project.name: FireSourcery_Library
project.description: Embedded C library (C23, arm-none-eabi-gcc, Cortex-M0+/M4) with a field-oriented motor control stack for bare-metal MCU targets: no RTOS, no heap after init, fixed-point at runtime. Generic Math, Framework and Type primitives, a Peripheral abstraction with a per-chip HAL, and Transducer algorithms sit beneath the Motor, MotorController and MotProtocol layers.

nodes.name: fixed.c
nodes.summary: Implements integer and fixed-point bit utilities: bit width, leading zero and sign-bit counts, log2 and power-of-two rounding, saturating add, rounded divide, and two integer square-root algorithms.
nodes.languageNotes: Selects GCC builtins (__builtin_clz, __builtin_clrsb, __builtin_add_overflow) with C23 stdbit or portable loop fallbacks behind preprocessor branches.

nodes.name: _leading_zeros
nodes.summary: Counts the leading zero bits of a 32-bit value through the compiler builtin or C23 stdbit.

nodes.name: _leading_sign_bits
nodes.summary: Counts the redundant leading sign bits of a signed 32-bit value through __builtin_clrsb.

nodes.name: fixed_bit_width
nodes.summary: Returns the number of bits needed to represent an unsigned 32-bit value, 0 for zero.

nodes.name: fixed_bit_width_signed
nodes.summary: Returns the magnitude bit width of a signed 32-bit value, excluding redundant sign bits.

nodes.name: fixed_lshift_max_unsigned
nodes.summary: Returns the largest left shift an unsigned value can take without overflow, its leading zero count.

nodes.name: fixed_lshift_max_signed
nodes.summary: Returns the largest left shift a signed value can take without overflow; used to size scaling shifts.

nodes.name: fixed_log2
nodes.summary: Floor of log2 for an unsigned 32-bit value, returning 0 for zero.

nodes.name: fixed_log2_ceiling
nodes.summary: Ceiling of log2 for an unsigned 32-bit value.

nodes.name: fixed_log2_bound
nodes.summary: Returns the floor and ceiling log2 exponents of a value as an interval.

nodes.name: fixed_pow2_bound
nodes.summary: Returns the two powers of two that bracket a value as an interval.

nodes.name: fixed_log2_round
nodes.summary: Returns the exponent of the power of two nearest to the value.

nodes.name: fixed_pow2_round
nodes.summary: Rounds a value to the nearest power of two.

nodes.name: fixed_sqrt
nodes.summary: Integer square root of a 32-bit value using the bit-by-bit digit method, no division.

nodes.name: fixed_add_sat
nodes.summary: Signed 32-bit addition that saturates to plus or minus INT32_MAX on overflow, using the GCC overflow builtin when available.

nodes.name: fixed_div_round
nodes.summary: Integer division rounded to nearest by adding half the divisor.

nodes.name: fixed_sqrt_iterative
nodes.summary: Integer square root by Babylonian iteration from a range-selected seed, bounded to six iterations.

nodes.name: fixed.h
nodes.summary: Public declarations for the integer and fixed-point bit utilities implemented in fixed.c: log2, bit width, maximum left shift, square root, saturating add and rounded divide.

nodes.name: Hysteresis.h
nodes.summary: Header-only hysteresis instance (Hysteresis_T) holding a setpoint and resetpoint with a conditioned output and boolean state. Provides high-acting and inverted low-acting region, poll and filter operations over the pure functions in hysteresis_math.h.

nodes.name: Hysteresis_OutputOf
nodes.summary: Conditions an input for a high-acting hysteresis: passes it through outside the band and holds the setpoint inside the band while previously triggered.

nodes.name: Hysteresis_RegionOf
nodes.summary: Classifies a value as off, on or deadband for a high-acting setpoint and resetpoint pair.

nodes.name: Hysteresis_Poll
nodes.summary: Updates the conditioned output and stored boolean state of a high-acting hysteresis from a new input and returns the state.

nodes.name: Hysteresis_Inverted_OutputOf
nodes.summary: Low-acting counterpart of Hysteresis_OutputOf: holds the setpoint inside the band while previously triggered by a falling input.

nodes.name: Hysteresis_Inverted_RegionOf
nodes.summary: Classifies a value as off, on or deadband for a low-acting pair, where the setpoint lies below the resetpoint.

nodes.name: Hysteresis_Inverted_Poll
nodes.summary: Updates the output and boolean state of a low-acting hysteresis from a new input and returns the state.

nodes.name: Hysteresis_Reset
nodes.summary: Resets the hysteresis to its inactive state with the output at the resetpoint.

nodes.name: Hysteresis_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes a hysteresis with an explicit setpoint and resetpoint, starting inactive.

nodes.name: hysteresis_math.h
nodes.summary: Stateless hysteresis primitives: active-high and active-low boolean state, deadbanded sign, sticky on-falling and on-rising value conditioning, and deadband, clamp and delta filters.

nodes.name: hysteresis_output_state_active_high
nodes.summary: Boolean hysteresis for a rising trigger: true at or above the setpoint, false at or below the resetpoint, otherwise the previous state.

nodes.name: hysteresis_output_state_active_low
nodes.summary: Inverted boolean hysteresis for low alarms: true at or below the setpoint, false at or above the resetpoint, otherwise the previous state.

nodes.name: hysteresis_output_state
nodes.summary: Direction-agnostic boolean hysteresis that normalizes by the sign of setpoint minus resetpoint and delegates to the active-high form.

nodes.name: hysteresis_sign
nodes.summary: Returns the sign of a value with a deadband around zero, holding the previous sign between the off and on magnitudes only while the sign still matches.

nodes.name: hysteresis_on_falling
nodes.summary: Sticky threshold filter for a high-acting pair: passes the input outside the band and outputs the setpoint inside it while previously triggered.

nodes.name: hysteresis_on_rising
nodes.summary: Sticky threshold filter for a low-acting pair, the mirror of hysteresis_on_falling.

nodes.name: hysteresis_deadband_filter
nodes.summary: Pass-through deadband filter that holds the previous output while the input lies between the lower and upper thresholds.

nodes.name: hysteresis_clamp_filter
nodes.summary: Clamping hysteresis filter that outputs the crossed threshold value and holds the previous output inside the band.

nodes.name: Linear.c
nodes.summary: Initializes Linear_T linear-function instances from a factor and divisor slope, a two-point map, or a fixed-point format, deriving a shifted integer slope and zero crossing sized to avoid 32-bit overflow.

nodes.name: Linear_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes a Linear_T from a factor and divisor slope with a y-intercept and reference output by converting to a two-point map.

nodes.name: Linear_Map_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes a Linear_T mapping [x0:xRef] to [y0:yRef], deriving the shifted slope, a shift sized for 2x headroom, and the zero crossing.

nodes.name: Linear_Fixed_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes a Linear_T that maps [x0:xRef] onto a fixed-point range of n fractional bits using a normalized 15-bit slope mantissa.

nodes.name: Linear.h
nodes.summary: Defines Linear_T, a shift-scaled integer linear function used for unit and ADC conversion, with inline forward and inverse evaluation, input-saturated and rounded variants, and fract16 and percent16 format helpers.

nodes.name: Linear_Of
nodes.summary: Evaluates the linear function as ((x - X0) * Slope) >> SlopeShift.

nodes.name: Linear_InvOf
nodes.summary: Evaluates the inverse of the linear function by dividing by the stored slope and adding X0.

nodes.name: Linear_Of_Sat
nodes.summary: Evaluates the linear function with the input clamped to [X0 - XDelta, X0 + XDelta], bounding the multiply.

nodes.name: Linear_Fract16_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes a Linear_T so that [x0:xRef] maps onto the fract16 range with 15 fractional bits.

nodes.name: Linear_Fract16_Sat
nodes.summary: Evaluates the linear function and saturates the result to the signed fract16 range.

nodes.name: Linear_Fract16_SatPos
nodes.summary: Evaluates the linear function and saturates the result to the non-negative fract16 range [0:32767].

nodes.name: linear_math.h
nodes.summary: Pure inline linear functions: shift-scaled and factor/divisor forms of f(x) and its inverse, rounded variants, and two-point range mapping with optional saturation.

nodes.name: linear_map_slope
nodes.summary: Maps x from an input origin to an output origin using a precomputed shifted slope, unsaturated.

nodes.name: linear_map_slope_sat
nodes.summary: Maps x between input and output ranges using a precomputed shifted slope, saturating at both range ends.

nodes.name: linear_map
nodes.summary: Linearly interpolates x from [in_low:in_high] to [out_low:out_high] using integer division.

nodes.name: linear_map_sat
nodes.summary: Two-point range mapping with the result held at the output bounds outside the input range.

nodes.name: Threshold.h
nodes.summary: Configuration value types for thresholds: a setpoint and resetpoint pair plus level and range formats with a deadband, and converters that bridge them to hysteresis setpoint and resetpoint pairs.

nodes.name: Threshold_InitSymmetric
nodes.summary: Builds a setpoint and resetpoint pair centered on a point with the deadband split evenly on either side.

nodes.name: Phase_Types.h
nodes.summary: Common three-phase types for the motor layer: Phase_Id sector ids, a per-phase bitmask, an int16 triplet and the flagged Phase_Data capture set, with sector stepping, angle lookup, register-mask mapping and capture-complete polling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses anonymous structs inside unions for named and indexed access, designated-initializer lookup tables indexed by enum, and a static_assert on the Phase_Data_T size.

nodes.name: Phase_MaskOf
nodes.summary: Spreads the A, B and C bits of a Phase_Id to given bit positions of a peripheral register mask.

nodes.name: Phase_IdOfMask
nodes.summary: Gathers the A, B and C bits from given positions of a register mask back into a Phase_Id; the inverse of Phase_MaskOf.

nodes.name: Phase_NextOf
nodes.summary: Returns the phase sector id 60 electrical degrees ahead (virtual CCW) from a lookup table.

nodes.name: Phase_PrevOf
nodes.summary: Returns the phase sector id 60 electrical degrees behind from a lookup table.

nodes.name: Phase_SignOf
nodes.summary: Returns +1, -1 or 0 for a forward, reverse, or unchanged or invalid step between two phase sector ids.

nodes.name: Phase_AngleOf
nodes.summary: Returns the 16-bit electrical angle of a phase sector id from a lookup table.

nodes.name: Phase_IdOfMax
nodes.summary: Returns the phase with the highest value in a triplet, a tie taking the earlier phase.

nodes.name: Phase_Capture
nodes.summary: Stores one phase value into a Phase_Data set and sets that phase captured flag.

nodes.name: Phase_PollComplete
nodes.summary: Returns true once all three phases are flagged captured and clears the flags, so the result is an edge.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC.h
nodes.summary: ADC component of the phase input: converts raw counts to per-unit fract16 voltage and current, marks the phase V and I conversion channels, and provides capture callbacks including the two-phase solve of the third current for low-side sensing.
nodes.languageNotes: Board scaling and current polarity are compile-time macros; PHASE_ADC_I_SENSOR_LOW_SIDE selects the solve-third-phase capture path.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC_VPuOf
nodes.summary: Converts a phase voltage ADC count to per-unit fract16 by the compile-time scale factor.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC_IPuOf
nodes.summary: Converts a phase current ADC count to signed per-unit fract16 relative to the sensor zero, applying the sensor polarity.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC_MarkVabc
nodes.summary: Marks the three phase voltage ADC conversions for sampling.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC_MarkIabc
nodes.summary: Marks the three phase current ADC conversions for sampling.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC_MarkI
nodes.summary: Marks only the phase current conversions selected by a phase bitmask.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC_Mark
nodes.summary: Marks, per phase, either the current or the voltage conversion according to a phase state bitmask.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC_CaptureV
nodes.summary: ADC callback body that converts a voltage count to per-unit and captures it into the V set of the phase input.

nodes.name: _Phase_ADC_SolveI
nodes.summary: Completes a current set from two captured phases by solving the third from ia + ib + ic = 0, saturated to fract16.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC_CaptureI
nodes.summary: ADC callback body that converts a current count to per-unit, captures it, and under low-side sensing solves the third phase.

nodes.name: Phase_Iabc_PuOfAdcu
nodes.summary: Builds a complete per-unit phase current set from three ADC counts and their zero references.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC_CaptureIBatch
nodes.summary: Captures one batch of phase current counts with the converted-phases mask and solves any unconverted third phase.

nodes.name: Phase_Vabc_PuOfAdcu
nodes.summary: Builds a complete per-unit phase voltage set from three ADC counts.

nodes.name: Phase_Input.h
nodes.summary: Defines Phase_Input_T, the transport struct carrying the captured phase voltage and current sets, with clear helpers and a variable-id getter for the six V and I values.

nodes.name: Phase_Input_Var_Get
nodes.summary: Returns a captured phase voltage or current value selected by variable id.

nodes.name: SinCos.c
nodes.summary: Setup and calibration for the analog sin/cos resolver decoder: config load from NVM, ADC range scaling, angle-offset and direction calibration, and config access by id.

nodes.name: SinCos_State_ResetUnits
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the ADC-to-fract16 scaling from the configured minimum and maximum counts, centered at midscale.

nodes.name: SinCos_Init
nodes.summary: Loads the config from NVM when present, rebuilds the unit scaling and zeroes the captured angle.

nodes.name: SinCos_Config_SetAdc
nodes.summary: Sets the ADC count and millivolt range of the sensor signals and rebuilds the scaling.

nodes.name: SinCos_Config_SetAdc_mV
nodes.summary: Sets the signal range from millivolt limits by converting them to ADC counts with the ADC reference.

nodes.name: SinCos_Config_SetAngleRatio
nodes.summary: Sets the ratio of electrical rotations per sensor cycle.

nodes.name: SinCos_CalibrateAngleOffset
nodes.summary: Records the decoded raw angle as the zero offset while the rotor is held at electrical zero.

nodes.name: SinCos_CalibrateCcwPositive
nodes.summary: Determines the sensor direction from the decoded angle with the rotor held at electrical +120 degrees.

nodes.name: SinCos_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a SinCos config field by id.

nodes.name: SinCos_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a SinCos config field by id, rebuilding the scaling when the ADC range changes.

nodes.name: SinCos.h
nodes.summary: Analog sin/cos resolver decode core: config, state and const handle types plus inline atan2 angle decode with offset and direction correction and mechanical-to-electrical angle projection.

nodes.name: _SinCos_DecodeAngle
nodes.summary: Scales the raw sin and cos ADC counts to fract16 and returns the atan2 angle without offset or direction correction.

nodes.name: SinCos_CaptureAngle
nodes.summary: Decodes the sensor angle, subtracts the calibrated offset, applies the direction, and stores the mechanical angle.

nodes.name: SinCos_GetElectricalAngle
nodes.summary: Projects the stored mechanical angle to an electrical angle by the configured rotation ratio.

nodes.name: VBus.c
nodes.summary: Translation unit for the DC bus voltage module; it only includes VBus.h and Monitor_Config.h, as all VBus logic is inline in the headers.

nodes.name: VBus.h
nodes.summary: DC bus voltage module shared by the Motor and MotorController layers: holds the filtered per-unit bus voltage and its inverse for FOC output normalization, the under- and over-voltage current derating ramps, speed derate, charge level, and init from the config and monitor partitions.
nodes.languageNotes: Header-only module of static inline functions; VBus_T embeds the VMonitor state and holds two separately stored config partitions that VBus_Reinit reconciles.

nodes.name: _VBus_Capture
nodes.summary: Stores the per-unit bus voltage and caches its reciprocal for output normalization, without filtering.

nodes.name: VBus_Capture
nodes.summary: Captures the bus voltage through a rolling two-sample average.

nodes.name: VBus_SetVNominal_V
nodes.summary: Sets the nominal supply voltage in both the VBus config and the monitor config.

nodes.name: _VBus_IDerateUnderVOf
nodes.summary: Computes the undervoltage current-limit derate, ramping from the floor at the fault-low limit to full scale at the warning-low limit.

nodes.name: _VBus_IDerateOverVOf
nodes.summary: Computes the overvoltage regen-current derate, ramping from full scale at the warning-high limit to the floor at the fault-high limit.

nodes.name: VBus_IDerateActive
nodes.summary: Returns the current derate for the active monitor status: the undervoltage or overvoltage ramp in warning, zero in fault, full scale when normal.

nodes.name: VBus_GetSpeedDerate
nodes.summary: Returns the speed-limit scale as bus voltage over nominal, clamped between the configured floor and 1.0.

nodes.name: VBus_GetChargeLevel
nodes.summary: Estimates the charge level by normalizing bus voltage between the fault-low and warning-high limits.

nodes.name: VBus_InitLive
nodes.summary: Seeds the live bus voltage state to the nominal supply voltage before the first ADC sample lands.

nodes.name: VBus_InitDerateSlopes
nodes.summary: Precomputes the under- and over-voltage derate slopes from the monitor thresholds and the floor values.

nodes.name: VBus_Reinit
nodes.summary: Re-derives the nominal per-unit value, the derate slopes and the range monitor from the held config partitions, leaving live state untouched.

nodes.name: VBus_InitMonitor
nodes.summary: Loads the monitor config partition, if given, and re-derives the dependent state.

nodes.name: VBus_InitBase
nodes.summary: Loads the base VBus config partition, if given, and re-derives the dependent state.

nodes.name: VBus_VarId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a live VBus value (per-unit voltage, inverse, or charge level) by variable id.

nodes.name: VBus_Config_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a VBus config field by id and re-anchors the monitor thresholds to the Li-ion profile when the nominal voltage changes.

nodes.name: VBus_ADC.h
nodes.summary: Include-only header reserved for the bus voltage ADC capture path; its capture and board-id functions are commented out and now live in VBus.h and VBus_Config.h.

nodes.name: VBus_Config.h
nodes.summary: NVM configuration for the DC bus: pack nominal voltage, supply current limits and derate floors, Li-ion default presets for the config and the monitor thresholds, validation, and config access by id.
nodes.languageNotes: Default profiles are compound-literal macros (VBUS_CONFIG_LIION, VBUS_MONITOR_CONFIG_LIION) so they can initialize constants at compile time as well as at run time.

nodes.name: VBus_Config_LiIon
nodes.summary: Returns the default Li-ion VBus config for a nominal voltage capped at the rated voltage of the board.

nodes.name: VBus_MonitorConfig_LiIon
nodes.summary: Returns Li-ion monitor thresholds scaled around a nominal voltage capped at the rated voltage of the board.

nodes.name: VBus_Config_Validate
nodes.summary: Clamps the VBus config fields to the board voltage and current ratings and the fract16 range.

nodes.name: VBus_Config_IsValid
nodes.summary: Checks that the nominal voltage, supply current limits and derate floors are within board ratings and range.

nodes.name: VBus_MonitorConfig_IsValid
nodes.summary: Checks that the monitor thresholds are strictly ordered fault, warning, nominal on both sides, so the derate ramps have nonzero spans.

nodes.name: VBus_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a VBus config field by id.

nodes.name: VBus_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a VBus config field by id, clamping the nominal voltage and supply current limits to board ratings.

nodes.name: VBus_BoardId_Get
nodes.summary: Returns the phase voltage divider resistor values of the board by divider config id.

nodes.name: VBus_Monitor.h
nodes.summary: Thin entry points binding VBus to its RangeMonitor-based voltage monitor: poll with the live bus voltage, read status and edges, and pause or resume monitoring during config writes.

nodes.name: VBus_PollMonitor
nodes.summary: Polls the range monitor with the current filtered bus voltage and returns the voltage monitor status.

nodes.name: ADC_Reference.h
nodes.summary: Declares the application-wide ADC full-scale reference (bits, maximum count, Vref in millivolts) and inline conversions between raw counts and left-justified Q1.15 fract16 values.

nodes.name: Monitor.c
nodes.summary: Generic single-direction threshold monitor: evaluates an input against a hard fault limit and a hysteresis warning band as high- or low-acting, derives the direction from config, and exposes setters and var and config access by id.

nodes.name: _Monitor_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Initializes a monitor base from config: the warning hysteresis from the warning thresholds, and the hard fault limit.

nodes.name: _Monitor_EvaluateAsHigh
nodes.summary: Evaluates an input as a high-acting monitor: normal at or below the resetpoint, fault at the limit, otherwise warning per the hysteresis.

nodes.name: _Monitor_EvaluateAsLow
nodes.summary: Evaluates an input as a low-acting monitor using the inverted hysteresis and a lower fault limit.

nodes.name: Monitor_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Loads the config, initializes the base, derives the monitoring direction (disabled when not enabled or invalid) and resets the state.

nodes.name: Monitor_Poll
nodes.summary: Records the input and updates the current and previous status by evaluating in the direction of the monitor.

nodes.name: Monitor_Reset
nodes.summary: Resets the status to normal, the last input to nominal, and the warning hysteresis.

nodes.name: Monitor_SetFaultLimit
nodes.summary: Sets the fault limit in config and re-initializes the monitor.

nodes.name: Monitor_SetWarningSetpoint
nodes.summary: Sets the warning setpoint in config and re-initializes the monitor.

nodes.name: Monitor_SetWarningResetpoint
nodes.summary: Sets the warning resetpoint in config and re-initializes the monitor.

nodes.name: Monitor_SetNominal
nodes.summary: Sets the nominal value in config and re-initializes the monitor.

nodes.name: _Monitor_VarId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads the monitor status or last value by variable id, without a null check.

nodes.name: Monitor_VarId_Get
nodes.summary: Null-safe read of the monitor status or last value by variable id.

nodes.name: _Monitor_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a monitor config field by id.

nodes.name: _Monitor_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a monitor config field by id without re-deriving the runtime state.

nodes.name: Monitor_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Null-safe read of a config field of a monitor by id.

nodes.name: Monitor_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Null-safe write of a config field by id, followed by re-initialization.

nodes.name: Monitor.h
nodes.summary: Types and inline queries for the generic single-direction monitor: status and mode enums, the base, config and runtime structs, status edge detection, and enable control.

nodes.name: Monitor_GetOutputValue
nodes.summary: Returns the status-conditioned value: the fault limit in fault, the hysteresis output in warning, otherwise the last input.

nodes.name: Monitor_Config.h
nodes.summary: Inline builders and validators for Monitor_Config_T and RangeMonitor_Config_T: explicit, percentage and symmetric constructors, high and low ordering checks, and expansion of a range config into high-side and low-side monitor configs.

nodes.name: Monitor_Config_Create
nodes.summary: Builds a Monitor_Config_T from a nominal value, warning set and reset points, and a fault limit.

nodes.name: Monitor_Config_OverLimit
nodes.summary: Builds a high-side monitor config from percentage offsets above nominal with a 5 percent warning reset band.

nodes.name: Monitor_Config_UnderLimit
nodes.summary: Builds a low-side monitor config from percentage offsets below nominal with a 5 percent warning reset band.

nodes.name: Monitor_Config_IsValidAsHigh
nodes.summary: Checks the threshold ordering of a high-side monitor: fault >= warning setpoint > resetpoint >= nominal.

nodes.name: Monitor_Config_IsValidAsLow
nodes.summary: Checks the threshold ordering of a low-side monitor: fault <= warning setpoint < resetpoint <= nominal.

nodes.name: Monitor_Config_IsValid
nodes.summary: Validates a config as high-side or low-side according to the ordering of the fault and warning setpoints.

nodes.name: Monitor_Config_FromRangeHigh
nodes.summary: Derives the high-side Monitor_Config_T from a range config, enabled only when the high limits are ordered above nominal.

nodes.name: Monitor_Config_FromRangeLow
nodes.summary: Derives the low-side Monitor_Config_T from a range config, enabled only when the low limits are ordered below nominal.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_Config_Create
nodes.summary: Builds a RangeMonitor_Config_T from a nominal value, fault and warning limits on both sides, and a warning hysteresis band.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_Config_Symmetric
nodes.summary: Builds a range config with equal fault and warning offsets above and below nominal.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_Config_SymmetricPercent
nodes.summary: Builds a symmetric range config from fault, warning and hysteresis percentages of nominal.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_Config_IsValid
nodes.summary: Validates a range config by expanding it into high and low monitor configs and checking the ordering of each side.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor.c
nodes.summary: Two-sided range monitor composed of a high and a low Monitor base: initializes both sides from a range config, combines their results into a signed status, and provides poll, reset, and var and config access by id.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Loads the range config, initializes both monitor sides, resets the state, and sets the mode active only when both sides are enabled and valid.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_Evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates the input on both sides and combines the results into a signed status, negative for the low side.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_Poll
nodes.summary: When active, records the input and updates the current and previous status; returns normal while disabled or paused.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_Reset
nodes.summary: Resets the status to normal, the last input to nominal, and both warning hystereses.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_VarId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads the range monitor status or last value by variable id.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a range monitor config field by id.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a range monitor config field by id; the holder re-derives with RangeMonitor_InitFrom.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor.h
nodes.summary: Types and inline queries for the two-sided RangeMonitor: a signed status enum aligned for abs()-based severity, the range config and mode, and edge, severity and direction queries with pause and resume.
nodes.languageNotes: Status enum values are deliberately signed and symmetric (-2..2) so abs() yields severity and the sign yields the side.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_IsDirectionCrossing
nodes.summary: Detects a status change directly between the high and low sides without passing through normal.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor.c
nodes.summary: Initializes temperature monitors: a single thermistor context (monitor thresholds, derate scale, thermistor coefficients, optional linear conversion) and a group that shares one config across its instances.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Initializes one heat monitor context: monitor thresholds, the derate limit scale, thermistor coefficients, and the optional Celsius-per-ADC linearization.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes a heat monitor context from its NVM config.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor_Group_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the collective monitor and limit scale of the group, then each instance from its own NVM config or that of the group.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor.h
nodes.summary: Temperature monitor built on Monitor_T: per-thermistor context and group types, filtered polling, a fault-to-warning derate scale, a hottest-sensor collective poll, and var and config access for monitor and thermistor settings.
nodes.languageNotes: HeatMonitor_T and HeatMonitor_Group_T are const handle structs (typedef const struct) that point at mutable state, the library pattern for ROM-placed contexts.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor_ToLimitScale
nodes.summary: Derives the derate Linear_T that maps the fault setpoint to 0 and the warning setpoint to 1, guarding against equal setpoints.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor_Poll
nodes.summary: Polls the monitor of a thermistor with the two-sample average of the new and last input.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a monitor config field by id and re-derives the derate limit scale from the new thresholds.

nodes.name: _HeatMonitor_Group_FindHottest
nodes.summary: Returns the index of the enabled group instance with the highest direction-normalized last input.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor_Group_PollCollective
nodes.summary: Polls the collective monitor of the group using the last input of the hottest sensor.

nodes.name: Thermistor.c
nodes.summary: Thermistor unit conversion between ADC counts, resistance and temperature for a pull-down divider, using Steinhart-Hart, quadratic PTC or two-point linear models, plus derivation of linearized Linear_T scalers and coefficient access by id.
nodes.languageNotes: The float models compile only under THERMISTOR_UNITS_FLOAT; float coefficients pass through the int32 config interface as raw IEEE-754 bits via a union.

nodes.name: Thermistor_KelvinOfR_Steinhart
nodes.summary: Converts thermistor resistance to Kelvin with the Steinhart-Hart B-parameter model; float builds only.

nodes.name: Thermistor_ROfKelvin_Steinhart
nodes.summary: Converts Kelvin to thermistor resistance with the inverse B-parameter model; float builds only.

nodes.name: Thermistor_KelvinOfR_Quadratic
nodes.summary: Converts resistance to Kelvin for a silicon PTC using the quadratic model; float builds only.

nodes.name: Thermistor_ROfKelvin_Quadratic
nodes.summary: Converts Kelvin to resistance for a silicon PTC using the quadratic model; float builds only.

nodes.name: Thermistor_CelsiusOfAdcu
nodes.summary: Converts an ADC count to Celsius, dispatching on the configured fit and falling back to the two-point linear model.

nodes.name: Thermistor_AdcuOfCelsius
nodes.summary: Converts Celsius to an ADC count, dispatching on the configured fit with a linear fallback.

nodes.name: Thermistor_ROhmOfAdcu
nodes.summary: Computes the thermistor resistance from an ADC count for the pull-down divider, removing any parallel resistor.

nodes.name: Thermistor_AdcuOfROhm
nodes.summary: Computes the ADC count for a thermistor resistance in the pull-down divider, including any parallel resistor.

nodes.name: Thermistor_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Copies coefficients into a configurable thermistor and resolves the fit type when unset; fixed instances are left unchanged.

nodes.name: Thermistor_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes a thermistor from its constant (NVM or compile-time) coefficients.

nodes.name: Thermistor_ToLinear_ROhmsPerAdcu
nodes.summary: Derives a Linear_T mapping ADC counts to ohms from the two-point linear model.

nodes.name: Thermistor_ToLinear_CelsiusPerROhms
nodes.summary: Derives a Linear_T mapping ohms to Celsius from the two-point linear model.

nodes.name: Thermistor_ToLinear_CelsiusPerAdcu
nodes.summary: Derives a Linear_T mapping ADC counts directly to Celsius from the two-point linear model.

nodes.name: _Thermistor_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a board constant or coefficient by id, returning float coefficients as raw IEEE-754 bits.

nodes.name: _Thermistor_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a coefficient by id for non-fixed thermistors; board constants are read-only.

nodes.name: Thermistor_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Null-safe read of a thermistor config value by id.

nodes.name: Thermistor_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Null-safe write of a thermistor config value by id.

nodes.name: _Thermistor_ConfigId_Get16
nodes.summary: Config read for 16-bit transport that scales resistances down by 10.

nodes.name: _Thermistor_ConfigId_Set16
nodes.summary: Config write for 16-bit transport that scales R0 up by 10; ignored for fixed thermistors.

nodes.name: Thermistor.h
nodes.summary: Thermistor descriptor types and macros: a coefficient set for NTC B-parameter, PTC quadratic and two-point linear fits, board wiring constants, initializers for fixed and configurable instances, and inline accessors.
nodes.languageNotes: A fixed instance aliases P_COEFFS to P_CONST_COEFFS; Thermistor_IsFixed tests that pointer identity to guard writes. thermal_t switches between int16 and float by build macro.

nodes.name: Thermistor_FitOf
nodes.summary: Resolves the resistance-temperature model from which coefficients are populated: Steinhart or quadratic in float builds, otherwise linear or none.

nodes.name: Linear_Voltage.c
nodes.summary: Initializes a Linear_T for voltage-divider ADC conversion from R1, R2, the ADC reference voltage and resolution, using a constant 15-bit slope shift.

nodes.name: Linear_Voltage_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes a Linear_T converting ADC counts to volts for a divider R1/R2, an ADC reference and a bit depth, with a fixed 15-bit shift.

nodes.name: Linear_Voltage.h
nodes.summary: ADC-to-voltage conversion through a voltage divider on Linear_T: compile-time initializer macros and inline conversions between ADC counts and volts or millivolts in both directions.

nodes.name: VDivider.c
nodes.summary: Empty translation unit for the voltage divider module; it only includes VDivider.h.

nodes.name: VDivider.h
nodes.summary: Defines the constant VDivider_T resistor pair, its conversion to a Linear_T voltage scaler using the global ADC reference, and board resistor access by id.

nodes.name: VDivider_ToLinear
nodes.summary: Initializes a Linear_T voltage scaler from the divider resistors and the global ADC reference.

nodes.name: _VDivider_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Returns a divider resistor value by id, scaled down by 10.

nodes.name: VMonitor.c
nodes.summary: Initializes voltage monitors: default symmetric percentage limits, and a context init that loads the range monitor config and derives the linear voltage conversion of the divider.

nodes.name: VMonitor_InitLimitsDefault
nodes.summary: Sets symmetric percentage-based fault, warning and hysteresis limits around nominal and re-initializes the range monitor.

nodes.name: VMonitor_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Initializes the range monitor of the voltage monitor from config and, when a Linear_T is provided, the voltage conversion of the divider.

nodes.name: VMonitor_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes a voltage monitor context from its NVM config.

nodes.name: VMonitor.h
nodes.summary: Voltage monitor specialization of RangeMonitor: state and config aliases, an under- and over-voltage status enum, a const context with divider and NVM config, a charge-level estimate, and var and config access.

nodes.name: VMonitor_ChargeLevelOfInput_Percent16
nodes.summary: Returns the position of an input between the fault-low limit and nominal as a 16-bit percentage.

nodes.name: Hysteresis_T
nodes.summary: Complete hysteresis instance: the setpoint and resetpoint thresholds, the conditioned output value held as state and the current logical output state. The caller handles direction.

nodes.name: Linear_T
nodes.summary: Forward coefficients of a fixed-point linear map y = ((x - X0) * Slope) >> SlopeShift: the slope and its shift, the zero crossing X0 and the reference span XDelta. The inverse divides instead of storing its own coefficients.

nodes.name: Threshold_T
nodes.summary: Setpoint and resetpoint pair, the run-time form of one threshold that bridges the configuration formats in this header to Hysteresis.

nodes.name: Threshold_Level_T
nodes.summary: Configuration format for one level: a setpoint and a deadband, converted to a Threshold_T acting high, low or symmetric.

nodes.name: Threshold_Range_T
nodes.summary: Configuration format for a two-sided window: a high and a low limit with one deadband applied to both directions, converted to a high and a low Threshold_T.

nodes.name: Phase_Data_T
nodes.summary: Three-phase sample set in 8 bytes: the A, B and C int16 values (also addressable as a Phase_Triplet_T), a per-phase bitmask of the channels captured and a pad byte. Phase_Capture sets a channel flag and Phase_PollComplete clears the flags once all three are present.

nodes.name: Phase_AdcBoard_T
nodes.summary: Const board constants of the phase sense front end: the phase voltage divider R1 and R2, and the current path base, MOSFET and shunt resistances with the amplifier gain. Phase_ADC_VMax and Phase_ADC_IMax derive full-scale volts and amps from it and the ADC reference.

nodes.name: Phase_ADC_T
nodes.summary: Const set of the six ADC conversion handles of one motor: phase voltages VA, VB, VC and phase currents IA, IB, IC. The Phase_ADC_Mark functions mark them for conversion.

nodes.name: Phase_Input_T
nodes.summary: Capture result interface for the phase measurements: one Phase_Data_T for the voltages and one for the currents.

nodes.name: SinCos_Config_T
nodes.summary: Storable sin/cos resolver calibration: the ADC and millivolt minimum and maximum, the electrical rotations ratio, the sensor-to-rotor angle offset and the CCW-positive flag.

nodes.name: SinCos_State_T
nodes.summary: Runtime state of the sin/cos decoder: the working copy of the config, the ADC to fract16 Linear_T scaling derived from it and the last captured mechanical angle.

nodes.name: SinCos_T
nodes.summary: Const handle of the sin/cos decode core: pointers to its state and to its NVM config. ADC sourcing lives in the sensor adapter (SinCos_Sensor).

nodes.name: VBus_T
nodes.summary: Bus voltage object shared by the Motor and MotorController layers: the filtered per-unit bus voltage and its cached inverse for Vout normalization, the precomputed under- and over-voltage current derate slopes, the voltage monitor state and the embedded VBus_Config_T.

nodes.name: VBus_Config_T
nodes.summary: NVM bus configuration: the nominal pack voltage, the discharge and charge supply current limits in per-unit, and the floor scales of the under-voltage, over-voltage and speed derate ramps.

nodes.name: ADC_Reference_T
nodes.summary: Const full scale of the converter as its consumers see it: resolution in bits, maximum count and reference voltage in millivolts. One global instance, ADC_REFERENCE, is defined by the application.

nodes.name: Monitor_Base_T
nodes.summary: Inner state of one monitored direction, shared by the common polling logic: a hard fault limit with no hysteresis and a warning level held as a Hysteresis_T.

nodes.name: Monitor_Config_T
nodes.summary: Configuration of a single-direction monitor: the fault and warning thresholds, the nominal value and the enable flag.

nodes.name: Monitor_T
nodes.summary: Single-direction threshold monitor: its base levels, the direction it monitors, the current and previous status, the last input and the config held for runtime update.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_Config_T
nodes.summary: Configuration of a two-sided monitor: the fault and warning ranges, each a high and a low limit with a shared deadband, the nominal value and the enable flag.

nodes.name: RangeMonitor_T
nodes.summary: Two-sided monitor: a high and a low Monitor_Base_T, the combined signed status (under to over) with its previous value, the last input, the mode and the config held for runtime update.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor_T
nodes.summary: Const context of one thermistor heat monitor: a pointer to its Monitor_T state, the thermistor descriptor, an optional Linear_T for local unit conversion, the limit scale used for the derate and the NVM config.

nodes.name: HeatMonitor_Group_T
nodes.summary: Const context of a group of heat monitors handled as a fan-in: the array of HeatMonitor_T and its count, with a collective state, limit scale and NVM config.

nodes.name: Thermistor_Coeffs_T
nodes.summary: Thermistor characterization, configurable or fixed to the board: the NTC B parameter or the PTC quadratic Alpha and Beta, the reference point R0 and T0, the two-point linear DeltaR and DeltaT, and the selected fit.

nodes.name: Thermistor_T
nodes.summary: Const thermistor descriptor: the board series pull-up, optional parallel pull-down and series voltage, plus pointers to the working coefficients and to their NVM or compile-time constant source.

nodes.name: VDivider_T
nodes.summary: Const voltage divider descriptor holding R1 and R2. VDivider_ToLinear derives the ADC to voltage Linear_T from it and the global ADC reference.

nodes.name: VMonitor_T
nodes.summary: Const context of a voltage monitor: a pointer to its RangeMonitor_T state, the voltage divider, an optional Linear_T for local unit conversion and the NVM config.

nodes.name: Accumulator.c
nodes.summary: Initialisation routines for the saturating discrete-time integrator: a default unity-gain setup over the full int16 range, and a variant taking an explicit gain and saturation bounds.

nodes.name: Accumulator_Init
nodes.summary: Resets the accumulator to zero with a unity coefficient and limits spanning the full int16 range.

nodes.name: Accumulator_InitSat
nodes.summary: Initialises the accumulator with a caller-supplied coefficient and saturation bounds, starting the state at zero clamped into those bounds.

nodes.name: Accumulator.h
nodes.summary: Defines Accumulator_T, a forward-Euler discrete-time integrator with output saturation (y[n] = clamp(y[n-1] + K*u[n])) held in a 15-bit-shifted fixed-point state. Provides the pure step laws, user-scale accessors, limit setters and saturation status queries; it is the state behind Ramp_T.
nodes.languageNotes: Header-only API of static inline functions. ACCUMULATOR_FLOAT switches the io/state typedefs and the scaling macros between a Q15-shifted int32 and float.

nodes.name: accumulator
nodes.summary: Pure forward-Euler integrator step with output clamping: clamp(state + coeff*input, min, max).

nodes.name: Accumulator_SetLimits
nodes.summary: Stores the lower and upper saturation bounds, converting user-scale values to the shifted internal scale.

nodes.name: Accumulator_Step
nodes.summary: Advances the Accumulator_T state by one saturated integration step and returns the user-scale output.

nodes.name: Angle.h
nodes.summary: Defines Angle_T, a 32-bit angle tracker that stores angle16 position and per-cycle delta shifted left 16 bits so integration wraps by integer overflow. Supports free-wrap integration, bounded interpolation between sensor edges with re-targetable limit windows, and direct sensor snapshots.
nodes.languageNotes: Modulo-2pi wrap comes from unsigned overflow of the 32-bit accumulator; the high 16 bits are the angle16 value.

nodes.name: Angle_Integrate
nodes.summary: Wrap-mode integration: stores the given per-cycle delta and adds it to the angle, wrapping freely on overflow. Used by position trackers such as sensorless and commanded open-loop angles.

nodes.name: Angle_IntegrateStep
nodes.summary: Advances the angle by the already-stored shifted delta with free wrap, for paths that resolve the delta separately.

nodes.name: Angle_Interpolate
nodes.summary: Bounded integration step that clamps angle plus delta into the [LimitLower, LimitUpper] window, estimating the angle between sensor edges.

nodes.name: Angle_SetLimitWindow
nodes.summary: Sets a one-sided limit window of the given width starting at the current angle and extending in the direction of the delta sign.

nodes.name: Angle_InitLimits
nodes.summary: Zeroes angle and delta and sets symmetric limits of plus and minus the given angle around zero.

nodes.name: Angle_Interpolate_Branch
nodes.summary: Alternative bounded step using a wrap-aware unsigned range test; on leaving the window the angle snaps to the limit in the direction of travel.

nodes.name: AnglePll.h
nodes.summary: Angle tracking phase-locked loop built on Angle_T and a PI loop filter: phase error -> PI -> estimated speed -> integrated estimated angle. Includes phase detectors for a vector along the tracked angle, magnitude-floor normalisation, split correct/predict steps, lock detection with acquire and loss hold counts, and bumpless seeding.

nodes.name: angle_pll_error_normalized
nodes.summary: Phase detector returning sin(estimate - actual) for a vector along the tracked angle, with the magnitude divided out and zero returned at or below the magnitude floor.

nodes.name: AnglePll_Correct
nodes.summary: Correction step: records the phase error and sets the estimated speed (the angle delta) from the PI loop filter output.

nodes.name: AnglePll_Proc
nodes.summary: Runs correction and prediction together for the case where both execute at the same rate, returning the estimated angle.

nodes.name: _AnglePll_ProcLock
nodes.summary: Updates the lock state from signal magnitude and phase error: counts stable ticks to acquire lock and tolerates losses for a hold count before releasing, which gives hysteresis.

nodes.name: _AnglePll_ProcDetected
nodes.summary: Normalises a detected error against the magnitude floor, updates the lock state, then applies the correction.

nodes.name: AnglePll_ProcVector
nodes.summary: Detects a vector along the tracked angle against the unit vector of the estimated angle and corrects the estimated speed.

nodes.name: AnglePll_ProcRelative
nodes.summary: Corrects the estimated speed from a vector already rotated into the frame of the estimated angle.

nodes.name: AnglePll_Seed
nodes.summary: Bumpless seed of the estimated angle and speed from a known reference, preloading the PI integrator so the loop resumes from the seed.

nodes.name: AnglePll_Reset
nodes.summary: Clears angle, speed, loop filter state, phase error, magnitude and the lock counters.

nodes.name: AnglePll_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Initialises the loop filter from a PID configuration and resets the PLL state.

nodes.name: Angle_SpeedPu.h
nodes.summary: Defines Angle_SpeedPuRef_T, a precomputed base angle step (the angle delta at 1.0 per-unit speed) and its reciprocal, converting between per-unit speed and angle16 per control period without a runtime divide. Hot-path helpers load a per-unit speed into an Angle_T delta, integrate it, and resolve the delta back to a saturated per-unit speed.

nodes.name: Angle_CaptureSpeed_Pu
nodes.summary: Loads a per-unit speed into the Angle_T delta by multiplying it with the precomputed base angle step.

nodes.name: Angle_IntegrateSpeed_Pu
nodes.summary: Captures a per-unit speed as the delta and integrates the angle by one step.

nodes.name: Angle_ResolveSpeed_Pu
nodes.summary: Converts the stored angle delta back to per-unit speed using the reciprocal base step, saturating at plus or minus 1.0 pu.

nodes.name: angle_counter_math.h
nodes.summary: Pure conversion functions from encoder or Hall counter units (counts, counts per second, timer ticks at a given counts-per-revolution) to the canonical angle16, angle-frequency and angle-per-period forms. Also precomputes the runtime scaling factors for delta angle and per-unit speed, and gives rpm and cycles-per-second views for the user boundary.

nodes.name: angle_speed_math.h
nodes.summary: Defines the canonical rotational speed types angle_freq_t (angle16 per second, sample-rate-free storage) and angle_dt_t (angle16 per control period) with compile-time macros and inline conversions between them. Hz, rpm, rad/s and per-unit values are views converted through the angle frequency.

nodes.name: MovAvg.h
nodes.summary: MovAvg_T filter object wrapping the moving-average math: an exponential average with a fract16 coefficient, an N-sample approximation, and a running mean that divides an accumulated sum by its sample count.

nodes.name: MovAvg
nodes.summary: Applies one exponential moving-average step with the stored fract16 coefficient and returns the updated output.

nodes.name: MovAvg_Running
nodes.summary: Adds a sample to the running sum and returns the mean over the samples taken so far.

nodes.name: mov_avg_math.h
nodes.summary: Stateless moving-average formulas: the exponential average y = (1 - lambda)*y_prev + lambda*x in Q1.15, the equivalent integer N-sample form, and a cumulative mean step.

nodes.name: mov_avg
nodes.summary: Exponential moving average in Q1.15: (1 - lambda)*y_prev + lambda*x.

nodes.name: angle16.h
nodes.summary: Defines the 16-bit binary angle types (angle16_t, uangle16_t, angle32_t, rot32_t) in which 65536 counts make one revolution, with degree constants and radian conversion factors. Provides arc/radius conversions between angle and radian-scaled quantities, quadrant extraction, and full, half and quarter cycle crossing tests.

nodes.name: fract16.c
nodes.summary: Fixed-point trigonometry and 2D vector operations for Q1.15 fractions: sine and cosine from a 256-entry quarter-wave lookup table, a polynomial atan2, unit vector generation, vector magnitude, Pythagorean complement, scaling, and a circle-limit normalisation scalar.

nodes.name: fract16_sin
nodes.summary: Sine of an angle16 in Q1.15, mapping the quadrant of the angle onto a quarter-wave lookup table.

nodes.name: fract16_cos
nodes.summary: Cosine of an angle16 in Q1.15, using the same quarter-wave table with a quadrant-shifted index.

nodes.name: fract16_atan2
nodes.summary: Fixed-point atan2 returning an angle16, using a cubic polynomial approximation of the ratio (x - |y|)/(x + |y|) per half-plane.

nodes.name: fract16_vector
nodes.summary: Returns the unit vector (cos, sin) for an angle16.

nodes.name: fract16_vector_magnitude
nodes.summary: Magnitude of an (x, y) vector through the integer square root of the sum of squares.

nodes.name: fract16_vector_component
nodes.summary: Pythagorean complement: the remaining component magnitude given one component and a magnitude limit.

nodes.name: fract16_vector_scale
nodes.summary: Scales both components of a vector by a fractional magnitude capped at 1.0.

nodes.name: fract16_vector_norm
nodes.summary: Returns the scalar limit/|v| needed to bring a vector inside a magnitude limit, or 1.0 when it is already within it.

nodes.name: fract16.h
nodes.summary: Core Q1.15 fixed-point header defining fract16_t, ufract16_t, accum32_t and related types, common constants (1/sqrt3, sqrt3/2, pi, the 120 degree sine and cosine) and literal macros. Provides inline multiply, divide, saturation, abs, sqrt, lerp/normalise and interval scaling helpers, and declares the trigonometry and vector functions implemented in fract16.c.
nodes.languageNotes: Operations take accum32_t parameters so intermediates up to +/-2.0 pass through unsaturated; saturation is a separate explicit step (fract16_sat, the _sat variants).

nodes.name: fract16_div
nodes.summary: Unsaturated Q1.15 divide, (dividend << 15) / divisor, asserting the dividend range and a non-zero divisor.

nodes.name: fract16_normalize_sat
nodes.summary: Maps x from [lo, hi] onto [0, FRACT16_MAX], saturating outside that range.

nodes.name: fract16_interval_div
nodes.summary: Divides the bounds of an interval by a fract16 scalar, saturating to plus or minus FRACT16_MAX and guarding a zero divisor.

nodes.name: fract16e.h
nodes.summary: Defines fract16e_t, a mantissa-plus-shift coefficient that scales a Q1.15 value with one 32-bit multiply and shift instead of a 64-bit product. Includes constructors from an accum32 value or a ratio, the multiply, and fract16k_t, which selects this form on Thumb-1 targets without a long multiply and a plain accum32 elsewhere.
nodes.languageNotes: FIXED_LONG_MULTIPLY_SOFT is derived from __ARM_ARCH_ISA_THUMB, so the coefficient representation is chosen per target at compile time.

nodes.name: fract16e
nodes.summary: Builds a mantissa-shift coefficient from an accum32 value and an exponent, dropping integer bits so the mantissa fits 16 bits.

nodes.name: fract16e_of_ratio
nodes.summary: Builds a coefficient from num/den, pre-shifting by the bit-width difference to keep a full-precision mantissa.

nodes.name: fract16e_mul
nodes.summary: Multiplies a coefficient by an accum32 value with one 32-bit product and a right shift.

nodes.name: interval_fixed.h
nodes.summary: Placeholder for a fixed-point variant of the interval_t helpers. It only includes math_general.h; the interval constructors and set operations are present as commented-out code.

nodes.name: math_general_fixed.h
nodes.summary: Integer duplicates of the math_general.h ordering helpers under a fixed_ prefix: abs, min, max, clamp, range and wrap-window tests, signed shift and sign functions. Intended as the fixed-point side of a numeric HAL selection.

nodes.name: math_general_float.h
nodes.summary: Float overloads of the math_general.h ordering helpers (abs, min, max, clamp, sign) for the floating-point numeric representation; integer callers keep the int32 versions.

nodes.name: real.h
nodes.summary: Numeric representation HAL selector: includes real_float.h when FLOATING_POINT is defined and real_fixed.h otherwise, giving math code one fract/accum vocabulary over either storage.

nodes.name: real_fixed.h
nodes.summary: Fixed-point binding of the real.h numeric vocabulary: maps fract_t, ufract_t, accum_t and coeff_t and their arithmetic, trigonometry and vector operations onto the fract16 and fract16e/fract16k implementations through typedefs and macros. The storage-boundary conversions are identity functions.

nodes.name: real_float.h
nodes.summary: Floating-point binding of the real.h numeric vocabulary: fract_t, accum_t and coeff_t become float, with float arithmetic, saturation, sqrt and vector functions. Angles stay angle16_t and storage stays fract16/accum32, converted at the wire, NVM and ADC boundary.

nodes.name: PID.c
nodes.summary: Fixed-point PI controller implementation: computes the proportional plus integral output with a dynamic integral clamp that tracks the output band for anti-windup, and manages output limits and state seeding. Converts the Q17.15 Kp and Ki configuration into mantissa-shift runtime gains scaled by the sample frequency.

nodes.name: PID_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Copies an optional configuration, derives the runtime gains, sets full-range output limits and resets the controller state.

nodes.name: CalcPI
nodes.summary: Core parallel PI calculation: the proportional term plus an integral accumulator clamped to a band that moves with the proportional term, so saturation releases without unwinding.

nodes.name: PID_CaptureOutputLimits
nodes.summary: Updates the output limits synchronously with processing without touching the integral, leaving it to the dynamic clamp.

nodes.name: PID_ProcPI
nodes.summary: Runs one PI step on setpoint minus feedback and returns the output clamped to the output limits.

nodes.name: PID_Reset
nodes.summary: Clears the integral accumulator, the previous error and the output.

nodes.name: _PID_SetOutputState
nodes.summary: Sets the output and the matching integral directly, asserting the value lies within the output limits.

nodes.name: PID_SetOutputState
nodes.summary: Clamps a requested output into the limits, then seeds the output and integral with it.

nodes.name: PID_SetOutputLimits
nodes.summary: Sets persistent output limits and moves the integral accumulator into the new range.

nodes.name: PID_SetFreq
nodes.summary: Stores a new sample frequency and recomputes the per-tick integral gain.

nodes.name: PID_SetKp_Fixed32
nodes.summary: Stores a bounded Kp in Q17.15 in the configuration and derives the runtime mantissa-shift gain from it.

nodes.name: PID_SetKi_Fixed32
nodes.summary: Stores a bounded Ki in Q17.15 and derives the per-tick integral gain as Ki divided by the sample frequency.

nodes.name: PID_SetKd_Fixed32
nodes.summary: Stores Kd in Q17.15 in the configuration; no runtime derivative form is derived yet.

nodes.name: PID_SetKp_Fixed16
nodes.summary: Sets Kp from a 16-bit Q8.8 value by shifting it up to Q17.15.

nodes.name: PID_SetKi_Fixed16
nodes.summary: Sets Ki from a 16-bit Q8.8 value by shifting it up to Q17.15.

nodes.name: PID_SetKd_Fixed16
nodes.summary: Sets Kd from a 16-bit Q8.8 value by shifting it up to Q17.15.

nodes.name: PID.h
nodes.summary: Declares the PID controller types (PID_Config_T tuning storage, PID_T runtime state with fract16e gains) and inline accessors for output, integral, saturation status and bounded gain get/set in Q17.15 and Q8.8 forms. Prototypes the processing and configuration functions in PID.c.

nodes.name: Ramp.c
nodes.summary: Ramp (slew-rate limiter) processing and configuration: steps the output toward a stored or supplied target by at most the slope per tick, with the limits applied to the target. Sets the slope from ticks, milliseconds, a per-second rate, or an interpolation interval to a final value.

nodes.name: _Ramp_ProcNextOf
nodes.summary: Steps the output toward the given target by at most the slope, without applying the ramp limits to the target.

nodes.name: Ramp_ProcNextOf
nodes.summary: Steps the output toward a supplied target clamped to the ramp limits, using the stored slope.

nodes.name: Ramp_ProcNext
nodes.summary: Steps the output toward the stored target, clamped to the limits on every step.

nodes.name: Ramp_Init_Slope
nodes.summary: Initialises the ramp with a slope coefficient, full int16 limits, and zero output and target.

nodes.name: Ramp_Init
nodes.summary: Initialises the ramp from a duration in ticks over a range, with symmetric limits of plus and minus the range and zero state.

nodes.name: Ramp_SetCoefficient
nodes.summary: Sets the slope coefficient directly in accumulator scale (step per tick, shifted 15).

nodes.name: Ramp_SetSlope_Ticks
nodes.summary: Sets the slope so the given range is covered in the given number of ticks; zero ticks becomes a one-tick step.

nodes.name: Ramp_SetSlope_Millis
nodes.summary: Sets the slope from a duration in milliseconds at the given update frequency.

nodes.name: Ramp_SetSlope_PerSecond
nodes.summary: Sets the slope from a rate in output units per second at the given update frequency.

nodes.name: Ramp_SetInterpolate
nodes.summary: Sets the slope so the output reaches a final value from its current value in the given number of ticks.

nodes.name: Ramp_SetInterpolate_Millis
nodes.summary: Sets the slope so the output reaches a final value from its current value in the given number of milliseconds.

nodes.name: Ramp.h
nodes.summary: Defines Ramp_T, a setpoint object combining a shifted Accumulator (output, slope coefficient, limits) with a stored target, plus compile-time slope/tick conversion and initialiser macros. Inline accessors read the output and target and apply three limit policies: input only, input with target clamp, or immediate output clamp.

nodes.name: Ramp_SetLimits
nodes.summary: Sets the limits applied to the target on each step; the stored target is kept and the output is not clamped, so an out-of-bounds output ramps back in.

nodes.name: Ramp_SetInputLimits
nodes.summary: Sets the limits and also clamps the stored target into them.

nodes.name: Ramp_SetOutputLimits
nodes.summary: Sets the limits and immediately re-clamps the current output into them.

nodes.name: Ramp_Setpoint.h
nodes.summary: Sketch of a combined ramp-plus-PID setpoint helper sharing one limit surface. It includes Ramp.h and PID.h, and all of its functions are currently commented out.

nodes.name: edge_fn.h
nodes.summary: Stateless edge detection helpers: rising, falling and any edge on boolean states and bitfields, zero-crossing edges on signed values, threshold crossings, and Schmitt-trigger style transitions with separate on and off thresholds.

nodes.name: math_general.h
nodes.summary: Base integer math helpers shared across the library: abs, min, max, clamp, range and wrap-window tests, sign_t and the sign functions. Also defines interval_t with constructors (symmetric, sign-keyed, from bounds) and clamp, containment, intersection, hull and offset operations.

nodes.name: interval_of_sign
nodes.summary: Builds an asymmetric interval keyed by sign: the aligned magnitude on the side of the sign and the opposed magnitude on the other, or a zero interval for sign zero.

nodes.name: FOC.c
nodes.summary: Translation unit for the FOC module that currently holds no definitions of its own; it only includes FOC.h.

nodes.name: Accumulator_T
nodes.summary: Discrete-time integrator with output saturation: the accumulated output, the gain coefficient and the upper and lower saturation bounds, all in the internal shifted scale.

nodes.name: Angle_T
nodes.summary: Angle tracker state in 32-bit shifted form: the angle accumulator (angle16 shifted 16, wrapping by overflow), the per-cycle delta, and an upper and lower limit. One struct serves the wrap, clamp and direct-set integration modes.

nodes.name: AnglePll_FilterTuning_T
nodes.summary: Lock tuning of the angle tracking loop: the magnitude floor at or below which the angle is indeterminate, the minimum magnitude and error tolerance for lock, and the consecutive-tick counts to acquire the lock and to hold it through loss.

nodes.name: AnglePll_T
nodes.summary: Angle tracking loop state: an Angle_T integrator holding the estimated angle and speed, the PI loop filter, the last phase error, the lock tuning, the last vector magnitude and the lock and loss counters.

nodes.name: Angle_SpeedPuRef_T
nodes.summary: Unit reference between per-unit speed and angle per control tick: the angle delta at 1.0 pu speed and its precomputed inverse, so each direction of the conversion is a single multiply.

nodes.name: MovAvg_T
nodes.summary: Moving average filter state: the coefficient (a fract16 lambda or a sample count N), the output and a sample index used by the running mean.

nodes.name: PID_Config_T
nodes.summary: PID tuning coefficients as stored: the PI or PID mode, the sample frequency, and Kp, Ki and Kd as Q17.15 values.

nodes.name: PID_T
nodes.summary: PID controller state: the integral accumulator, the previous error, the output with its minimum and maximum, the run-time Kp and per-tick Ki derived from the config as mantissa and shift values, and the config held for storage update.

nodes.name: Ramp_T
nodes.summary: Setpoint ramp: an Accumulator_T supplying the output, the slope coefficient and the limits, plus the target the output steps toward.

nodes.name: FOC.h
nodes.summary: Stateful FOC core: the FOC_T object holding the dq, alpha-beta and abc vectors, the Id/Iq PI pair, the voltage limit policy, decoupling feedforward and the field-weakening integrator, wrapped around the pure functions of foc_math.h.
nodes.languageNotes: Header-only module of static inline functions. Build variants are selected by macros (FOC_DECOUPLE_ENABLE, FOC_I_SAMPLE_DELAY, FIXED_LONG_MULTIPLY_SOFT), and alignas(4) pairs the fract16 fields for 32-bit access.

nodes.name: FOC_SetTheta
nodes.summary: Stores the sine and cosine of the electrical angle for the Park and inverse Park transforms.

nodes.name: FOC_ProcClarkePark
nodes.summary: Transforms three phase currents to alpha-beta and then to Id/Iq at the held angle, storing both frames.

nodes.name: FOC_ProcInvClarkePark
nodes.summary: Transforms Vd/Vq back through inverse Park and inverse Clarke, saturating and storing the alpha-beta and abc output voltages.

nodes.name: FOC_ProcVBemfClarkePark
nodes.summary: Transforms measured terminal voltages into Valpha/Vbeta and Vd/Vq at the held angle, capturing the back-EMF during freewheel.

nodes.name: FOC_ProcVControl
nodes.summary: Direct voltage control: clamps the Vq request to the V limit policy, applies the voltage-circle limit and reports whether the request was limited.

nodes.name: FOC_ProcIFeedback_Base
nodes.summary: Runs the Id then Iq PI controllers limit-first: Vd is bounded by the voltage circle, and the remaining Vq budget intersected with the V policy sets the Iq PI output limits.

nodes.name: FOC_CaptureSpeed
nodes.summary: Caches omega*Ld, omega*Lq and omega*psi from the electrical angle step for feedforward and decoupling, plus the optional Park offset for the current sample delay.

nodes.name: FOC_ProcIFeedback_Decouple
nodes.summary: Current loop with cross-coupling feedforward: offsets each PI output limit by its feedforward term so the summed Vd and Vq stay inside the voltage circle and the V policy band.

nodes.name: FOC_ProcIFeedback
nodes.summary: Primary current-loop entry that dispatches to the decoupled or base PI implementation according to FOC_DECOUPLE_ENABLE.

nodes.name: FOC_MatchIVState
nodes.summary: Seeds the Id/Iq PI integrators so the next current-loop step reproduces the present Vd/Vq, for a bumpless transfer into closed loop.

nodes.name: FOC_ClearOutputState
nodes.summary: Zeros the dq, abc and alpha-beta output voltage state.

nodes.name: FOC_ResetFeedbackState
nodes.summary: Resets both current PI controllers, the field-weakening integrator and the cached electrical-speed terms.

nodes.name: FOC_CaptureI
nodes.summary: Sets the electrical angle and transforms the sampled phase currents into the dq frame in one step.

nodes.name: FOC_ProcIControl
nodes.summary: Runs the current feedback loop and then the inverse transforms to produce the phase voltage outputs.

nodes.name: FOC_SetVLimits
nodes.summary: Sets the half-plane Vq limit for a direction (anti-plugging) and the matching PI output limits.

nodes.name: FOC_ProcIdFieldWeakening
nodes.summary: Advances the voltage-feedback field-weakening integrator against a margin below the voltage circle and returns the demagnetizing Id request.

nodes.name: FOC_InitElectrical
nodes.summary: Stores the per-unit electrical model view and derives the shift used for the omega*L products.

nodes.name: FOC_Var_Get
nodes.summary: Variable-id read interface returning real-time FOC state such as Id, Iq, Vd, Vq, the phase voltages and the PI integrals.

nodes.name: FOC_T
nodes.summary: Per-motor FOC runtime state: held sine/cosine, dq currents and voltages, alpha-beta and abc images, the Id/Iq PI pair, the V limit policy, the electrical model view, cached speed terms and field-weakening state.

nodes.name: FOC_Ext.h
nodes.summary: Collaborator-style extensions bridging FOC_T to the phase data types: consume flagged Iabc and back-EMF sample sets into the dq frame, and return the abc voltage output as a phase triplet.

nodes.name: FOC_CaptureIData
nodes.summary: Consumes a complete flagged Iabc sample set into Id/Iq, clears the capture flag and reports whether new data was processed.

nodes.name: FOC_CaptureVBemfData
nodes.summary: Consumes a complete flagged back-EMF voltage sample set into the dq frame and clears its flag.

nodes.name: FOC_GetVOut
nodes.summary: Computes the abc output voltages from Vd/Vq at the held angle and returns them as a saturated phase triplet.

nodes.name: _dq0.h
nodes.summary: Reference implementation of the direct abc-to-dq0 transform and its inverse in fract16 fixed point, kept as the known textbook form of which the Clarke/Park pair is the lower-cost factorization.

nodes.name: _foc_dq0_transform
nodes.summary: Direct abc-to-dq0 matrix multiplication with caller-supplied sin/cos at the 0, 120 and 240 degree offsets.

nodes.name: foc_dq0_transform
nodes.summary: Direct abc-to-dq0 transform from the rotor angle sin/cos, deriving the 120-degree shifted terms internally.

nodes.name: foc_inv_dq0_transform
nodes.summary: Inverse dq0-to-abc transform from the rotor angle sin/cos.

nodes.name: foc_dq0
nodes.summary: Result triple (d, q, zero) of the direct dq0 transform in 32-bit unsaturated form.

nodes.name: _svpwm_sector.h
nodes.summary: Sector-based space-vector modulation: determines the hexagon sector from alpha/beta and computes midclamp duty cycles from its two basic vectors, equivalent to svpwm_midclamp of the same phase voltages.
nodes.languageNotes: Returns struct svpwm_abc without including svpwm_math.h, so it relies on that header being included first.

nodes.name: svpwm_midclamp_sector
nodes.summary: Computes midclamp SVPWM duties by selecting the hexagon sector from alpha/beta and timing its two basic vectors with the null time split equally.

nodes.name: foc_math.h
nodes.summary: Pure fixed-point FOC math: Clarke/Park transforms and inverses, decoupling feedforward, voltage-circle limiting, dq power balance, supply-current to q-axis current limits and v_q band policies.
nodes.languageNotes: Stages pass 32-bit structs by value and return unsaturated results; the sink saturates once, and inlining removes the struct copies.

nodes.name: foc_clarke
nodes.summary: Clarke transform of three phase quantities to the alpha-beta stationary frame.

nodes.name: foc_inv_clarke
nodes.summary: Inverse Clarke transform from alpha-beta to three phase quantities.

nodes.name: foc_park
nodes.summary: Park transform rotating alpha-beta into the rotor dq frame using the sin/cos of the electrical angle.

nodes.name: foc_inv_park
nodes.summary: Inverse Park transform rotating dq back to the alpha-beta frame.

nodes.name: foc_clarke_park
nodes.summary: Combined Clarke then Park transform from abc to dq.

nodes.name: foc_inv_clarke_park
nodes.summary: Combined inverse Park then inverse Clarke transform from dq to abc.

nodes.name: foc_circle_limit
nodes.summary: Limits a dq vector to a magnitude circle with d-axis priority, reducing q to the remaining budget and taking a square root only when the limit is exceeded.

nodes.name: foc_circle_limit_ff
nodes.summary: Saturates widened d and q inputs to fract16 and applies the d-priority circle limit.

nodes.name: foc_q_circle_limit
nodes.summary: Returns the q-axis magnitude left inside the circle after d has claimed its share, saturating to zero.

nodes.name: foc_iq_limits
nodes.summary: Converts a DC supply current window into signed Iq limits by power balance at the operating point (Vdc, d-axis power, Vq).

nodes.name: foc_iq_phase_limits
nodes.summary: Conservative Iq limits from the supply window, keyed by motion direction: the phase-current bound left after Id takes its share of the circle.

nodes.name: foc_vq_band
nodes.summary: Builds the allowed Vq band as the q circle intersected with the policy limit, with the back-EMF window clamped into it.

nodes.name: foc_abc
nodes.summary: Three-phase quantity triple (a, b, c) in 32-bit unsaturated form, passed between transform stages.

nodes.name: foc_dq
nodes.summary: Rotor-frame pair (d, q) in 32-bit unsaturated form, passed between transform stages.

nodes.name: foc_alphabeta
nodes.summary: Stationary-frame pair (alpha, beta) in 32-bit unsaturated form, passed between transform stages.

nodes.name: foc_sensorless_math.h
nodes.summary: Stateless sensorless-FOC primitives: a first-order low-pass step, the map from estimated EMF to the rotor vector, and the sliding-mode innovation, saturation and correction laws composed by the EMF observer.

nodes.name: lpf_step
nodes.summary: First-order discrete low-pass step y += k*(x - y), used to extract and smooth the estimated EMF.

nodes.name: foc_rotor_of_emf
nodes.summary: Maps an EMF vector to the rotor flux vector by a quarter-turn rotation whose side is chosen by the rotation direction sign.

nodes.name: smo_sigma
nodes.summary: Saturated sliding-mode innovation: the estimated current minus the measured current.

nodes.name: smo_z
nodes.summary: First-order sliding-mode correction z = K*sat(sigma/thr), with a linear boundary layer to suppress chatter.

nodes.name: motor_electrical_math.h
nodes.summary: Pure math for PMSM electrical parameters (Rs, Ld/Lq, flux linkage, Kv/Ke): identification formulas from raw measurements, SI unit conversions and per-unit encodings at the turn, rad and speed bases.

nodes.name: mech_rpm_of_el_angle_freq
nodes.summary: Converts an electrical angle frequency to mechanical rpm using the pole-pair count.

nodes.name: rs_pu_of_vi
nodes.summary: Per-unit stator resistance from per-unit d-axis voltage and current.

nodes.name: psi_pu_of_wb
nodes.summary: Encodes a flux linkage in webers as per-unit against the voltage and angular-frequency bases.

nodes.name: angle_freq_of_kv
nodes.summary: Converts a Kv rating in rpm per volt to electrical angle frequency per volt using the pole pairs.

nodes.name: psi_pu_of_running
nodes.summary: Per-unit flux linkage from the q-axis steady-state voltage equation while running: Vq less the resistive and inductive terms, over speed.

nodes.name: psi_uwb_of_running
nodes.summary: Flux linkage in microwebers from SI running measurements of Vq, Id, Iq, Rs, Ld and electrical speed.

nodes.name: l_pu_of_h
nodes.summary: Encodes an inductance in henries as per-unit against the V, I and angular-frequency bases.

nodes.name: l_pu_turn_of_rs_tau_cycles
nodes.summary: Turn-base per-unit inductance from the resistance and a measured current-rise time constant in control cycles (L = R*tau).

nodes.name: l_pu_turn_of_hfi
nodes.summary: Turn-base per-unit inductance from high-frequency injection voltage and current amplitudes.

nodes.name: g_l_pu_turn
nodes.summary: Reciprocal inductance at the rad base, the current-model gain 1/L, from a turn-base per-unit inductance.

nodes.name: smo_math.h
nodes.summary: Header reserved for the sliding-mode correction laws (innovation sigma to correction z). It currently holds only the description and the fract16 include; the laws themselves are in foc_sensorless_math.h.

nodes.name: stator_math.h
nodes.summary: Stator voltage equation of one axis across one control period (v = R*i + L*di/dt + e), solved for the drive voltage, the back-EMF and the next current, plus axis power and reactance.

nodes.name: stator_v
nodes.summary: Drive form of the stator equation: the voltage held across a period that moves the current from i_prev to i against the EMF.

nodes.name: stator_emf
nodes.summary: Voltage-model back-EMF over one period: the applied voltage less the resistive and inductive drops.

nodes.name: stator_i_next
nodes.summary: Current-model step: the next current from the present current, applied voltage and EMF, using R and 1/L.

nodes.name: stator_reactance
nodes.summary: Reactance X = omega*L from the inductance and the electrical angle step per period.

nodes.name: svpwm_math.h
nodes.summary: Pure SVPWM math: bus-voltage normalization, zero-sequence placement (midclamp, general clamp, midclamp with a duty ceiling) and the modulation radius that leaves a low-side current-sense window.
nodes.languageNotes: Each radius function has a macro twin so the same value is available as a constant expression for configuration and static_assert.

nodes.name: svpwm_norm_vbus_inv
nodes.summary: Normalizes a per-unit phase voltage to the bus voltage by multiplying with the precomputed inverse bus voltage.

nodes.name: svpwm_midclamp
nodes.summary: Midclamp SVPWM: shifts the three normalized phase voltages by the midpoint of their extremes so the null time is shared equally, returning duties centered at 50%.

nodes.name: svpwm_clamp
nodes.summary: General zero-sequence clamp placing a share k of the null time at the all-high vector, covering the bottom clamp, midclamp and the top clamp.

nodes.name: svpwm_midclamp_ceiling
nodes.summary: Midclamp that moves the zero sequence toward the bottom clamp once the highest duty would pass a ceiling, keeping a low-side current-sense window.

nodes.name: svpwm_midclamp_ceiling_radius
nodes.summary: Largest modulation radius at which the ceiling-limited midclamp keeps its highest duty at or under a given peak.

nodes.name: svpwm_midclamp_transform
nodes.summary: Midclamp zero-sequence shift without the 50% duty offset, returning signed phase values.

nodes.name: svpwm_abc
nodes.summary: Unsigned duty-cycle triple (a, b, c) returned by the SVPWM functions.

nodes.name: _svpwm_abc
nodes.summary: Signed 32-bit phase triple returned by the offset-free midclamp transform.

nodes.name: EmfObserver.h
nodes.summary: Sensorless rotor-angle observer: steps a stator model with sliding-mode or voltage-model EMF estimation, in the stationary or the estimated dq frame, and feeds the rotor vector of the EMF into a shared angle PLL.

nodes.name: _EmfObserver_ProcSmoNext
nodes.summary: One SMO axis, correction first: computes z against the new sample, filters it into the EMF estimate, then integrates the model across the next period with the command just made.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_AlphaBeta_Proc
nodes.summary: Stationary-frame SMO step run after the FOC loop: updates both axes and feeds the rotor vector of the estimated EMF to the PLL.

nodes.name: _EmfObserver_ProcSmo
nodes.summary: One SMO axis, model first: integrates across the period the sample closes using the previous z, then computes the new z and the filtered EMF.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_AlphaBeta_ProcHeld
nodes.summary: Stationary-frame SMO step run before the FOC loop, using the voltage held across the period the sample closes.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_VModel_Proc
nodes.summary: Voltage-model front end in the estimated dq frame: computes and low-pass filters the dq EMF, then corrects the PLL with the relative rotor vector.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_Eemf_Proc
nodes.summary: Extended-EMF SMO in the estimated dq frame: removes the frame-rotation coupling from each axis voltage, runs a scalar SMO per axis, corrects the PLL and returns the estimated angle.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_Eemf_ProcHeld
nodes.summary: Runs the EEMF SMO on the alpha-beta command the observer holds, parked at the mean angle of the period it spanned.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_Reset
nodes.summary: Clears the per-tick axis state, the PLL and the held voltage while keeping the config and the winding.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_Init
nodes.summary: Copies the tuning config, initializes the PLL loop filter and lock tuning, and resets the observer state.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_GetVar
nodes.summary: Variable-id read interface returning observer runtime values such as the estimated angle and speed.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_Config_Get
nodes.summary: Variable-id read interface returning the observer tuning config fields.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_Config_T
nodes.summary: Observer tuning: sliding gain, boundary-layer width, EMF low-pass coefficient, PLL filter tuning and the loop-filter PI config.

nodes.name: EmfObserver_T
nodes.summary: Observer state: the winding model, the alpha/beta and d/q SMO axes, the angle PLL, the held output voltage and the tuning config.

nodes.name: Motor_Limits.h
nodes.summary: Current-limit envelope type with motoring/generating and forward/reverse magnitudes, with helpers to take the minimum, derate by ratio and resolve the envelope to a signed interval.

nodes.name: Motor_ILimit_Min
nodes.summary: Element-wise minimum of two current-limit envelopes, the fan-in of several limit sources.

nodes.name: Motor_ILimit_Derate
nodes.summary: Scales the motoring and generating magnitudes of a base envelope by ratios, leaving the directional limits unchanged.

nodes.name: Motor_ILimit_Resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves the envelope to a signed [Cw:Ccw] interval by intersecting motoring/generating along the motoring sign with forward/reverse along the forward sign.

nodes.name: Motor_ILimit_T
nodes.summary: Current-limit envelope of four per-unit magnitudes: motoring, generating, forward and reverse.

nodes.name: Motor_Types.h
