nodes.summary: Shared motor data types: the V/I/frequency unit basis with per-unit conversions for volts, amps, rpm, resistance, flux and inductance, and the four-quadrant operating-state identifier.

nodes.name: Motor_QuadrantId
nodes.summary: Encodes the operating quadrant from the motion, torque and Vq signs as a signed id distinguishing motoring, regeneration and plugging.

nodes.name: Motor_UnitBasis_T
nodes.summary: Unit basis defining what 1.0 pu means for voltage, current and electrical frequency, from which the R, psi, L and power bases derive.

nodes.name: Stator.h
nodes.summary: Per-axis image of the stator across one control period (I, previous I, held V) and the winding parameters (R, L, 1/L), with operations applying the stator equation to capture a period, estimate the EMF or integrate the current model.

nodes.name: Stator_Winding_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the winding from the model at the turn base, deriving L at the rad base and the reciprocal gain G.

nodes.name: Stator_Axis_Emf
nodes.summary: Back-EMF of the axis over the captured period, from the voltage model.

nodes.name: Stator_Axis_Capture
nodes.summary: Closes a control period on the axis record: shifts the current sample to previous and stores the new sample and the voltage held across it.

nodes.name: Stator_Axis_Integrate
nodes.summary: Advances the axis by the current model in place of a sample, computing the next current from the applied voltage and a stand-in for the EMF.

nodes.name: Stator_Axis_T
nodes.summary: One stator axis across one control period: the current at both ends and the voltage held across it.

nodes.name: Stator_Winding_T
nodes.summary: Phase winding parameters in per-unit: resistance, inductance at the rad base and its reciprocal.

nodes.name: Motor_Clock.h
nodes.summary: Compile-time timing references for the motor module: the control (PWM), current-loop and speed-loop frequencies, and macros converting between milliseconds and cycles of each loop.

nodes.name: Motor_Electrical.h
nodes.summary: Canonical motor electrical model stored as base-independent rates (1/psi, 1/Ld, 1/Lq, Rs, pole pairs), with accessors for the per-unit turn-base views, Kv, the speed base and the field-weakening limits.

nodes.name: Motor_Electrical_IsValid
nodes.summary: Checks that the pole pairs and the stored reciprocal rates are nonzero, so the conversions that divide by them are safe.

nodes.name: Motor_SetLd_PuTurn
nodes.summary: Stores Ld from a turn-base per-unit value by converting it to the base-independent angle-frequency-per-ohm rate.

nodes.name: Motor_SetLq_PuTurn
nodes.summary: Stores Lq from a turn-base per-unit value by converting it to the base-independent angle-frequency-per-ohm rate.

nodes.name: Motor_SpeedBase_AngleFreq
nodes.summary: Speed base as an electrical angle frequency: the back-EMF speed at the board maximum phase voltage.

nodes.name: Motor_Electrical_T
nodes.summary: Canonical stored motor model: pole pairs, the reciprocal flux and inductance rates and the stator resistance, independent of Fs and the board bases.

nodes.name: Phase_Polar.c
nodes.summary: Two-phase (six-step) PWM output for the inverter: unipolar and bipolar duty writes and gate activation per commutation step, including the PWM polarity inversion bipolar drive needs.

nodes.name: Phase_Polar_OutputV0
nodes.summary: Floats the outputs, clears the PWM polarity inversion on all three channels, then enables all phases at zero duty.

nodes.name: Phase_Unipolar_ActivateOutput
nodes.summary: Enables the gate outputs of the given six-step commutation phase pair.

nodes.name: Phase_Unipolar1_WriteDuty
nodes.summary: Unipolar-1 duty write per commutation step: PWM on the driven phase, zero duty holding the return phase low.

nodes.name: Phase_Unipolar2_ActivateOutput
nodes.summary: Enables the gate outputs of a commutation step in unipolar-2 mode.

nodes.name: Phase_Unipolar2_WriteDuty
nodes.summary: Unipolar-2 duty write per commutation step: duties offset above and below the 50% midpoint on the two active phases.

nodes.name: _Phase_Bipolar_InvertPolarity
nodes.summary: Selects which PWM channel takes inverted polarity for a commutation step and syncs the invert registers.

nodes.name: Phase_Bipolar_ActivateOutput
nodes.summary: Floats the outputs, sets the polarity inversion of the step, then enables its gates for bipolar drive.

nodes.name: Phase_Bipolar_WriteDuty
nodes.summary: Bipolar duty write per commutation step: the same mid-offset duty on both active phases, one of them with inverted polarity.

nodes.name: Phase_Polar.h
nodes.summary: Declares the six-step commutation phase identifiers, the polar PWM modes and the unipolar/bipolar activate and write-duty API built on Phase_VOut.

nodes.name: Phase_Svpwm.h
nodes.summary: Bridges FOC phase voltages to PWM duties: normalizes by the inverse bus voltage and applies the build-selected zero-sequence placement (midclamp, midclamp ceiling or fixed clamp) before writing the three duties.
nodes.languageNotes: The clamp variant is chosen at compile time by PHASE_SVPWM_MIDCLAMP, PHASE_SVPWM_MIDCLAMP_CEILING or PHASE_SVPWM_CLAMP.

nodes.name: Phase_SvpwmVOut
nodes.summary: Computes SVPWM duties from the phase voltages and the inverse bus voltage with the build-selected clamp, returning them as flagged phase data.

nodes.name: Phase_WriteSvpwm
nodes.summary: Computes SVPWM duties with the build-selected clamp and writes them to the three PWM channels.

nodes.name: Phase_VOut.c
nodes.summary: Three-phase voltage output actuator: writes PWM duties, switches the gate outputs between high-Z, V0 and PWM, and provides single-vector align and jog helpers plus PWM and pin initialization.

nodes.name: Phase_WriteDuty
nodes.summary: Writes the three PWM duties and triggers a synchronized duty update.

nodes.name: Phase_Deactivate
nodes.summary: Disables all three gate outputs, floating the phases (high-Z).

nodes.name: Phase_ActivateOutput
nodes.summary: Enables all three gate outputs with the duties already stored.

nodes.name: Phase_ActivateV0
nodes.summary: Writes zero duty on all phases and enables the outputs, holding the motor terminals at the low side.

nodes.name: Phase_ActivateT0
nodes.summary: Writes 50% duty on all phases and enables the outputs, the zero-voltage SVPWM state.

nodes.name: Phase_ActivateVOut
nodes.summary: Switches the output to high-Z, V0 or PWM according to the requested mode.

nodes.name: Phase_ReadVOut
nodes.summary: Reads the collective output state back from the gate and duty registers as high-Z, V0 or PWM.

nodes.name: _Phase_Align
nodes.summary: Writes a duty to the phases selected by a bitmask and zero to the rest.

nodes.name: Phase_Align
nodes.summary: Applies an align vector by writing the duty to the phases of the given phase id.

nodes.name: Phase_Align_VRatio
nodes.summary: Aligns with a voltage given as a ratio of half the bus voltage.

nodes.name: Phase_Align_V
nodes.summary: Aligns with a per-unit voltage resolved against the live inverse bus voltage.

nodes.name: Phase_ReadAlign
nodes.summary: Reads the align vector currently applied, from which duties are nonzero.

nodes.name: Phase_ReadAlignNext
nodes.summary: Returns the align vector that follows the current one in sequence.

nodes.name: Phase_ReadAlignPrev
nodes.summary: Returns the align vector that precedes the current one in sequence.

nodes.name: Phase_JogNext
nodes.summary: Steps the align vector forward one position at the given duty and returns the new phase id.

nodes.name: Phase_JogPrev
nodes.summary: Steps the align vector backward one position at the given duty and returns the new phase id.

nodes.name: Phase_JogSigned
nodes.summary: Jogs forward or backward by the sign of the duty, or returns the current vector when it is zero.

nodes.name: Phase_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the PWM module, the three PWM channels and the three gate output pins.

nodes.name: Phase_VOut.h
nodes.summary: Defines the Phase_VOut_T inverter actuator (PWM module, three PWM channels, three gate pins) with inline per-phase enable, synchronized duty and gate writes, output-state queries and thread-context duty updates.
nodes.languageNotes: The actuator is a const struct of peripheral descriptors built by the PHASE_INIT macro; PHASE_PIN_SYNC and PHASE_SYNC_INVERT_UPDATE select single-write register paths.

nodes.name: _Phase_SyncPwmDuty
nodes.summary: Triggers the software-synchronized duty load of the PWM module for the selected phases.

nodes.name: _Phase_SyncPwmInvert
nodes.summary: Triggers a synchronized polarity-invert update when PHASE_SYNC_INVERT_UPDATE is enabled.

nodes.name: _Phase_WriteGates
nodes.summary: Writes the on/off state of the three gate outputs for a phase id: one synchronized pin write when the pins share a module, otherwise one write per phase.

nodes.name: _Phase_ReadGates
nodes.summary: Reads the on/off state of the three gate outputs as a bitmask.

nodes.name: _Phase_ReadDutyAlign
nodes.summary: Reads which phases carry a nonzero duty as a bitmask, the voltage output state.

nodes.name: Phase_WriteData
nodes.summary: Writes a flagged phase-data duty set to the PWM channels and syncs, skipping when no data is flagged.

nodes.name: Phase_WriteDuty_Thread
nodes.summary: Thread-context duty write that updates only the phases already carrying duty while the outputs are active, preserving V0.

nodes.name: Phase_Polar_WriteDuty_Thread
nodes.summary: Thread-context duty write for the polar modes that updates only the phases whose gates are enabled.

nodes.name: Phase_VOut_T
nodes.summary: Constant inverter actuator descriptor: the PWM module, three PWM channels and three gate-enable pins.

nodes.name: Phase_Board.h
nodes.summary: Board-level phase sensing constants shared by all motors (V and I sensor maxima, rated values), with accessors and conversions between physical units and the per-unit base.
nodes.languageNotes: PHASE_BOARD is an extern const with volatile fields, so the values can be compile-time defined yet overwritten at run time.

nodes.name: Phase_IMaxAmps
nodes.summary: Returns the board current sensor maximum in amps, the I base of the per-unit scale.

nodes.name: Phase_VMaxVolts
nodes.summary: Returns the board voltage sensor maximum in volts, the V base of the per-unit scale.

nodes.name: Phase_Board_IsValid
nodes.summary: Validates that the board sensor maxima and rated per-unit values are set and within range.

nodes.name: Phase_R_PuOfMilliOhms
nodes.summary: Converts a resistance in milliohms to per-unit on the board V/I base.

nodes.name: Phase_L_PuTurnOfMicroHenries
nodes.summary: Converts an inductance in microhenries to turn-base per-unit for a given sampling frequency.

nodes.name: Phase_Board_T
nodes.summary: Constant board record of the sensor maxima and the rated voltage and current, defined by the application and shared by all motor instances.

nodes.name: Hall_Sensor.c
nodes.summary: Stub translation unit for the Hall sensor RotorSensor implementation: it contains only the file description and an Angle.h include, with no definitions.

nodes.name: SinCos_Sensor.c
nodes.summary: RotorSensor implementation for a sin/cos analog resolver: reads the ADC pair each tick into an electrical angle and delta, filters speed at 1 ms, and exposes the operations through SIN_COS_VTABLE.
nodes.languageNotes: Polymorphism by a const table of function pointers (RotorSensor_VTable_T); the static functions are reachable only through it.

nodes.name: SinCos_RotorSensor_CaptureAngle
nodes.summary: Polling-rate capture: reads the sin/cos ADC pair, resolves the electrical angle and stores the angle, its wrapped delta and the mechanical angle in the rotor sensor state.

nodes.name: SinCos_RotorSensor_CaptureSpeed
nodes.summary: 1 ms speed update projecting the angle delta to per-unit speed through a two-sample average.

nodes.name: SinCos_RotorSensor_ZeroInitial
nodes.summary: Captures the present angle as the starting point and clears the delta and speed.

nodes.name: Motor_CalibrationElectrical.c
nodes.summary: Calibration sub-state that self-identifies Rs, Ld and Lq at standstill through a staged sequence (align, DC resistance average, Vd step time constant, HFI on Vq, commit, ramp down) and writes the results to the motor config.

nodes.name: ProcRs
nodes.summary: Averages Vd and Id over the measurement window, computes Rs in per-unit and milliohms, and prepares the bias and threshold for the Ld step.

nodes.name: ProcLd
nodes.summary: Times the Id rise to 63% after a Vd step and derives Ld from Rs and the time constant, in per-unit and microhenries.

nodes.name: ProcLq
nodes.summary: Synchronously demodulates Iq against the injected HFI phase and derives Lq from the injection voltage and the current amplitude.

nodes.name: CommitResults
nodes.summary: Writes the identified Ld, Lq and Rs to the motor electrical config and advances to the ramp-down stage.

nodes.name: Electrical_Entry
nodes.summary: Sub-state entry: sets the V0 output, clears the FOC feedback state, zeroes the scratch buffer and captures the unit base, align current and injection amplitudes.

nodes.name: Electrical_Proc
nodes.summary: Per-control-cycle stage dispatcher that drives the FOC output of the current stage and runs its measurement step.

nodes.name: Motor_Calibration_StartElectrical
nodes.summary: Requests a state-machine transition into the electrical calibration sub-state when the feature is enabled.

nodes.name: ElectricalCalibration_T
nodes.summary: Scratch state of the parameter identification, held in the motor calibration buffer: stage, counters, accumulators, step and HFI settings and the results.

nodes.name: VBus_FOC.h
nodes.summary: Couples the DC bus state to the dq frame: converts the supply charge and discharge current limits into q-axis current limits by power balance, phase-current bound or voltage derating, and derives the bus current from dq power.
nodes.languageNotes: The enforcement form is a build option (VBUS_I_LIMIT_POWER_BALANCE, _PHASE_BOUND or _V_DERATE); each form takes different inputs and the caller selects.

nodes.name: VBus_FOC_IBusOf
nodes.summary: DC bus current from dq power, using the live inverse bus voltage.

nodes.name: VBus_FOC_IqLimits
nodes.summary: Signed Iq limits from the supply charge/discharge window by exact power balance at the operating point.

nodes.name: VBus_FOC_IqPhaseLimits
nodes.summary: Conservative Iq limits from the supply window as a phase-current bound keyed by the motion direction.

nodes.name: VBus_FOC_IqDerateLimits
nodes.summary: Iq limits formed by scaling a motor draw and return current limits with the under-voltage and over-voltage derate ramps.

nodes.name: Timer.h
nodes.summary: Main header of the software Timer module: defines the time base (Timer_Base_T), the mode enum and Timer_State_T, then pulls in the three API layers - the _TimerT.h template core, Timer_General.h self-contained runtime objects, and TimerT.h const-context handles.
nodes.languageNotes: C static polymorphism: all behaviour is static inline functions parameterised by a const time-base pointer, so the compiler folds register addresses and frequencies at each call site instead of dispatching at runtime.

nodes.name: TimerT.h
nodes.summary: Layer 3 of the Timer module: TimerT_T pairs a compile-time-constant time base with a pointer to RAM state, and one-line inline wrappers forward to the _TimerT core for periodic, counter, one-shot, count-N and modal polling.

nodes.name: TimerT_Modal_Poll
nodes.summary: Polls a TimerT handle through the mode-enum dispatcher and returns true when the period elapses.

nodes.name: TimerT_Init
nodes.summary: Resets the handle's state to the stopped mode.

nodes.name: TimerT_Stop
nodes.summary: Stops the timer unless it is disabled.

nodes.name: TimerT_SetPeriod
nodes.summary: Changes the period in ticks without moving the reference time.

nodes.name: TimerT_StartPeriodic
nodes.summary: Starts the timer in periodic mode with the given period.

nodes.name: TimerT_StartOneShot
nodes.summary: Starts a single-shot timeout of the given period.

nodes.name: TimerT_StartCounterN
nodes.summary: Starts a count-down timer that fires a given number of times before stopping.

nodes.name: Timer_General.h
nodes.summary: Layer 2 of the Timer module: a self-contained Timer_T that keeps its time base and state together in RAM, with a general-purpose API (poll, start, stop, elapsed time, frequency and millisecond setters) forwarding to the _TimerT core.

nodes.name: Timer_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Copies a time base into the RAM Timer_T and resets its state to stopped.

nodes.name: Timer_Restart
nodes.summary: Sets the timer's reference time to now.

nodes.name: Timer_Poll
nodes.summary: Polls a self-contained Timer_T with the mode-free period/counter logic.

nodes.name: Timer_SetFreq
nodes.summary: Sets the period from a frequency in Hz using the base frequency.

nodes.name: _TimerT.h
nodes.summary: Template core of the Timer module: inline functions over (Timer_Base_T, Timer_State_T) implementing elapsed-time polling, the specialised periodic, counter, count-N and one-shot modes, the mode-free and modal poll dispatchers, start/stop, and tick-to-time unit conversions.

nodes.name: _TimerT_PollElapsed
nodes.summary: Core poll: if the period has elapsed since the reference time, moves the reference to now and returns true.

nodes.name: _TimerT_CountN_Poll
nodes.summary: Count-down poll: fires and decrements the counter while it is non-zero.

nodes.name: _TimerT_OneShot_Poll
nodes.summary: One-shot poll: fires once when the period elapses, then clears the armed counter.

nodes.name: _TimerT_Poll
nodes.summary: Mode-free poll that encodes stopped, periodic, one-shot and multi-shot in Period and Counter, stopping the timer after the last shot.

nodes.name: _TimerT_Modal_Poll
nodes.summary: Poll driven by the Timer_Mode_T enum, including the disabled state: counts up for periodic counters, counts down for N-shot timers, and moves a finished one-shot to stopped.

nodes.name: _TimerT_InitMode
nodes.summary: Clears the timer state and sets its initial mode.

nodes.name: _TimerT_StartMode
nodes.summary: Sets the mode and starts the period from now, unless the timer is disabled.

nodes.name: _TimerT_StartPeriodic
nodes.summary: Starts periodic mode with the counter cleared.

nodes.name: _TimerT_StartOneShot
nodes.summary: Starts one-shot mode with the counter armed to 1.

nodes.name: _TimerT_StartCountN
nodes.summary: Starts N-shot count-down mode with the given number of shots.

nodes.name: math_counter.h
nodes.summary: Pure helper functions for wrapping counters and free-running timers: wrapped difference, mask alignment, and elapsed / is-elapsed checks built on unsigned subtraction.

nodes.name: AngleCounter.h
nodes.summary: Stateful pulse-count companion to Angle_T: accumulates signed edge counts into a wrapping 32-bit angle, estimates count frequency with the mixed M/T method, and bridges that frequency into an angle delta for interpolation and into per-unit, RPM and cycles-per-second speed queries.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_CaptureCount
nodes.summary: On a pulse edge, adds the signed count and advances the wrapping 32-bit angle by one count.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_ZeroCount
nodes.summary: Clears the signed displacement counter.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_SetAngle
nodes.summary: Sets the accumulated angle directly from a sensor snapshot.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_CaptureFreq
nodes.summary: M/T frequency step at the sample rate: takes the counts since the last sample and multiplies them by the sample-time frequency, holding a single count's worth while no new pulse arrives.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_ResolveAngleDelta
nodes.summary: Converts count frequency into the per-poll angle increment stored in Base.Delta for interpolation.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_Interpolate
nodes.summary: Advances the base angle by its delta for one poll cycle, within the configured limits.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_SetLimits
nodes.summary: Sets the lower and upper angle bounds that clamp interpolation.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_GetSpeed_Pu
nodes.summary: Returns speed in per-unit from the count frequency and the precomputed scale.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Derives the runtime unit factors (angle per count, angle delta per count frequency, per-unit speed scale) from polling frequency, counts per revolution and the speed base.

nodes.name: Encoder_Sensor.c
nodes.summary: Adapts the quadrature Encoder transducer to the motor's RotorSensor interface: defines ENCODER_VTABLE with init, unit setup, 20 kHz angle capture, 1 ms M/T speed capture, zeroing and availability checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Interface implemented as a const struct of function pointers (vtable); the static functions are reachable only through ENCODER_VTABLE.

nodes.name: Encoder_RotorSensor_Init
nodes.summary: RotorSensor INIT entry: initializes the encoder for interrupt-driven quadrature M/T capture.

nodes.name: Encoder_RotorSensor_CaptureAngle
nodes.summary: 20 kHz capture: reads the encoder's mechanical angle in the calibrated direction and converts it to the electrical angle held in the rotor sensor state.

nodes.name: Encoder_RotorSensor_CaptureSpeed
nodes.summary: 1 ms capture: runs the M/T frequency capture, writes per-unit speed and the angle delta, and promotes the encoder to homed once an index edge has been seen.

nodes.name: Encoder_RotorSensor_ZeroSensor
nodes.summary: Resets pulse accumulation and speed state while keeping the position reference.

nodes.name: Encoder_RotorSensor_IsSensorAvailable
nodes.summary: Reports feedback as available once the encoder is aligned to the d-axis.

nodes.name: Encoder_RotorSensor_InitUnits
nodes.summary: Sets the encoder's speed base to the mechanical base (electrical base divided by pole pairs) and derives the counter units.

nodes.name: Encoder_Sensor.h
nodes.summary: Declares Encoder_RotorSensor_T, which composes a RotorSensor base with an Encoder instance, plus the ENCODER_VTABLE extern and its compile-time initializer macro.

nodes.name: Hall.c
nodes.summary: Out-of-line part of the Hall sensor decoder: pin and config initialization, the calibration routine that fills the physical-to-virtual sensor table, table and wiring validation, and the variable / config ID accessors.

nodes.name: Hall_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Initializes the three Hall input pins and copies a config table into state.

nodes.name: Hall_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the Hall decoder from its non-volatile config.

nodes.name: Hall_StartCalibrate
nodes.summary: Begins calibration by clearing the sensor table, so a partial run cannot pass validation on old entries.

nodes.name: Hall_CalibrateState
nodes.summary: Records the virtual sector ID for the current physical sensor reading; called once per energised phase.

nodes.name: Hall_IsStateValid
nodes.summary: Checks wiring by rejecting the all-low and all-high sensor readings.

nodes.name: Hall_IsCalibrationTableValid
nodes.summary: Verifies that each of the six physical codes maps to a distinct, valid virtual ID.

nodes.name: Hall_VarId_Get
nodes.summary: Returns a runtime variable (raw sensor pins or resolved ID) by variable ID.

nodes.name: _Hall_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes one sensor-table entry by config ID, rejecting out-of-range values.

nodes.name: _Hall_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads one sensor-table entry by config ID.

nodes.name: Hall_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Null-checked wrapper that sets a config value in the instance's state.

nodes.name: Hall_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Null-checked wrapper that reads a config value from the instance's state.

nodes.name: Hall.h
nodes.summary: Hall sensor decoder base: defines the 3-bit sensor state, virtual sector IDs with rotor-angle and commutation aliases, the config / state / handle types, and inline functions that read the pins, map them through the calibration table, and resolve direction and the 16-bit sector-boundary angle.
nodes.languageNotes: One enum carries several alias sets (sensor state, rotor angle, commutation phase) over the same 3-bit values, and lookup tables use designated initializers indexed by those enumerators.

nodes.name: _Hall_Angle16Of
nodes.summary: Looks up the 16-bit electrical angle at the centre of a virtual Hall sector.

nodes.name: _Hall_Angle16BoundaryOf
nodes.summary: Returns the sector's entry boundary angle: the centre shifted 30 degrees against the direction of travel.

nodes.name: _Hall_DirectionOf_Lut
nodes.summary: Resolves rotation direction from the previous and new sector IDs with a 64-entry transition table.

nodes.name: Hall_Verify
nodes.summary: Returns true for the six valid sensor codes, excluding 000 and 111.

nodes.name: _Hall_CaptureSensors
nodes.summary: Stores the raw reading, shifts the previous ID, and maps the reading to a virtual ID through the calibration table.

nodes.name: Hall_ReadSensors
nodes.summary: Reads the three Hall pins into a 3-bit sensor value.

nodes.name: Hall_CaptureSensors_ISR
nodes.summary: Unconditional read-and-capture for use from a pin-edge interrupt.

nodes.name: Hall_PollCaptureSensors
nodes.summary: Polls the pins and captures only on a valid change, holding the last sector on an open or shorted wire; returns true on each edge.

nodes.name: Hall_GetAngleAs
nodes.summary: Returns the current sector's boundary angle for a given direction.

nodes.name: Hall_ResolveDirection
nodes.summary: Derives and stores the direction from the last two captured IDs.

nodes.name: Hall_ResolveAngle
nodes.summary: Stores the boundary angle of the current sector for the stored direction.

nodes.name: Hall_ZeroInitial
nodes.summary: Captures the sensors at standstill and seeds the angle to the sector centre.

nodes.name: Hall_Sensor.h
nodes.summary: Implements the RotorSensor interface for Hall sensors by composing the Hall decoder, a PulseTimer for edge timing and an AngleCounter: snaps the angle to the sector boundary on each edge, interpolates within the sector at 20 kHz, and derives speed at 1 ms. Defines HALL_VTABLE.
nodes.languageNotes: The vtable and its static functions are defined in the header, so each including translation unit gets its own copy.

nodes.name: Hall_RotorSensor_Init
nodes.summary: RotorSensor INIT entry: initializes the Hall decoder and the pulse timer with a 500 ms stop timeout.

nodes.name: Hall_RotorSensor_SetSectorLimits
nodes.summary: Bounds interpolation to the current 60-degree sector using its CCW and CW entry boundaries.

nodes.name: Hall_RotorSensor_CaptureAngle
nodes.summary: 20 kHz capture: on a Hall edge, times it, snaps the angle to the sector boundary and updates the limits; otherwise interpolates toward the next boundary.

nodes.name: Hall_RotorSensor_CaptureSpeed
nodes.summary: 1 ms capture: computes the count frequency (zero on timeout), updates the interpolation delta and writes per-unit speed to the rotor sensor state.

nodes.name: Hall_RotorSensor_ZeroInitial
nodes.summary: Resets the sensor at standstill: seeds the counter angle with the sector centre, sets the sector limits and zeroes the pulse timer.

nodes.name: Hall_RotorSensor_VerifyCalibration
nodes.summary: Reports whether the Hall calibration table is valid.

nodes.name: Hall_RotorSensor_InitUnits_ElSpeed
nodes.summary: Sets the counter units for an electrical revolution of six edges against the electrical speed base.

nodes.name: Hall_RotorSensor_InitUnits_MechSpeed
nodes.summary: Alternative unit setup that treats the Hall sensors as a mechanical speed encoder with 6 x pole-pairs counts per revolution.

nodes.name: MotBuzzer.h
nodes.summary: Motor controller buzzer: aliases Blinky_T as MotBuzzer_T, defines the event option flags and config, and maps named beep patterns (short, double, periodic, standby error, monitor trigger) onto Blinky calls.

nodes.name: Pin.h
nodes.summary: GPIO pin abstraction over HAL_Pin: Pin_T holds the HAL port, the pin mask and an invert flag, with inline output and input functions at both physical (voltage) and logical (on/off) level, a masked module write, and init / deinit.

nodes.name: Pin_Output_Low
nodes.summary: Drives the pin to low voltage, ignoring the invert flag.

nodes.name: Pin_Output_High
nodes.summary: Drives the pin to high voltage, ignoring the invert flag.

nodes.name: Pin_Output_Toggle
nodes.summary: Toggles the pin's output level.

nodes.name: Pin_Output_Off
nodes.summary: Sets the pin to its logical off state, honouring the invert flag.

nodes.name: Pin_Input_ReadPhysical
nodes.summary: Reads the pin's input as a voltage level, ignoring the invert flag.

nodes.name: Pin_Module_WriteOutput
nodes.summary: Writes several pins of one port in two HAL writes and no read: the masked pins off, then the selected states on.

nodes.name: Pin_Output_Init
nodes.summary: Configures the pin as an output and sets it to logical off.

nodes.name: Pin_Input_Init
nodes.summary: Configures the pin as an input.

nodes.name: Blinky.c
nodes.summary: Timed pin indicator for LEDs and buzzers: drives a Pin from a modal TimerT to produce one-shot blinks, N-repeat blinks and periodic on/off patterns, advanced by polling Blinky_Proc.

nodes.name: Blinky_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the output pin off, resets the timer and clears the pattern function.

nodes.name: Blinky_Proc
nodes.summary: Polled process: on each timer event turns the pin off after a one-shot, toggles during an N-blink, or runs the periodic pattern function.

nodes.name: Blinky_On
nodes.summary: Turns the indicator on and records the state.

nodes.name: Blinky_Off
nodes.summary: Turns the indicator off and records the state.

nodes.name: _Blinky_Toggle
nodes.summary: Toggles the pin using the output register state.

nodes.name: Blinky_Toggle
nodes.summary: Toggles the indicator using the tracked on/off state.

nodes.name: Blinky_Stop
nodes.summary: Stops the timer, turns the indicator off and clears the pattern.

nodes.name: Blinky_Blink_OnOff
nodes.summary: Turns the indicator on and starts a one-shot timer that turns it off after the duration.

nodes.name: Blinky_Blink_Toggle
nodes.summary: Toggles the pin and starts a one-shot timer of the given duration.

nodes.name: Blinky_Blink
nodes.summary: Single blink for the given on-time.

nodes.name: Blinky_BlinkN
nodes.summary: Blinks a given number of times with separate on and off times, using the timer's N-shot counter.

nodes.name: Pattern_PeriodicToggle
nodes.summary: Pattern step that alternates the indicator and reloads the timer with the on-time or the off-time.

nodes.name: Blinky_StartPeriodic
nodes.summary: Starts a repeating on/off pattern with the given on and off times.

nodes.name: Blinky.h
nodes.summary: Declares the Blinky pin-indicator handle (pin, runtime state, timer), its initializer macros, inline enable / disable, and the blink, periodic and stop API.

nodes.name: Encoder.c
nodes.summary: Encoder configuration and reference logic: counter and pin-interrupt initialization, index homing with a travel budget, calibration of the index angle offset and the virtual home, quadrature direction calibration, and the variable / config ID accessors.

nodes.name: Encoder_InitInterrupts_Quadrature
nodes.summary: Enables dual-edge pin interrupts on A and B and a rising-edge interrupt on the index pin, for emulated quadrature capture.

nodes.name: Encoder_InitInterrupts_Incremental
nodes.summary: Enables a dual-edge interrupt on phase A only, for single-phase counting.

nodes.name: Encoder_InitCounter
nodes.summary: Initializes the hardware decoder counter with its wrap value, or the A/B input pins when capture is emulated in software.

nodes.name: Encoder_SetCounterZero
nodes.summary: Zeroes pulse accumulation and speed state.

nodes.name: Encoder_InitDirection
nodes.summary: Resolves and stores the direction compensation from config.

nodes.name: Encoder_GetHomingDelta
nodes.summary: Returns the mechanical angle to advance per open-loop step during a homing sweep.

nodes.name: Encoder_StartHoming
nodes.summary: Arms the index capture and loads the search travel budget of 1.5 revolutions.

nodes.name: Encoder_ProcHoming
nodes.summary: Spends one step of the homing travel budget.

nodes.name: Encoder_GetHomingStatus
nodes.summary: Pure query returning found, timeout or searching.

nodes.name: Encoder_PollHoming
nodes.summary: Combined step and status: decrements the travel budget and returns the homing status.

nodes.name: Encoder_ClearPositionRef
nodes.summary: Drops the position reference and re-arms the index capture after a fault, sensor loss or power-on.

nodes.name: Encoder_ResolveUserZero
nodes.summary: Derives the application zero in the d-axis frame as index offset plus virtual home offset.

nodes.name: Encoder_CalibrateIndexAngleOffset
nodes.summary: Commits the captured index position as the commutation offset and carries the error into the live angle.

nodes.name: Encoder_CalibrateVirtualHomeOffset
nodes.summary: Teaches the application zero at the current shaft position; requires the encoder to be homed.

nodes.name: Encoder_SetQuadratureMode
nodes.summary: Enables or disables quadrature capture and re-resolves the direction compensation.

nodes.name: Encoder_EnableQuadratureMode
nodes.summary: Enables quadrature capture.

nodes.name: Encoder_DisableQuadratureMode
nodes.summary: Disables quadrature capture.

nodes.name: Encoder_SetQuadratureDirection
nodes.summary: Sets whether A-leads-B counts as positive and re-resolves the direction compensation.

nodes.name: Encoder_CaptureQuadratureReference
nodes.summary: Zeroes the counter at the start of a direction calibration.

nodes.name: Encoder_CalibrateQuadraturePositive
nodes.summary: After moving in the positive direction, sets the A-leads-B polarity from the sign of the count.

nodes.name: Encoder_CalibrateQuadratureDirection
nodes.summary: Sets the A-leads-B polarity from the count sign and the known direction of travel.

nodes.name: Encoder_SetCountsPerRevolution
nodes.summary: Sets the counts-per-revolution config value.

nodes.name: Encoder_SetAngleFreqBase
nodes.summary: Sets the speed base used for per-unit conversion.

nodes.name: _Encoder_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a config field by config ID.

nodes.name: _Encoder_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a config field by config ID.

nodes.name: Encoder_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Sets a config field and propagates it: updates the stop timeout, the direction compensation or the user zero as needed.

nodes.name: Encoder_VarId_Get
nodes.summary: Returns a read-only diagnostic by variable ID: speed, angle in either frame, reference and homing state, index error, error count, direction, raw phases.

nodes.name: Encoder.h
nodes.summary: Incremental encoder core: config, state and const handle types for hardware-decoder or software-emulated capture, the stacked d-axis / index / user reference frames, and inline functions for counter access, index capture, align zero, reference state and direction compensation.
nodes.languageNotes: Compile-time selection between a hardware quadrature decoder and emulated pin-interrupt capture via ENCODER_HW_DECODER / ENCODER_HW_EMULATED changes both the struct layout and the inline bodies.

nodes.name: Encoder_GetCounterD
nodes.summary: Returns the signed displacement count from the hardware counter or the software accumulator.

nodes.name: _Encoder_SetCounterD
nodes.summary: Writes the displacement count to the software accumulator and, when present, the hardware counter.

nodes.name: _Encoder_GetAngle32
nodes.summary: Returns the 32-bit wrapping angle, scaled from the hardware counter or read from the accumulated angle.

nodes.name: _Encoder_ZeroPulseCount
nodes.summary: Resets pulse accumulation and speed state while keeping the angle datum owned by align and index.

nodes.name: Encoder_GetAngle
nodes.summary: Returns the 16-bit angle in the d-axis frame read by commutation.

nodes.name: Encoder_GetAngle_User
nodes.summary: Returns the 16-bit angle in the application frame, zero at the virtual home.

nodes.name: Encoder_CaptureIndex
nodes.summary: Index-edge capture: saves the raw angle and snaps the angle to the configured index offset, in two stores with no branch.

nodes.name: Encoder_PollIndexCapture
nodes.summary: Promotes the reference state to homed once an index edge has been captured.

nodes.name: Encoder_IsAligned
nodes.summary: True when the electrical angle is valid (aligned or homed).

nodes.name: Encoder_IsHomed
nodes.summary: True when the mechanical angle is valid (homed).

nodes.name: Encoder_CaptureAlignZero
nodes.summary: Sets the angle to zero at the rotor d-axis after an align and re-arms the index capture; skipped once homed.

nodes.name: _Encoder_IsQuadratureCaptureEnabled
nodes.summary: Returns the quadrature capture flag, or false when quadrature support is compiled out.

nodes.name: _Encoder_ResolveDirectionComp
nodes.summary: Selects the direction compensation from the quadrature polarity or the externally set single-phase direction.

nodes.name: Encoder_GetDirectionRef
nodes.summary: Returns the stored direction compensation.

nodes.name: Encoder_ISR.h
nodes.summary: Interrupt-side capture for the software-emulated encoder: a quadrature state-transition table that turns A/B pin changes into signed counts, single-phase capture, and the per-pin and shared ISR entry points that also time each edge.

nodes.name: _Encoder_CapturePhasesState
nodes.summary: Shifts the previous A/B state and appends the new pin state to form the 4-bit transition index.

nodes.name: _Encoder_CaptureCount
nodes.summary: Adds a signed count to the encoder's AngleCounter.

nodes.name: _Encoder_Quadrature_CountOf
nodes.summary: Looks up the signed count (-2 to +2) for a 4-bit A/B transition, with A-leads-B as increment.

nodes.name: _Encoder_Quadrature_CapturePulse
nodes.summary: Reads the pins, updates the transition state and captures the decoded count.

nodes.name: Encoder_CapturePulse
nodes.summary: Default ISR body: captures a quadrature or single-phase count by the mode flag, then times the edge.

nodes.name: Encoder_CaptureCount
nodes.summary: Captures an externally supplied signed count and times the edge.

nodes.name: Encoder_OnPhaseA_ISR
nodes.summary: Phase A pin interrupt: clears the flag and captures a pulse.

nodes.name: Encoder_OnPhaseB_ISR
nodes.summary: Phase B pin interrupt: clears the flag and captures a pulse.

nodes.name: Encoder_OnIndex_ISR
nodes.summary: Index pin interrupt: clears the flag and captures the index.

nodes.name: Encoder_OnPhaseAB_ISR
nodes.summary: Shared A/B interrupt: clears both flags, then captures one pulse so a two-edge jump is counted once.

nodes.name: Encoder_OnPhaseABZ_ISR
nodes.summary: Shared A/B/index interrupt: dispatches to the index handler or the A/B handler.

nodes.name: Encoder_MT.c
nodes.summary: Initialization for the encoder's M/T speed mode: derives the AngleCounter units from config, loads config values, sets the stop-detection timeout, and starts either polled or interrupt-driven quadrature capture.

nodes.name: Encoder_MT_InitUnits
nodes.summary: Derives the AngleCounter units from polling frequency, counts per revolution and the speed base.

nodes.name: Encoder_MT_InitValuesFrom
nodes.summary: Loads a config, derives units, sets the stop timeout and direction compensation, and zeroes the capture state.

nodes.name: Encoder_MT_Init_Polling
nodes.summary: Initializes the pulse timer and config for polled capture.

nodes.name: Encoder_MT_Init_InterruptQuadrature
nodes.summary: Initializes the pulse timer and config, forces quadrature capture on, and sets up the hardware counter or the pin interrupts.

nodes.name: Encoder_MT_SetInitial
nodes.summary: Zeroes the pulse count, the pulse timer and the count frequency.

nodes.name: Encoder_MT.h
nodes.summary: Encoder speed bridge using the M/T method: captures pulse frequency at the 1 ms sample rate, resolves the interpolation delta, and returns direction-compensated per-unit speed and RPM.

nodes.name: Encoder_MT_CaptureFreqD
nodes.summary: Captures the pulse frequency into the encoder's AngleCounter at the sample rate.

nodes.name: Encoder_MT_ResolveInterpolation
nodes.summary: Converts the count frequency into the per-poll angle delta.

nodes.name: Encoder_MT_GetSpeed_Pu
nodes.summary: Returns per-unit speed signed in the calibrated direction.

nodes.name: PulseTimer.h
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper over the HAL clock timer for timing square-wave pulses: captures the tick delta between edges, accumulates sample time for M/T frequency, and extends a 16-bit timer with a 32-bit millisecond counter for low-speed and stop detection.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_CaptureDeltaT
nodes.summary: Captures the timer ticks between two pulse edges from the HAL.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_CaptureSampleTh
nodes.summary: Captures the ticks since the last pulse at the sample point, accumulating a sample period on overflow.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_CaptureSampleTk
nodes.summary: Returns the time spanned by the pulses in the sample window, the T of the M/T method.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_CaptureSampleTk_Freq
nodes.summary: Returns the sample-time frequency, or 0 while still accumulating.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_CaptureExtendedDeltaT
nodes.summary: Edge capture that substitutes the 32-bit extended timer delta when the base timer has saturated.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_IsExtendedStop
nodes.summary: True when no edge has arrived within the stop timeout.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_SetExtendedWatchStop_Millis
nodes.summary: Sets the stop-detection timeout from milliseconds.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_CaptureEdge
nodes.summary: Alias for the extended edge capture, called on every pulse edge.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the HAL timer and its frequency.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_SetInitial
nodes.summary: Clears overflow, zeroes the timer and resynchronises the extended timer reference.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_Counter.h
nodes.summary: Glue between PulseTimer and AngleCounter: on each pulse edge captures the edge time and accumulates the signed count, and at the sample rate computes the count frequency or forces zero once the stop timeout elapses.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_CaptureCount
nodes.summary: Edge capture that times the edge and counts it, with the angle supplied externally (Hall sector snap).

nodes.name: PulseTimer_CaptureAngleCount
nodes.summary: Edge capture that times the edge and advances both the count and the wrapping angle.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_CaptureFreq
nodes.summary: Sample-rate speed step: zero on stop timeout, otherwise the M/T count frequency.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_AngleCounter_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the pulse timer and the counter units together.

nodes.name: Timer_Base_T
nodes.summary: Const timer source: a pointer to the free-running time base register or counter and its frequency for conversions.

nodes.name: Timer_State_T
nodes.summary: Mutable timer state: the period in base ticks (0 disables), the time reference, a counter for the repeat and counter modes, and the mode.

nodes.name: TimerT_T
nodes.summary: Const timer handle pairing a Timer_Base_T held by value with a pointer to its Timer_State_T, so the time base address and frequency are compile-time constants.

nodes.name: Timer_T
nodes.summary: Self-contained RAM timer object holding a copy of its Timer_Base_T and its Timer_State_T contiguously, for general purpose use.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_T
nodes.summary: Pulse counter companion to Angle_T for square wave encoders: the accumulated angle, the signed displacement counter, its delta and count frequency, and the per-count unit factors (angle, angle delta, per-unit speed, counts per revolution) derived from an AngleCounter_Ref_T.

nodes.name: AngleCounter_Ref_T
nodes.summary: Unit reference the caller fills for AngleCounter_InitFrom: the polling frequency, the counts per revolution and the base angular frequency for per-unit speed. Nothing in it is persisted.

nodes.name: Encoder_RotorSensor_T
nodes.summary: Encoder implementation of the RotorSensor interface: the RotorSensor_T base, bound to ENCODER_VTABLE by its init macro, followed by the Encoder_T it adapts.

nodes.name: Hall_Config_T
nodes.summary: Storable Hall calibration: the 8-entry table that maps the raw 3-bit sensor reading to a Hall_Id_T.

nodes.name: Hall_State_T
nodes.summary: Hall decoder runtime state: the working config, the last physical sensor read, the resolved current and previous ids, the direction and the angle.

nodes.name: Hall_T
nodes.summary: Const context of the Hall decoder: the three sensor input pins and pointers to its state and to its NVM config.

nodes.name: Hall_RotorSensor_T
nodes.summary: Hall implementation of the RotorSensor interface: the RotorSensor_T base, the Hall_T decoder, a PulseTimer_T for edge timing, a pointer to the AngleCounter_T used for count, frequency and interpolation, and the control loop polling frequency.

nodes.name: MotBuzzer_Config_T
nodes.summary: Buzzer configuration: the event flags that select which events trigger a beep, and the enable flag.

nodes.name: Pin_T
nodes.summary: Const pin descriptor: a pointer to the HAL pin registers, the pin mask or id, and an invert flag that treats the ground level as on.

nodes.name: Blinky_State_T
nodes.summary: Runtime state of the pin indicator: its timer state, the on flag, the on and off times and the active pattern function.

nodes.name: Blinky_T
nodes.summary: Const context of a pin indicator: the output Pin_T, a pointer to its runtime state and its TimerT_T. MotBuzzer_T is an alias of it.

nodes.name: Encoder_Config_T
nodes.summary: Storable encoder configuration: the counts per revolution, the base angular frequency for per-unit speed, the calibrated index offset (d-axis to Z), the user home offset (Z to application zero), the extended timer stop time, the index-calibrated flag and, in quadrature mode, the capture enable and A-leads-B polarity.

nodes.name: Encoder_State_T
nodes.summary: Encoder runtime state: the working config, the previous A/B phases and the error count, the AngleCounter_T, the direction compensation, and the position reference (index angle capture, derived user zero, homing steps remaining and reference state).

nodes.name: Encoder_T
nodes.summary: Const context of an encoder: either the HAL hardware counter or, when emulated, the HAL A, B and Z pin handles with their ids and the A and B Pin_T; plus the PulseTimer_T, the polling frequency and pointers to its state and to its NVM config.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_State_T
nodes.summary: Pulse timer runtime state: the captured timer value, the tick count between two pulse edges, the timer value at the last sample, and the extended timer value with its stop threshold.

nodes.name: PulseTimer_T
nodes.summary: Const pulse timer instance: the HAL clock timer used for edge-to-edge timing, the timer and sample frequencies with the sample time, a pointer to its state, and the 32-bit extended timer with its frequency and conversion for low-speed stop detection.

nodes.name: Motor_MotVar.c
nodes.summary: Protocol-side router that maps a MotVarId_T (prefix, type, base id) onto the per-motor Var accessors: base motor variables, sub-module variables (board, phase input, rotor, heat monitor, PID tuning, FOC, sensorless observer) and sensor variables (Hall, encoder).

nodes.name: Motor_VarType_Base_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a base motor variable by type id, routing to the user output, user control and config (calibration, debug, actuation, PID, electrical) getters. Command and setpoint types read as 0.

nodes.name: Motor_VarType_Base_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a base motor variable by type id: user control, setpoints, state, open-loop and calibration commands, and the config groups. Electrical writes re-derive the FOC parameters; access control is left to the caller.

nodes.name: Motor_VarType_SubModule_Get
nodes.summary: Reads sub-module variables: board constants, phase input, rotor sensor output, heat monitor state and config, live PID tuning, FOC output, and the sensorless observer's telemetry and config when built.

nodes.name: Motor_VarType_SubModule_Set
nodes.summary: Writes the writable sub-module groups: heat monitor config, thermistor config and live PID tuning. Read-only groups are ignored.

nodes.name: Motor_VarType_Sensor_Get
nodes.summary: Reads Hall and, when enabled, encoder state and config variables from the motor's sensor table.

nodes.name: Motor_VarType_Sensor_Set
nodes.summary: Writes Hall and encoder config variables and forwards Hall commands to Motor_Hall_Cmd.

nodes.name: Motor_MotVar_Get
nodes.summary: MotVarId_T read entry: dispatches on the id's prefix to the base, sub-module or sensor type getter of the given motor.

nodes.name: Motor_MotVar_Set
nodes.summary: MotVarId_T write entry: reports an invalid id for a NULL motor or unknown prefix, otherwise dispatches to the matching type setter.

nodes.name: Motor_MotVar_CheckSet
nodes.summary: Optional write-admission check, not wired in: classifies each (prefix, type) pair as read-only, unrestricted command or setpoint IO, or state-gated. The state-gated cases currently fall through to false.

nodes.name: Motor_MotVar.h
nodes.summary: Declares the Motor_T dispatch by MotVarId_T: the base, sub-module and sensor VarType getters and setters, and the Motor_MotVar_Get/Set entry points used by the wire protocol.

nodes.name: Motor_ADC.c
nodes.summary: Phase current zero-offset calibration, run as a sub-state of the motor CALIBRATION state: averages the raw ADC counts of the three current channels for about two seconds with the low sides on, then stores them as the Iabc zero reference in Config.

nodes.name: StartCalibration
nodes.summary: Sub-state entry: zeroes the moving-average filters kept in the motor's calibration buffer, starts a 2000 ms one-shot on the control timer, switches the phases to the low side and marks the first Iabc conversion.

nodes.name: ProcCalibration
nodes.summary: Sub-state loop: once all three current samples have landed, feeds each channel's raw ADC count into its running average and marks the next conversion.

nodes.name: EndCalibration
nodes.summary: Sub-state exit test: when the timer elapses, writes the averaged counts to Config.IabcZeroRef_Adcu, floats the phases and returns to the CALIBRATION parent state.

nodes.name: Motor_ADC_Calibrate
nodes.summary: Public command that invokes the transition from MOTOR_STATE_CALIBRATION into the current sensor zero calibration sub-state.

nodes.name: Motor_ADC.h
nodes.summary: Inline ADC capture and mark callbacks for a motor: converts phase voltage and current ADC counts into the per-unit PhaseInput set using the stored current zero reference, marks the next conversions by phase output state, and gates the current sample cycle by the I-loop divider.

nodes.name: Motor_IsISampleCycle
nodes.summary: True on the control cycle that samples the phase current set, found by masking the motor's control tick counter with the I-loop divider. Every cycle as built.

nodes.name: Motor_ADC_CaptureIabc
nodes.summary: Captures a complete three-phase current set: converts the ADC counts to per-unit against the stored zero references and stores the result in PhaseInput.I.

nodes.name: Motor_ADC_MarkPhases
nodes.summary: Marks the next conversion by output state: the current set while the bridge is driven, the phase voltage (back-EMF) set while it floats.

nodes.name: Motor_ADC_MarkI
nodes.summary: Marks the driven current sample. With low-side sensing it leaves out the phase with the highest duty; otherwise it marks all three.

nodes.name: Motor_Table.h
nodes.summary: Collection interface over an array of Motor_T instances: applies a feedback mode, control state, direction or command to every motor, tests every or any motor against a state or predicate, and wraps the void_array for-each helpers.

nodes.name: Motor_Table_ApplyControl
nodes.summary: Applies a phase output state (float, V0 or PWM) to every motor in the table through each motor's state machine input.

nodes.name: Motor_Table_SetCmdWith
nodes.summary: Sets a command value on every motor's context with the supplied setter, such as a speed or torque command function.

nodes.name: Motor_Table_IsEveryUserDirection
nodes.summary: True when every motor's user direction equals the given sign.

nodes.name: Motor_Table_IsEverySpeedZero
nodes.summary: True when every motor's speed feedback reads zero.

nodes.name: _Motor_Table_GetDirectionAll
nodes.summary: Returns the user direction shared by all motors: forward, reverse, or NULL when they disagree or are stopped.

nodes.name: Motor_Table_ForEach
nodes.summary: Calls a procedure on every Motor_T in the table through void_array_foreach.

nodes.name: Motor_Table_IsEveryState
nodes.summary: True when every motor's root state is the given state.

nodes.name: Motor_Table_IsAnyState
nodes.summary: True when at least one motor's root state is the given state.

nodes.name: Motor.c
nodes.summary: Core per-motor module: initialises a Motor_T from its NVM config (phase output, rotor sensor, heat monitor, timers, PIDs, ramps, FOC parameters), validates the config, and owns direction, feedback mode, current and speed limit resolution and the PID tuning setters.

nodes.name: Motor_Init
nodes.summary: Initialises a motor instance: loads Config from NVM, initialises the phase output, the selected rotor sensor, the heat monitor and the timers, resets the limit inputs, defaults to current feedback mode, then resets derived state and starts the state machine.

nodes.name: Motor_Reset
nodes.summary: Re-derives runtime state from Config: sensor units, speed and current PIDs, speed and torque ramps, FOC parameters, open-loop preset ramps and the control timer. Clears the direction and the voltage limit.

nodes.name: Motor_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Copies a supplied config into the motor context, when one is given, and resets derived state.

nodes.name: Motor_Reinit
nodes.summary: Reloads Config from NVM and resets derived state without touching hardware registers. A sensor change still needs a reboot.

nodes.name: Motor_IsConfigValid
nodes.summary: Checks the motor config and that its speed limits fit within the ceiling, which field weakening extends past the rated speed.

nodes.name: Motor_ValidateConfig
nodes.summary: Clamps config values into range at init: the align voltage by Rs, the motoring current beside the field-weakening current, and the speed limits within the ceiling.

nodes.name: Motor_InitUnits
nodes.summary: Propagates the control frequency, pole pairs and speed base from Config to the active rotor sensor's unit reference.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_InitParams
nodes.summary: Derives the FOC electrical parameters (Ld, Lq, Rs, Psi at the turn base) and the field-weakening Id limit and gain from Config. An invalid electrical model keeps the previous parameters.

nodes.name: Motor_ClearFeedbackState
nodes.summary: Resets the speed PID, the phase current and voltage inputs, the speed and torque ramp outputs and the user command to zero.

nodes.name: Motor_SetFeedbackMode
nodes.summary: Stores the feedback mode flags. The RUN state's entry resolves the limits that follow from it.

nodes.name: Motor_ResolveVLimits
nodes.summary: Voltage modes: sets the torque ramp limits and the speed PID output limits to the anti-plugging voltage interval of the applied direction.

nodes.name: Motor_ResolveFeedbackLimits
nodes.summary: Resolves the torque ramp and speed PID limits in the units of the feedback mode: voltage limits for voltage modes, current limits otherwise.

nodes.name: Motor_SetDirection
nodes.summary: Applies the electrical direction: sets the FOC voltage limit half-plane for it, stores Direction and zeroes the rotor sensor's initial state.

nodes.name: Motor_ResolveILimits
nodes.summary: Materialises the current limits into the torque ramp and the speed PID: min(pushed, config), signed by direction and intersected with the supply current window.

nodes.name: _Motor_SetILimits
nodes.summary: Push alternative: stores the motoring and generating limit inputs and resolves them immediately.

nodes.name: Motor_SetILimits
nodes.summary: Stores the upper layer's motoring and generating current limits, each capped by the config limit. Takes effect on the next resolve.

nodes.name: Motor_SetILimitDerates
nodes.summary: Stores the current limits as derate ratios of the configured motoring and generating limits.

nodes.name: Motor_SetILimitMotoring
nodes.summary: Sets the motoring current limit input and keeps the generating one.

nodes.name: Motor_SetILimitGenerating
nodes.summary: Sets the generating current limit input and keeps the motoring one.

nodes.name: Motor_ResetILimit
nodes.summary: Removes the pushed current caps: the limit inputs return to the config values and the forward and reverse caps to full scale.

nodes.name: Motor_ResolveSpeedLimits
nodes.summary: Materialises the speed limits into the speed ramp: min(pushed, config), signed by the configured forward direction.

nodes.name: Motor_SetSpeedLimits
nodes.summary: Stores the forward and reverse speed limit inputs. They are keyed by user direction, so a direction change needs no resync.

nodes.name: Motor_SetSpeedLimitForward
nodes.summary: Sets the forward speed limit input and keeps the reverse one.

nodes.name: Motor_SetSpeedLimitReverse
nodes.summary: Sets the reverse speed limit input and keeps the forward one.

nodes.name: Motor_SetSpeedLimit
nodes.summary: Sets the forward and reverse speed limit inputs to the same value.

nodes.name: Motor_ResetSpeedLimit
nodes.summary: Returns the speed limit inputs to the config values.

nodes.name: Motor_SetSpeedLimitDerate
nodes.summary: Stores the speed limits as a derate ratio of the configured forward and reverse limits.

nodes.name: Motor_ResetSpeedPid
nodes.summary: Reloads the speed PID from its config.

nodes.name: Motor_ResetIPid
nodes.summary: Reloads the Iq and Id current PIDs from the shared current PID config.

nodes.name: _Motor_ResetTuning
nodes.summary: Discards live tuning: restores the speed and current PID configs from NVM and reloads the running PIDs.

nodes.name: _Motor_Tuning_SetSpeedKp
nodes.summary: Sets the speed loop Kp (Fixed32) in both Config and the running PID, keeping the runtime and stored values consistent.

nodes.name: _Motor_Tuning_SetSpeedKi
nodes.summary: Sets the speed loop Ki (Fixed32) in both Config and the running PID.

nodes.name: _Motor_Tuning_SetIKp
nodes.summary: Sets the current loop Kp (Fixed32) in Config and in both the Iq and Id PIDs.

nodes.name: _Motor_Tuning_SetIKi
nodes.summary: Sets the current loop Ki (Fixed32) in Config and in both the Iq and Id PIDs.

nodes.name: _Motor_Tuning_SetSpeedKp_Fixed16
nodes.summary: Sets the speed loop Kp from a 16-bit fixed-point value in both Config and the running PID.

nodes.name: _Motor_Tuning_SetSpeedKi_Fixed16
nodes.summary: Sets the speed loop Ki from a 16-bit fixed-point value in both Config and the running PID.

nodes.name: _Motor_Tuning_SetIKp_Fixed16
nodes.summary: Sets the current loop Kp from a 16-bit fixed-point value in Config and in both the Iq and Id PIDs.

nodes.name: _Motor_Tuning_SetIKi_Fixed16
nodes.summary: Sets the current loop Ki from a 16-bit fixed-point value in Config and in both the Iq and Id PIDs.

nodes.name: Motor.h
nodes.summary: Central per-motor header: defines the direction, feedback mode and fault flag types, the storable Motor_Config_T, the runtime Motor_Context_T and the const Motor_T device handle, with inline accessors for limits, direction, speed feedback and the speed loop step.
nodes.languageNotes: Each instance is split into a compile-time const handle (Motor_T, placed in flash) that points at mutable RAM state (Motor_Context_T). Feature paths are selected by preprocessor macros whose defaults are set at the top of the header.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_T
nodes.summary: Storable per-motor configuration loaded from non-volatile memory: sensor mode, forward direction, electrical model, current zero references, base speed and current limits, ramp slopes, PID configs, field-weakening tuning, and the align and open-loop presets.

nodes.name: Motor_Context_T
nodes.summary: Mutable runtime state of one motor: state machine instance, feedback mode, user command, fault flags, direction, active rotor sensor and its state, speed and torque ramps, speed PID, phase inputs, FOC state, limit inputs, open-loop ramps, heat monitor state, the working Config and a calibration scratch buffer.

nodes.name: Motor_T
nodes.summary: Compile-time const device handle of one motor: pointers to its context and VBus, the phase output and ADC channels, the rotor sensor table, the state machine, the control and speed timers, the NVM config and the heat monitor.

nodes.name: Motor_Direction_Cast
nodes.summary: Validates an integer as a Motor_Direction_T (CW, CCW or NULL) and returns NULL for any other value.

nodes.name: Motor_ILimitIntervalOfMotion
nodes.summary: Current limit interval by the sign of mechanical motion, for operation without a direction lock: motoring and generating by quadrant, the motoring limit on both sides at standstill.

nodes.name: _Motor_ResolveILimits
nodes.summary: Resolves the signed [Cw:Ccw] current limit interval: min(pushed, config) motoring and generating limits signed by Direction, intersected with the supply current window.

nodes.name: _Motor_ResolveSpeedLimits
nodes.summary: Resolves the signed speed limit interval from the forward and reverse limits and the configured forward direction.

nodes.name: _Motor_ApplyILimits
nodes.summary: Writes a current limit interval into the torque ramp limits and the speed PID output limits.

nodes.name: Motor_GetSpeedFeedback
nodes.summary: Returns the per-unit speed from the active rotor sensor. The single speed feedback getter for control and state checks.

nodes.name: Motor_ActivatePassiveOutput
nodes.summary: Selects the passive bridge output by speed: float within the freewheel limit, V0 (phases shorted) above it, where the back-EMF would exceed the bus.

nodes.name: Motor_ProcSpeedControlOf
nodes.summary: One speed loop step: ramps the speed request and runs the speed PI against the sensor's speed feedback, returning the torque or voltage request.

nodes.name: Motor_MatchSpeedTorqueState
nodes.summary: Bumpless transfer for the speed loop: seeds the speed ramp with the measured speed and the speed PID output with the given torque state.

nodes.name: Motor_GetUserDirection
nodes.summary: Returns the applied direction in the user's frame: Config.DirectionForward times the electrical Direction.

nodes.name: Motor_Config.c
nodes.summary: Motor config field interface: validates and clamps Motor_Config_T against the board ratings, provides setters with unit conversion for calibration, limits, ramps, align and open-loop presets, and implements the var-id get/set dispatchers of the calibration, actuation, PID and electrical config groups.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_IsValid
nodes.summary: Checks a config without modifying it: forward direction set, current zero references non-zero, a valid electrical model, limits and align and open-loop presets within the board ratings, and non-zero ramp slopes.

nodes.name: _Motor_Config_IsValidSpeed
nodes.summary: Checks that the forward and reverse speed limits are within a ceiling supplied by the caller.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_ValidateOpenLoop
nodes.summary: Clamps the align current and voltage and the open-loop ramp finals to the rated limits.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_Validate
nodes.summary: Clamps the V-speed adjustment, the current limits, the align values and the open-loop presets into their rated ranges.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_ValidateSpeed
nodes.summary: Clamps both speed limits to the given ceiling.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_ValidateVAlign
nodes.summary: Bounds the align voltage to the voltage that drives rated current through Rs, since an unregulated voltage-mode align draws VAlign / Rs at standstill.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_ValidateFw
nodes.summary: Limits the motoring current to the rated vector left beside the field-weakening current.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_ValidateFwSensorMode
nodes.summary: Disables field weakening (IfwLimit = 0) when the sensor mode is sensorless.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetSensorMode
nodes.summary: Sets the rotor sensor mode and re-applies the sensorless field-weakening rule. Takes effect after a reboot.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetPolePairs
nodes.summary: Sets the pole pair count of the electrical model.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetKv
nodes.summary: Sets the back-EMF constant from Kv, stored as electrical angular frequency per volt using the pole pairs.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetVSpeedRatio
nodes.summary: Sets the V-speed adjustment ratio used for back-EMF voltage matching, capped at full scale.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetSpeedRated
nodes.summary: Back-solves Kv from a rated speed and bus voltage, so that Kv times the bus voltage equals the given RPM.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetIaZero_Adcu
nodes.summary: Sets the phase A current sensor zero reference in ADC counts.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetIbZero_Adcu
nodes.summary: Sets the phase B current sensor zero reference in ADC counts.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetIcZero_Adcu
nodes.summary: Sets the phase C current sensor zero reference in ADC counts.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetSpeedLimitForward_Pu
nodes.summary: Sets the persistent forward speed limit, capped by the speed ceiling: rated, or full scale with field weakening.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetSpeedLimitReverse_Pu
nodes.summary: Sets the persistent reverse speed limit, capped by the speed ceiling.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetILimitMotoring_Pu
nodes.summary: Sets the persistent motoring current limit, capped by the board's rated peak current.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetILimitGenerating_Pu
nodes.summary: Sets the persistent generating current limit, capped by the board's rated peak current.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetSpeedRampSlope_PuPerTick
nodes.summary: Sets the speed ramp slope directly, in per-unit per speed loop tick.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetTorqueRampSlope_PuPerTick
nodes.summary: Sets the torque ramp slope directly, in per-unit per current loop tick.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetSpeedRampTime_Ticks
nodes.summary: Sets the speed ramp slope from the time in ticks to reach the forward speed limit. Zero means no ramp.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetTorqueRampTime_Ticks
nodes.summary: Sets the torque ramp slope from the time in ticks to reach the motoring current limit. Zero means no ramp.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetSpeedRampTime_Millis
nodes.summary: Sets the speed ramp time in milliseconds, converted to speed loop ticks.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetTorqueRampTime_Millis
nodes.summary: Sets the torque ramp time in milliseconds, converted to current loop ticks.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetSpeedRampSlope_RpmPerS
nodes.summary: Sets the speed ramp slope from RPM per second, converted to per-unit per tick.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetTorqueRampSlope_AmpPerS
nodes.summary: Sets the torque ramp slope from amps per second, converted to per-unit per tick.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetIAlign
nodes.summary: Sets the align current, capped by the rated peak current.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetVAlign
nodes.summary: Sets the align voltage, capped by the rated voltage.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetAlignTime_Cycles
nodes.summary: Sets the align ramp and step duration in control cycles.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetAlignTime_Millis
nodes.summary: Sets the align duration in milliseconds, converted to control cycles.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetOpenLoopRampSpeedFinal_Pu
nodes.summary: Sets the open-loop ramp's final speed, capped at half the rated speed limit.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetOpenLoopRampSpeedTime_Cycles
nodes.summary: Sets the open-loop speed ramp time in control cycles.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetOpenLoopRampSpeedTime_Millis
nodes.summary: Sets the open-loop speed ramp time in milliseconds, converted to control cycles.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetOpenLoopRampIFinal_Pu
nodes.summary: Sets the open-loop ramp's final current, capped by the rated peak current.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetOpenLoopRampITime_Cycles
nodes.summary: Sets the open-loop current ramp time in control cycles.

nodes.name: Motor_Config_SetOpenLoopRampITime_Millis
nodes.summary: Sets the open-loop current ramp time in milliseconds, converted to control cycles.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigCalibration_Get
nodes.summary: Var-id getter of the calibration config group: sensor mode, direction calibration, pole pairs, Kv, V-speed tuning and the three current zero references.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigCalibration_Set
nodes.summary: Var-id setter of the calibration config group, routing each id to its config setter.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigActuation_Get
nodes.summary: Var-id getter of the actuation config group: base speed and current limits, ramp slopes, align current, voltage and time, and the open-loop ramp presets.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigActuation_Set
nodes.summary: Var-id setter of the actuation config group. Each write goes through the clamping config setter.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigPid_Get
nodes.summary: Var-id getter of the stored speed and current PID gains and sample frequencies, as raw 32-bit values.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigPid_Set
nodes.summary: Var-id setter of the stored speed and current PID Kp and Ki as raw 32-bit values. Sample frequencies are read-only.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigPid16_Get
nodes.summary: Var-id getter of the PID config with the gains reported in 16-bit fixed-point form.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigPid16_Set
nodes.summary: Var-id setter of the PID config with the gains given in 16-bit fixed-point form.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigElectrical_Get
nodes.summary: Var-id getter of the electrical model as stored: Psi, Ld and Lq as angular-frequency rates, Rs in per-unit, and the field-weakening Id limit and gain.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigElectrical_Set
nodes.summary: Var-id setter of the electrical model as stored. The field-weakening Id limit goes through the sensorless rule.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigElectricalSi_Get
nodes.summary: Var-id getter of the electrical model in SI units: flux in microwebers, inductances in microhenries, Rs in milliohms.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigElectricalSi_Set
nodes.summary: Var-id setter of the electrical model from SI units, converted to the stored rate and per-unit forms.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigElectricalPu_Get
nodes.summary: Var-id getter of the electrical model in per-unit at the turn base, the form the FOC layer uses.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigElectricalPu_Set
nodes.summary: Var-id setter of the electrical model from per-unit turn-base values.

nodes.name: Motor_Config.h
nodes.summary: Config field interface header: declares the config validators and defines the var-id enums of the calibration, actuation, PID and electrical config groups together with their get/set dispatcher prototypes.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC.c
nodes.summary: Bridges the motor state machine to the FOC math: the per-PWM-cycle current-mode and voltage-mode pipelines, align and open-loop drives, back-EMF capture while passive, bumpless state matching on resume, supply current window resolution and the SVPWM duty write.
nodes.languageNotes: Hot-path helpers are kept out of line on purpose (noinline) so one copy serves every state, trading a call for flash size on the Cortex-M0+ target.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_WriteDuty
nodes.summary: Writes the FOC phase voltages Va, Vb, Vc to the PWM as SVPWM duties, scaled by the inverse bus voltage.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_AngleControl
nodes.summary: Current-mode angle control: sets theta, Clarke-Parks the captured phase currents, then runs the Id/Iq PI loop to Vd/Vq and the phase voltages. Kept noinline as the single copy for every current-mode state.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_AngleControl_Alt
nodes.summary: Variant for a divided current loop, not built: updates the angle every cycle but runs the PI only when a fresh current set has landed.

nodes.name: _Motor_FOC_ProcTorqueReq
nodes.summary: Torque path step on the context: advances field weakening for the Id request, ramps the Iq request through the torque ramp, and runs angle control at the sensor's electrical angle.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ProcTorqueReq
nodes.summary: Torque request entry for the state machine: runs the torque path at the present bus voltage.

nodes.name: _Motor_FOC_ProcAngleAlign
nodes.summary: Align step: ramps a d-axis current request clamped to [0, IAlign] and runs angle control at a fixed angle with zero Iq.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ProcAngleAlign
nodes.summary: Align entry on the device handle: runs the align step at the present bus voltage.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_MatchVOutput
nodes.summary: Matches the current loop's integrator state to the voltage being output, on a feedback mode change or on entry from another driving state.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_MatchVFreewheel
nodes.summary: Resume from freewheel: captures the speed for decoupling, matches the current loop state to the back-EMF (by sensor or by speed), and pre-loads the field-weakening Id from the matched voltage.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_MatchTorqueIState
nodes.summary: Seeds the torque ramp output with the measured Iq so current control resumes without a step.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ProcAngleFeedforwardV
nodes.summary: Open-loop voltage vector: captures the phase currents for measurement and sets Vd/Vq at the given angle without feedback.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ProcAngleV
nodes.summary: Voltage-mode pipeline: ramps the voltage request, sets theta from the sensor, still captures the currents, applies Vq within the bus limit and inverse-transforms to the phase voltages.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_MatchTorqueVState
nodes.summary: Seeds the torque ramp output with the present Vq for voltage mode.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ClearFeedbackState
nodes.summary: Clears all feedback state: the FOC capture, output and PI state, the speed PID, the phase current and voltage inputs, the ramp outputs and the user command.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ProcIFeedback
nodes.summary: Current loop run at the completion of the phase current set (the ON_PHASE action): captures Iabc, runs the PI on the held field-weakening Id and torque ramp output, and inverse-transforms.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ProcCaptureAngleVBemf
nodes.summary: Passive-state observer: at the sensor angle, captures the back-EMF into Vd/Vq while the phases float, or the short-circuit current into Id/Iq while they are shorted, clearing the other half.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_SetDirection
nodes.summary: Sets the motor direction and the FOC voltage limit half-plane for it.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ResolveISupplyLimits
nodes.summary: Computes the supply current window [Cw:Ccw] at the operating point by the build-selected law (power balance, phase bound or voltage derate) and stores it for the next current limit resolve.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_SetAlignCmdAngle
nodes.summary: Sets the open-loop electrical angle used by the align command.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_StartAlignCmd
nodes.summary: Starts a user align command by clearing the feedback state, so the torque ramp starts from zero.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ProcAlignCmd
nodes.summary: Runs the align step at the open-loop angle with the user command as the Id request.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_StartStartUpAlign
nodes.summary: Starts the start-up align: clears the feedback state and zeroes the open-loop angle to align on phase A.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ProcStartUpAlign
nodes.summary: Runs the align step at the open-loop angle, ramping toward the preset align current.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_StartOpenLoop
nodes.summary: Starts the open-loop spin by zeroing the preset current and speed ramps, continuing from the present open-loop angle.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ProcOpenLoop
nodes.summary: Open-loop spin step: ramps the preset speed, integrates it into the electrical angle, ramps Iq toward the preset current within the motoring limit, and runs angle control.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC.h
nodes.summary: Motor FOC submodule header: inline quadrant predicates (motoring, generating, plugging, regen), the decoupling speed capture, the field-weakening Id request step, the supply limit resolve hooks, and declarations of the FOC routines mapped to state machine handlers.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_IsRegen
nodes.summary: True regeneration: Iq opposes the rotation while the applied Vq still aligns with the speed, i.e. generating and not plugging.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_CaptureVSpeed
nodes.summary: Captures the electrical speed, the rotor sensor's angle delta per control period, into FOC for decoupling.

nodes.name: _Motor_FOC_ProcIdReq
nodes.summary: Returns the torque path's d-axis request: the field-weakening Id stepped on the last applied voltage, or 0 when field weakening is not built.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_WriteDuty_Thread
nodes.summary: Alternative duty write gated on the phase output register state: writes the SVPWM duties only while the output is in PWM mode.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ResolveISupplyLimitsOnEntry
nodes.summary: State entry hook that resolves the supply current window when any MOTOR_I_SUPPLY_LIMITS_* option is built, and is otherwise a no-op.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_ResolveISupplyLimitsOnSpeed
nodes.summary: Speed tick hook that resolves the supply current window only when MOTOR_I_SUPPLY_LIMITS_ON_SPEED is built.

nodes.name: Motor_Include.h
nodes.summary: Umbrella header that exports the whole Motor module: the table, thread, user, var, config, core, sensor and ADC headers.

nodes.name: Motor_StateMachine.c
nodes.summary: Defines the motor's hierarchical state machine: the INIT, DEACTIVATED, PASSIVE, RUN, INTERVENTION, OPEN_LOOP, CALIBRATION and FAULT root states, with their entry and loop handlers and the input transition tables for fault, phase output, feedback mode, direction, open-loop, calibration and intervention inputs.
nodes.languageNotes: States are const State_T structs of function pointers plus a designated-initializer transition table indexed by input id. The handlers run in the PWM ISR while the inputs arrive from the main thread.

nodes.name: TransitionFault
nodes.summary: Shared fault input of the non-fault states: ORs in the requested fault flags and transitions to FAULT if any flag is set.

nodes.name: TransitionIntervention
nodes.summary: Shared intervention input of RUN and INTERVENTION: accepts only sub-states of INTERVENTION and ignores a request for the branch already active.

nodes.name: Init_Next
nodes.summary: INIT exit test: after the init wait, clamps and validates the config and verifies the rotor sensor calibration, then goes to FAULT if any flag is set, otherwise to DEACTIVATED.

nodes.name: Deactivated_Entry
nodes.summary: DEACTIVATED entry: floats the phases, centres the duties, clears the feedback state, sets the direction to NULL and resets the control timer.

nodes.name: Deactivated_InputDirection
nodes.summary: DEACTIVATED direction input: applies a valid direction without leaving the state.

nodes.name: Passive_Entry
nodes.summary: PASSIVE entry: selects float or V0 by speed, clears the feedback state and resets the control timer.

nodes.name: Passive_Proc
nodes.summary: PASSIVE loop: captures the back-EMF, or the short-circuit current, at the sensor angle so control can resume matched.

nodes.name: Passive_InputControl
nodes.summary: PASSIVE phase output input: floats or shorts the phases on request. On PWM with a direction set it enters RUN when sensor feedback is available, or the active sensor's start-up chain from standstill.

nodes.name: Passive_InputDirection
nodes.summary: PASSIVE direction input: applies a valid direction only at zero speed.

nodes.name: Passive_InputOpenLoop
