nodes.summary: PASSIVE open-loop input: at zero speed, enters the requested OPEN_LOOP sub-state directly, or the OPEN_LOOP root.

nodes.name: Run_Entry
nodes.summary: RUN entry: resolves the supply, feedback and speed limits, matches the FOC state to the freewheel back-EMF or to the existing output, seeds the torque ramp and the speed loop, and re-bases the user command to the active feedback mode.

nodes.name: Run_Proc
nodes.summary: RUN loop on every PWM cycle: takes the speed PID output or the user command as the request, runs the voltage or the torque FOC path, and writes the duties.

nodes.name: Run_OnSpeed
nodes.summary: RUN speed tick action: captures the decoupling speed, re-resolves the supply, feedback and speed limits, and steps the speed loop when speed feedback is selected.

nodes.name: Run_InputControl
nodes.summary: RUN phase output input: a release request goes to PASSIVE within the freewheel limit, otherwise to the SPEED_ZERO intervention.

nodes.name: _Motor_TransitionFeedbackLost
nodes.summary: NEXT test shared by RUN and INTERVENTION: when sensor feedback is lost, falls back to open loop if built, else to PASSIVE within the freewheel limit, else to FAULT with the position sensor flag.

nodes.name: Intervention_Entry
nodes.summary: INTERVENTION entry: resolves the supply and current limits and matches the torque ramp and FOC output, since intervention runs the current loop in every feedback mode.

nodes.name: Intervention_InputControl
nodes.summary: INTERVENTION phase output input: a release goes to PASSIVE or SPEED_ZERO by speed, and PWM resumes RUN when sensor feedback is available.

nodes.name: OpenLoop_InputControl
nodes.summary: OPEN_LOOP phase output input: any release returns to PASSIVE, PWM is ignored.

nodes.name: OpenLoop_InputDirection
nodes.summary: OPEN_LOOP direction input at zero speed: NULL exits to PASSIVE, CW or CCW is applied.

nodes.name: OpenLoop_InputOpenLoop
nodes.summary: OPEN_LOOP command input: NULL exits to PASSIVE, the root re-enters itself, and a sub-state of OPEN_LOOP is entered directly.

nodes.name: Calibration_InputControl
nodes.summary: CALIBRATION phase output input: float exits to PASSIVE, V0 and PWM hold V0 and stay in calibration.

nodes.name: Calibration_InputDirection
nodes.summary: CALIBRATION direction input: applies a valid direction at zero speed.

nodes.name: Calibration_InputCalibration
nodes.summary: CALIBRATION command input: NULL exits to PASSIVE, the root re-enters itself, and a calibration sub-state is entered directly.

nodes.name: Fault_Entry
nodes.summary: FAULT entry: shorts the phases (V0) when requested or above the freewheel limit, otherwise floats them.

nodes.name: Fault_InputFault
nodes.summary: FAULT fault input: latches newly set flags, clears the requested flags and re-polls the conditions, and returns to DEACTIVATED once no flag remains.

nodes.name: Motor_StateMachine.h
nodes.summary: Motor state machine interface: the state and input id enums, the extern root states and machine definition, the ISR-side proc wrapper, state queries, and inline commands for enable, disable and fault set and clear.

nodes.name: _Motor_StateMachine
nodes.summary: Runs one synchronous state machine step from the PWM ISR, guarded by the async input lock when that mode is built.

nodes.name: _Motor_StateMachine_Thread
nodes.summary: PWM thread wrapper that runs the state machine step on a StateMachine_T handle's active state and context.

nodes.name: Motor_GetStateId
nodes.summary: Returns the id of the motor's root state.

nodes.name: Motor_IsState
nodes.summary: True when the motor's root state is the given state.

nodes.name: Motor_IsConfig
nodes.summary: True when the motor is in a state where the config may be changed: DEACTIVATED, CALIBRATION or FAULT.

nodes.name: Motor_Disable
nodes.summary: Invokes the PASSIVE to DEACTIVATED transition, accepted only at zero speed.

nodes.name: Motor_Enable
nodes.summary: Invokes the DEACTIVATED to PASSIVE transition, enabling operation.

nodes.name: Motor_StateMachine_SetFault
nodes.summary: Raises fault flags through the asynchronous FAULT input, which moves the motor to the FAULT state.

nodes.name: Motor_StateMachine_ClearFault
nodes.summary: Requests clearing of the given fault flags through the FAULT input.

nodes.name: Motor_StateMachine_TryClearFaultAll
nodes.summary: Requests clearing of all fault flags and reports whether the motor left the FAULT state.

nodes.name: Motor_Thread.h
nodes.summary: Per-motor thread functions for the application to place in its ISRs and loops: the PWM-rate control thread (sensor capture, state machine step, stator capture, speed poll) and the heat monitor thread.

nodes.name: Motor_PollSpeed
nodes.summary: On the speed timer tick, captures the speed from the rotor sensor and dispatches the ON_SPEED action to the active state.

nodes.name: Motor_CaptureSensor
nodes.summary: Captures the rotor angle from the active sensor at the start of the control cycle.

nodes.name: Motor_CaptureStator
nodes.summary: Lets the active sensor take the stator state after the state machine step. The sensorless observer corrects here.

nodes.name: Motor_PWM_Thread
nodes.summary: Per-PWM-cycle control thread, about 50 us: captures the sensor angle, runs the state machine step, optionally the sensorless stator capture, polls the speed loop tick and advances the control tick counter.

nodes.name: Motor_Heat_Thread
nodes.summary: Polls the motor heat monitor with the latest ADC result, raises an overheat fault through the state machine, and marks the next conversion while the monitor is enabled.

nodes.name: Motor_User.c
nodes.summary: User command interface of a motor: phase output, feedback mode, direction and intervention requests routed through the state machine, plus the voltage, current, torque and speed command setters, in per-unit or as a ratio of the configured limits.

nodes.name: Motor_ActivateControl
nodes.summary: Requests PWM output (run) through the phase output state machine input.

nodes.name: Motor_ReleaseVZ
nodes.summary: Requests floating phase output, the freewheel release.

nodes.name: Motor_ReleaseV0
nodes.summary: Requests V0 phase output, the phases shorted to hold.

nodes.name: Motor_ApplyControlState
nodes.summary: Applies a phase output state (float, V0 or PWM) through the state machine input.

nodes.name: Motor_ApplyFeedbackMode
nodes.summary: Requests a feedback mode change through the state machine when it differs from the active mode.

nodes.name: Motor_ApplyVirtualDirection
nodes.summary: Requests an electrical (CW or CCW) direction change through the state machine when it differs from the applied direction.

nodes.name: Motor_ApplyUserDirection
nodes.summary: Requests a direction in the user frame, converted by the configured forward direction.

nodes.name: Motor_ApplyTorqueZero
nodes.summary: Requests the TORQUE_ZERO intervention sub-state: coast with zero torque, resumable.

nodes.name: Motor_ApplySpeedZero
nodes.summary: Requests the SPEED_ZERO intervention sub-state: active deceleration to zero, resumable.

nodes.name: Motor_ApplySafeStop
nodes.summary: Requests the SAFE_STOP intervention sub-state: deceleration to zero with resume rejected.

nodes.name: Motor_ForceDisableControl
nodes.summary: Forces the passive output immediately (float or V0 by speed), clears the feedback state, then requests the release transition.

nodes.name: Motor_StartVoltageMode
nodes.summary: Selects voltage feedback mode.

nodes.name: Motor_SetVoltageCmd
nodes.summary: Sets the user command as a per-unit voltage along the applied (motoring) direction.

nodes.name: Motor_SetVoltageCmd_Norm
nodes.summary: Sets the voltage command as a ratio of the phase voltage reference from VBus.

nodes.name: Motor_StartIMode
nodes.summary: Selects current feedback mode.

nodes.name: Motor_SetICmd
nodes.summary: Sets the user command as a per-unit current, positive as motoring along the applied direction.

nodes.name: Motor_SetICmd_Norm
nodes.summary: Sets the current command as a ratio of the configured motoring limit when positive, or of the generating limit when negative.

nodes.name: Motor_SetTorqueCmd
nodes.summary: Sets the user command as a per-unit torque current, signed by the configured forward direction.

nodes.name: Motor_SetTorqueCmd_Norm
nodes.summary: Sets the torque command as a ratio of the configured motoring current limit.

nodes.name: Motor_SetTorqueVCmd
nodes.summary: Sets a voltage-mode torque command in per-unit, signed by the configured forward direction.

nodes.name: Motor_SetTorqueVCmd_Norm
nodes.summary: Sets the voltage-mode torque command as a ratio of the SVPWM phase voltage reference.

nodes.name: Motor_StartSpeedMode
nodes.summary: Selects speed feedback mode with the inner current loop.

nodes.name: Motor_SetSpeedCmd
nodes.summary: Sets the user command as a per-unit speed, signed by the configured forward direction.

nodes.name: Motor_SetSpeedCmd_Norm
nodes.summary: Sets the speed command as a ratio of the configured forward or reverse speed limit, chosen by sign.

nodes.name: Motor_SetTorqueMotoringCmd
nodes.summary: Sets a per-unit torque command, positive along the applied motoring direction.

nodes.name: Motor_SetTorqueMotoringCmd_Norm
nodes.summary: Sets the motoring-frame torque command as a ratio of the configured motoring current limit.

nodes.name: Motor_SetSpeedMotoringCmd
nodes.summary: Sets a per-unit speed command, positive along the applied motoring direction.

nodes.name: Motor_SetSpeedMotoringCmd_Norm
nodes.summary: Sets the motoring-frame speed command as a ratio of the configured forward speed limit.

nodes.name: _Motor_SetMotoringCmd_Norm
nodes.summary: Dispatches a normalized motoring-frame command to the speed, current or voltage setter by feedback mode.

nodes.name: _Motor_SetUserCmd_Norm
nodes.summary: Dispatches a normalized user-frame command to the speed, torque or torque-voltage setter by feedback mode.

nodes.name: Motor_SetActiveCmd_Norm
nodes.summary: Sets a normalized user command interpreted by the motor's active feedback mode.

nodes.name: _Motor_SetMotoringCmdUnits
nodes.summary: Dispatches a per-unit motoring-frame command to the speed, current or voltage setter by feedback mode.

nodes.name: _Motor_SetUserCmdUnits
nodes.summary: Dispatches a per-unit user-frame command to the speed, torque or torque-voltage setter by feedback mode.

nodes.name: Motor_User.h
nodes.summary: User-facing interface header: inline telemetry getters (speed, phase current and voltage, power, bus current, heat, setpoints, effective limits, quadrant, rated unit basis) and declarations of the command functions implemented in Motor_User.c.

nodes.name: Motor_User_GetSpeed_Pu
nodes.summary: Speed feedback in per-unit, signed in the user frame by the configured forward direction.

nodes.name: Motor_GetIPhase_Pu
nodes.summary: Phase current magnitude in per-unit, signed by the applied direction so that motoring is positive.

nodes.name: Motor_GetVPhase_Pu
nodes.summary: Phase voltage magnitude in per-unit, the back-EMF while freewheeling and the output while driving, signed by the applied direction.

nodes.name: Motor_User_ILimitMotoring
nodes.summary: Effective motoring current limit as an unsigned magnitude, read back from the resolved limit interval.

nodes.name: Motor_FOC_GetQuadrant
nodes.summary: Classifies the operating quadrant from the signs of the speed, Iq and Vq.

nodes.name: Motor_RatedUnitBasis
nodes.summary: Returns the rated unit basis for conversion: the nominal supply voltage, the rated peak current and the speed at the nominal bus voltage.

nodes.name: Motor_Var.c
nodes.summary: Implements the motor's id-keyed variable interface: runtime telemetry outputs, user control and setpoint inputs, state, open-loop and calibration commands, board constants, debug values and live PID tuning, each as a switch over a var-id enum.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_UserOut_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a runtime telemetry value by id: speed, phase current and voltage, state, sub-state path, fault flags, heat, the speed, current and voltage setpoints, effective V-speed, power and bus current.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_UserControl_Get
nodes.summary: Reads user control state by id: user direction, feedback mode, phase output state and the effective speed and current limits.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_UserControl_Set
nodes.summary: Applies a user control input by id (direction, feedback mode or phase output) through the state machine.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_UserSetpoint_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a setpoint by id: the normalized active-mode command, or a speed, torque, current or voltage command in per-unit.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_StateCmd_Call
nodes.summary: Executes a state command by id: clear fault, force disable, enable, disable, torque zero or speed zero.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_OpenLoopCmd_Call
nodes.summary: Executes an open-loop command by id: enter, phase output, angle align, jog or start the run chain.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_CalibrationCmd_Call
nodes.summary: Executes a calibration command by id: enter calibration, current sensor ADC zero, virtual home or electrical parameter identification.

nodes.name: Motor_Var_Board_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a board constant by id: the rated and maximum voltage and current, the voltage divider and current sense resistor and gain values, and the enabled rotor sensor options.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_ConfigDebug_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a derived diagnostic value: the rated speed in RPM, the speed at nominal voltage, or the rated speed in per-unit.

nodes.name: Motor_Var_ConfigElectrical_Set
nodes.summary: Writes an electrical config value and re-derives the FOC parameters from it.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_PidTuning_Get
nodes.summary: Reads the running speed and current PID sample frequency and gains (Fixed32) for live tuning.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_PidTuning_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a speed or current PID gain to both the running PID and Config for live tuning.

nodes.name: Motor_Var.h
nodes.summary: Defines the var-id enums of the motor's property interface (user output, user control, setpoint, state, open-loop and calibration commands, board constants, debug) and declares the get, set and call functions keyed by them.

nodes.name: Motor_Encoder.c
nodes.summary: Encoder-specific extensions of the motor state machine, built only with MOTOR_SENSOR_ENCODER_ENABLE: index homing under CALIBRATION, the align, validate-align and validate-closed-loop sub-states under OPEN_LOOP, the chained start-up sequence into RUN, and quadrature direction calibration.
nodes.languageNotes: The whole translation unit sits inside one #ifdef. Sub-states are file-local const State_T objects, reached only through the exported command functions that hand their address to the state machine.

nodes.name: PollAlignSettled
nodes.summary: Polls the align settle timer and restarts the window whenever the encoder still measures motion. True once the shaft has been still for the full window.

nodes.name: ProcHoming
nodes.summary: Homing loop: on each timer tick, advances the open-loop angle by the encoder's homing step, drives a feed-forward align voltage at it and spends one step of the search budget.

nodes.name: HomingTransition
nodes.summary: Homing exit test: an index found returns to CALIBRATION, and an exhausted travel budget raises the position sensor fault.

nodes.name: HomingAlignTransition
nodes.summary: Once the align before homing has settled, zeroes the open-loop angle, captures the encoder's align zero and starts the homing sweep.

nodes.name: Motor_Encoder_StartHoming
nodes.summary: Command: enters the homing sequence (align, then index search) through the CALIBRATION input.

nodes.name: Motor_Encoder_CalibrateIndexAngleOffset
nodes.summary: Commits the measured index position as the encoder's index angle offset. Valid only after a homing pass started from a fresh align.

nodes.name: AlignZeroNext
nodes.summary: Align sub-state exit: once settled, captures the encoder's align zero and proceeds to align validation.

nodes.name: ValidateAlignNext
nodes.summary: After the open-loop validation window, faults if the encoder angle did not move, otherwise proceeds to closed-loop validation.

nodes.name: ValidateClosedLoopTransition
nodes.summary: Closed-loop validation: faults if the speed and Vq polarity disagree. On timeout it marks the alignment validated and returns to OPEN_LOOP.

nodes.name: Motor_Encoder_StartAlignZero
nodes.summary: Command: enters the align sub-state from OPEN_LOOP, for testing the state on its own.

nodes.name: Motor_Encoder_StartValidateAlign
nodes.summary: Command: enters the validate-align sub-state from OPEN_LOOP, for testing the state on its own.

nodes.name: Motor_Encoder_StartValidateClosedLoop
nodes.summary: Command: enters the validate-closed-loop sub-state from OPEN_LOOP, for testing the state on its own.

nodes.name: StartUpAlignTransition
nodes.summary: Start-up chain: once the align settles, captures the encoder zero and moves to align validation.

nodes.name: StartUpValidateAlignTransition
nodes.summary: Start-up chain: faults if the encoder did not track the open-loop drive, otherwise moves to closed-loop validation.

nodes.name: StartUpValidateClosedLoopTransition
nodes.summary: Start-up chain: faults on a speed and voltage polarity mismatch. On timeout it completes the validation and enters RUN.

nodes.name: Motor_Encoder_GetStartUpState
nodes.summary: Returns the entry state of the encoder's start-up chain for the motor state machine.

nodes.name: Motor_Encoder_StartUpChain
nodes.summary: Command: from PASSIVE at zero speed, enters the encoder start-up chain.

nodes.name: ProcDirection
nodes.summary: Direction calibration steps: after the align on phase A it captures the quadrature reference and aligns on phase B, then calibrates which count direction is positive.

nodes.name: Motor_Encoder.h
nodes.summary: Declares the encoder-specific motor commands: homing, index angle offset calibration, the align and validation sub-state starts, and the start-up chain.

nodes.name: Motor_Hall.c
nodes.summary: Hall sensor calibration of a motor, as a sub-state of CALIBRATION: steps the stator through six align vectors 60 electrical degrees apart with the current loop, records the Hall state at each, and faults if the resulting table is not valid.

nodes.name: Calibration_Entry
nodes.summary: Hall calibration entry: resets the step counter, holds V0, clears the feedback state, opens the voltage limit in the forward half-plane, and starts the align timer and the Hall calibration.

nodes.name: Calibration_Proc
nodes.summary: Hall calibration loop: runs a current-mode align on the step's phase vector every tick and writes the duties. On each timer period it records the Hall state for the vector, resets the ramp and advances.

nodes.name: Calibration_End
nodes.summary: After six steps, floats the phases and restores the voltage limit, then returns to CALIBRATION, or to FAULT when the Hall table is not valid.

nodes.name: Motor_Hall_Calibrate
nodes.summary: Command: invokes the transition from CALIBRATION into the Hall calibration sub-state.

nodes.name: Motor_Hall_Cmd
nodes.summary: Var command entry for Hall: checks that Hall is the configured and active sensor, then starts the calibration.

nodes.name: Motor_Hall.h
nodes.summary: Declares the motor's Hall calibration command and var command entry, and defaults the Hall capture mode to polling.

nodes.name: Motor_Table_T
nodes.summary: Const motor collection: a pointer to a contiguous array of Motor_T devices and its length. The Motor_Table functions apply an operation or a test across every motor.

nodes.name: Motor_HallEncoder.h
nodes.summary: Inline pin-interrupt handlers for boards where the Hall inputs and the encoder A/B/Z channels share pins, routing each edge to the emulated encoder and/or the Hall angle capture according to compile-time options and the configured SensorMode.
nodes.languageNotes: The header has no include guard or #pragma once, and its handler bodies are selected by MOTOR_SENSOR_ENCODER_ENABLE, ENCODER_HW_EMULATED and MOTOR_HALL_MODE_ISR.

nodes.name: Motor_HallEncoderA_ISR
nodes.summary: Pin A edge handler for shared Hall/encoder pins: forwards to the emulated encoder phase A handler and, in Hall ISR mode with Hall selected, captures the Hall angle.

nodes.name: Motor_HallEncoderB_ISR
nodes.summary: Pin B edge handler for shared Hall/encoder pins: forwards to the emulated encoder phase B handler and, in Hall ISR mode with Hall selected, captures the Hall angle.

nodes.name: Motor_HallEncoderAB_ISR
nodes.summary: Combined A/B edge handler for boards with one interrupt for both pins: forwards to the emulated encoder AB handler and optionally captures the Hall angle.

nodes.name: Motor_HallEncoderCZ_ISR
nodes.summary: Handler for the shared C/Z pin that switches on SensorMode: the index pulse for an encoder, or the Hall phase C edge and Hall angle capture for a Hall sensor.

nodes.name: Motor_Sensor.c
nodes.summary: Selects, by the motor's configured SensorMode, the state-machine sub-state a sensor needs for start-up from standstill and for open-loop fallback on feedback loss. Only the sensorless option supplies them; every other sensor returns NULL.

nodes.name: Motor_Sensor_StartUpState
nodes.summary: Returns the state chain that acquires the rotor angle from standstill for the configured sensor, or NULL where the sensor reads the angle directly.

nodes.name: Motor_Sensor_FallbackState
nodes.summary: Returns the open-loop fallback state that carries on from the selected sensor's last angle after feedback loss in RUN, or NULL where the sensor has none.

nodes.name: Motor_Sensor.h
nodes.summary: Motor-level sensor umbrella header that pulls in every compile-time enabled sensor integration (Hall, shared Hall/Encoder pins, Encoder, Sensorless) with the sensor table, and defines the MOTOR_SENSOR_TABLE_INIT_* macros that bind each table entry to the motor's shared SensorState.

nodes.name: RotorSensor.c
nodes.summary: Defines MOTOR_SENSOR_VTABLE_EMPTY, a no-op RotorSensor vtable used for unimplemented or unselected sensors so that callers never null-check the interface.

nodes.name: RotorSensor.h
nodes.summary: Generic rotor angle sensor interface: a const vtable (capture angle, capture stator, capture speed, feedback availability, zeroing, init, units, calibration check) and the shared RotorSensor_State_T holding electrical angle, per-cycle delta and per-unit speed. Inline wrappers dispatch through the vtable, and a getter exposes the rotor state by variable id.
nodes.languageNotes: C interface pattern: a const struct of function pointers serves as the vtable, and the const base struct is embedded as the first member of each concrete sensor entry so the entry can be used through a RotorSensor_T pointer.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_T
nodes.summary: Base instance of the rotor sensor interface: a const pair of vtable pointer and shared state pointer, embedded as the first member of every concrete sensor entry.

nodes.name: _RotorSensor_SetDelta
nodes.summary: Publishes the per-cycle electrical angle delta to the shared state through a rolling two-sample average.

nodes.name: _RotorSensor_SetSpeedPu
nodes.summary: Publishes the per-unit speed to the shared state through a two-sample average saturated to the fract16 range.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_Init
nodes.summary: Calls the sensor's INIT to re-initialise its peripheral registers, then zeroes the shared angle and speed state.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_CaptureAngle
nodes.summary: Control-loop virtual call (about 20 kHz) that updates the electrical angle from the active sensor.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_CaptureStator
nodes.summary: Control-loop virtual call made after the state machine and the FOC write, letting a stator-observing sensor take the sampled current and the written voltage.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_CaptureSpeed
nodes.summary: Speed-loop virtual call (about 1 kHz) that updates the per-unit speed feedback.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_ZeroInitial
nodes.summary: Virtual call on start that zeroes the sensor's initial position reference.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_IsFeedbackAvailable
nodes.summary: Virtual query of whether the sensor currently provides usable angle feedback, checked from stop and after align.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_VerifyCalibration
nodes.summary: Virtual query of whether the sensor's calibration data is valid.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_InitUnitsFrom
nodes.summary: Copies pole pairs and the electrical speed base from the motor's unit reference, derives the per-unit speed reference at the polling frequency, then calls the sensor's INIT_UNITS.

nodes.name: _Motor_Var_Rotor_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a rotor variable (electrical angle, angle delta, speed feedback, mechanical angle or direction) by its Motor_Var_Rotor_T id.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_Table.c
nodes.summary: Placeholder translation unit for the rotor sensor table: it only includes RotorSensor_Table.h and defines nothing.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_Table.h
nodes.summary: Sensor selection registry: the RotorSensor_Id_T type ids (order preserved for serialization), the per-motor RotorSensor_Table_T holding one const entry per compile-time enabled sensor type, an enabled-sensors bitfield, and lookup and validation of a sensor by id.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_Table_T
nodes.summary: Const per-motor registry holding an EMPTY entry and one entry for each sensor type compiled in (Hall, Encoder, SinCos, Sensorless), all mapping to the common angle and speed state.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_Of
nodes.summary: Returns the base RotorSensor entry for a sensor type id, falling back to the EMPTY entry for ids that are not compiled in.

nodes.name: RotorSensor_Validate
nodes.summary: Checks that a sensor id is in range and that the given sensor pointer is the table's entry for that id.

nodes.name: Motor_Sensorless.c
nodes.summary: Sensorless start-up sub-state chain of the motor state machine: a coast wait under PASSIVE, then DC align and an open-loop ramp under OPEN_LOOP while the EMF observer converges, handing off to RUN once the observer locks. Also provides the open-loop fallback sub-state for a weakened lock; an alternate correction sequence and a SENSORLESS_RUN state are kept commented out.
nodes.languageNotes: Hierarchical states are const State_T instances linked by P_PARENT/P_TOP pointers, with ENTRY, LOOP and NEXT function pointers cast from Motor_T-typed handlers.

nodes.name: Coast_Next
nodes.summary: COAST transition: back to PASSIVE if the direction was cleared, to RUN if the observer already has lock, otherwise on to ALIGN once PASSIVE has lasted the coast time.

nodes.name: Coast_InputControl
nodes.summary: Phase-output input while coasting: a float or zero-voltage request cancels the pending start and returns to PASSIVE, while a PWM request is ignored as already pending.

nodes.name: Align_Entry
nodes.summary: ALIGN entry: starts the align timer, applies zero-voltage output, starts the FOC start-up align and resets the observer.

nodes.name: StartUp_Proc
nodes.summary: START_UP loop: runs the open-loop FOC ramp and writes duty, re-seeding the observer PLL from the ramp while the estimated EMF is still below its floor.

nodes.name: StartUp_Next
nodes.summary: Hand-off to closed loop: once the observer reports lock, re-Parks the FOC operating point at the estimated angle, clears the open-loop flag and transitions to RUN.

nodes.name: Fallback_Entry
nodes.summary: FALLBACK entry: seeds the open-loop angle, speed ramp and current ramp from the observer's angle, the speed feedback and the limited final ramp current.

nodes.name: Motor_Sensorless_StartRunChain
nodes.summary: Command entry that enters OPEN_LOOP at the SENSORLESS_ALIGN sub-state when a direction is set and the sensorless adapter is the active sensor.

nodes.name: Motor_Sensorless_StartUpState
nodes.summary: Returns ALIGN if PASSIVE has already lasted the coast time, otherwise the COAST sub-state; NULL unless sensorless is the active sensor.

nodes.name: Motor_Sensorless_FallbackState
nodes.summary: Returns the FALLBACK sub-state when sensorless is active and the observer's EMF is weak but still tracking; otherwise NULL.

nodes.name: Motor_Sensorless.h
nodes.summary: Interface of the sensorless start-up chain: the coast-time constant MOTOR_SENSORLESS_COAST_CYCLES and the entry points that start the align-ramp-run chain or return its start-up and fallback states. It also declares Motor_Sensorless_ProcTorqueReq, whose definition is currently commented out.

nodes.name: Sensorless_Sensor.c
nodes.summary: RotorSensor vtable implementation backed by the back-EMF observer: predicts and publishes the PLL angle every control tick, corrects the estimate from the FOC's sampled currents and held voltage after the state machine, derives per-unit speed, reports lock as feedback availability, and loads the winding model from the motor's electrical parameters.

nodes.name: Sensorless_Sensor_CaptureAngle
nodes.summary: Every control tick advances the PLL prediction and publishes the estimated angle and delta to the shared rotor state.

nodes.name: Sensorless_Sensor_CaptureStator
nodes.summary: Corrects the observer with the FOC's Id/Iq sample against the voltage held from the previous tick, then holds the newly written Valpha/Vbeta for the next sample.

nodes.name: Sensorless_Sensor_CaptureSpeed
nodes.summary: Converts the observer's angle delta to per-unit speed, reporting zero while the EMF magnitude is indeterminate.

nodes.name: Sensorless_Sensor_VerifyCalibration
nodes.summary: Treats the observer as calibrated when the sliding-mode gain, the low-pass coefficient and the winding plant gain are all non-zero.

nodes.name: Sensorless_Sensor_InitUnits
nodes.summary: Initialises the observer's winding model from the motor's Rs and Lq when the electrical model is valid, otherwise keeps the prior winding.

nodes.name: Sensorless_Sensor.h
nodes.summary: Declares Sensorless_Sensor_T, the RotorSensor entry that reads the rotor through the stator via an EmfObserver, together with its vtable and the SENSORLESS_SENSOR_INIT macro that allocates observer state and binds the motor's FOC, electrical model and NVM tuning.

nodes.name: Sensorless_Sensor_T
nodes.summary: Const sensorless sensor entry: the RotorSensor base followed by pointers to the EMF observer, the motor's FOC state, its electrical model and the observer's NVM config.

nodes.name: Motor_SinCos.c
nodes.summary: Motor-level integration of the analog Sin/Cos resolver: a CALIBRATION sub-state that aligns the rotor to phase A, captures the angle offset, steps +120 electrical degrees to resolve the positive direction and then verifies calibration, plus the command entry that starts it.

nodes.name: Calibration_Proc
nodes.summary: Timer-stepped calibration sequence: align to phase A, capture the angle offset, align at +120 electrical degrees, capture the CCW-positive sense, then release the phases.

nodes.name: Calibration_End
nodes.summary: On sequence completion sets the PositionSensor fault flag from the calibration check and returns to the parent CALIBRATION state.

nodes.name: Motor_SinCos_Calibrate
nodes.summary: Invokes the state-machine transition from CALIBRATION into the Sin/Cos calibration sub-state.

nodes.name: Motor_SinCos_Cmd
nodes.summary: Command dispatch that starts calibration only when Sin/Cos is both the active and the configured sensor.

nodes.name: Motor_SinCos.h
nodes.summary: Declares the motor-level Sin/Cos resolver entry points: starting the calibration sub-state and the generic command dispatch.

nodes.name: SinCos_Analog.h
nodes.summary: Bundles the two ADC conversion handles (sin and cos channels) of a Sin/Cos sensor, with helpers to mark both channels for conversion and read their results.

nodes.name: SinCos_Analog_Mark
nodes.summary: Marks both the sin and cos ADC channels for conversion.

nodes.name: SinCos_Analog_GetSin
nodes.summary: Returns the latest ADC result of the sin channel.

nodes.name: SinCos_Analog_GetCos
nodes.summary: Returns the latest ADC result of the cos channel.

nodes.name: SinCos_Sensor.h
nodes.summary: Declares SinCos_RotorSensor_T, the RotorSensor entry for analog Sin/Cos resolvers composed of the decode core and its ADC conversion bundle, with initializer macros and a helper that marks the analog channels.

nodes.name: SinCos_RotorSensor_T
nodes.summary: Const Sin/Cos sensor entry: the RotorSensor base followed by the SinCos decode core, the ADC conversion handles and the control-loop polling frequency.

nodes.name: SinCos_RotorSensor_MarkAnalog
nodes.summary: Marks the sensor's sin and cos ADC channels for conversion.

nodes.name: Motor_Calibration.c
nodes.summary: Calibration sub-states of the motor state machine. The only live code is Motor_Calibration_StartHome, currently a stub; the tuning, auto-tuning excitation and capture, homing and angle-align sub-states are all commented out.

nodes.name: Motor_Calibration_StartHome
nodes.summary: Intended entry to the homing sub-state from any calibration state; its transition code is commented out, leaving a no-op.

nodes.name: Motor_Calibration.h
nodes.summary: Inline commands to enter and exit the motor's CALIBRATION state and to test whether a calibration sub-state has completed, plus declarations for the homing, tuning and electrical-parameter calibration routines. The tuning excitation and capture types are commented out.

nodes.name: Motor_Calibration_Enter
nodes.summary: Requests entry to the CALIBRATION top state through the calibration state-machine input.

nodes.name: Motor_Calibration_Exit
nodes.summary: Requests exit from CALIBRATION by sending the calibration input with a NULL target.

nodes.name: Motor_Calibration_IsComplete
nodes.summary: True when the active leaf state is the CALIBRATION top state itself, meaning a calibration sub-state has finished and returned to its parent.

nodes.name: Motor_Intervention.c
nodes.summary: INTERVENTION sub-states that take the user command out of the control loop: TORQUE_ZERO passes only generating current, SPEED_ZERO decelerates to zero with the speed PID, and SAFE_STOP (SS1) is a committed SPEED_ZERO child that rejects resume and escalates to FAULT on a watchdog timeout.

nodes.name: TorqueZero_Proc
nodes.summary: Runs the FOC torque path with the user's current command filtered to its generating side only, then writes duty.

nodes.name: TorqueZero_CaptureSpeed
nodes.summary: Speed-tick action that captures the speed voltage and re-resolves the supply and current limits.

nodes.name: SpeedZero_Entry
nodes.summary: Matches the speed loop state to the present torque ramp output for a bumpless transfer and resets the control timer.

nodes.name: SpeedZero_Proc
nodes.summary: Runs the FOC torque path from the speed PID output, then writes duty.

nodes.name: SpeedZero_Next
nodes.summary: Transitions to PASSIVE once the speed reaches zero.

nodes.name: SpeedZero_CaptureSpeed
nodes.summary: Speed-tick action that updates the limits and then runs the speed controller toward a zero setpoint; shared with SAFE_STOP.

nodes.name: SafeStop_Next
nodes.summary: Transitions to PASSIVE at zero speed, or raises the SafeStopTimeout fault and goes to FAULT when the watchdog cycle count is exceeded.

nodes.name: SafeStop_InputControl
nodes.summary: Phase-output input during safe stop: float or zero-voltage requests are honoured only at zero speed, and a PWM resume is rejected.

nodes.name: Motor_Intervention.h
nodes.summary: Exposes the three INTERVENTION sub-states (TORQUE_ZERO, SPEED_ZERO, SAFE_STOP) for direct entry from the RUN state and the motor user commands.

nodes.name: Motor_OpenLoop.c
nodes.summary: OPEN_LOOP sub-states and commands of the motor state machine: phase-output and jog commands, a commanded angle align, and the start-up chain that aligns for a timed period and then runs the open-loop FOC ramp. A phase-align variant is commented out.

nodes.name: OpenLoop_PhaseOutput
nodes.summary: Transition handler that clears the FOC feedback state and applies the requested phase output mode while remaining in OPEN_LOOP.

nodes.name: Motor_OpenLoop_SetPhaseOutput
nodes.summary: Command that sets the phase output mode (float, zero or PWM) from within OPEN_LOOP without leaving it.

nodes.name: Motor_OpenLoop_SetJog
nodes.summary: Jog command for OPEN_LOOP; the transition handler it invokes is currently a no-op stub.

nodes.name: Motor_OpenLoop_SetAngleAlign
nodes.summary: Command that sets the open-loop angle and enters the ANGLE_ALIGN sub-state, holding the rotor at that angle with the current loop.

nodes.name: Motor_OpenLoop_SetAngleAlign_Phase
nodes.summary: Angle-align command that takes a phase id and converts it to its electrical angle.

nodes.name: StartUpAlign_Next
nodes.summary: START_UP_ALIGN transition: moves to the open-loop RUN sub-state when the align timer expires.

nodes.name: OpenLoop_StartUpRun
nodes.summary: Transition handler that, with a direction set, applies zero-voltage output and enters START_UP_ALIGN.

nodes.name: Motor_OpenLoop_StartRunChain
nodes.summary: Starts the align-then-run open-loop chain; its body is compiled in only with MOTOR_OPEN_LOOP_RUN_ENABLE or in debug builds.

nodes.name: Motor_OpenLoop.h
nodes.summary: Interface to the motor's OPEN_LOOP state: inline enter, exit and enter-at-sub-state inputs, the exported RUN and START_UP_ALIGN sub-states, and the open-loop command functions (phase output, angle align, jog, start run chain). Motor_OpenLoop_SetPhaseAlign is declared but its definition is commented out.

nodes.name: Motor_OpenLoop_Enter
nodes.summary: Requests entry to the OPEN_LOOP top state through the open-loop state-machine input.

nodes.name: Motor_OpenLoop_Exit
nodes.summary: Requests exit from OPEN_LOOP by sending the open-loop input with a NULL target.

nodes.name: Motor_OpenLoop_EnterBranch
nodes.summary: Requests entry to OPEN_LOOP directly at a given sub-state, for commands that begin with a sub-state.

nodes.name: Traction.c
nodes.summary: Initialises the traction module from stored configuration and provides get and set access to its config fields (throttle, brake, zero and lever modes) by id. The var-id accessors and a motor-input mapping are commented out.

nodes.name: Traction_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Copies the supplied configuration into the traction instance when one is given.

nodes.name: Traction_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Returns a traction config field (throttle, brake, zero or lever mode) selected by config id.

nodes.name: Traction_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a traction config field selected by config id, casting the value to the field's mode enum.

nodes.name: Traction.h
nodes.summary: Traction (vehicle drive) input model for the motor controller: throttle, brake, lever and direction inputs resolved into a RELEASE/THROTTLE/BRAKE command with edge detection, the mode enums for throttle, brake, release and lever behaviour, the Traction_T aggregate of input and config, and the config and var id interface.

nodes.name: Traction_Input_T
nodes.summary: User drive input state: direction, throttle, brake and signed lever values together with the last resolved drive command.

nodes.name: Traction_Input_EvaluateCmd
nodes.summary: Resolves the drive command from the inputs, with brake taking priority over throttle and release otherwise.

nodes.name: Traction_Input_PollCmdEdge
nodes.summary: Re-evaluates and stores the drive command, reporting whether it changed.

nodes.name: Traction_Input_PollThrottle
nodes.summary: Stores the throttle value and reports whether the drive command changed.

nodes.name: Traction_Input_PollBrake
nodes.summary: Stores the brake value and reports whether the drive command changed.

nodes.name: Traction_Input_PollDirectionEdge
nodes.summary: Stores a new direction and returns true only when it differs from the previous one.

nodes.name: Traction_Input_ResolveLever
nodes.summary: Splits the signed lever value into a throttle value along the reference direction and a brake value against it.

nodes.name: Traction_LeverReference
nodes.summary: Selects the direction the lever is read against by lever mode: the drive direction (or the lever's sign when unresolved) for brake-to-stop, the lever's sign for through-zero.

nodes.name: ADC_Conversion.h
nodes.summary: Application-layer ADC handle: ADC_Conversion_T names one channel on an ADC instance, and inline accessors mark it for conversion, test the mark, and read or clear its result while the ADC module owns the state.

nodes.name: ADC_Conversion_T
nodes.summary: Const application handle for one ADC conversion: a pointer to the result slot, the owning ADC instance and the channel index.

nodes.name: ADC_Conversion_Mark
nodes.summary: Marks the handle's channel on its ADC for conversion.

nodes.name: ADC_Conversion_GetResult
nodes.summary: Returns the latest conversion result of the handle's channel.

nodes.name: State.h
nodes.summary: Defines State_T, the const vtable that maps state machine inputs to output actions and transitions: ENTRY/EXIT/LOOP actions, the NEXT clock transition, the input transition table and mapper, command/accessor/action tables, and parent/top/depth links for hierarchical states. Also declares the id, input, and value scalar types and the handler function-pointer signatures.
nodes.languageNotes: State_T is typedef'd as `const struct State`, so every state instance is a ROM-resident vtable; optional members (EXIT, linked states) are compiled in by feature macros.

nodes.name: StateMachine.c
nodes.summary: Placeholder compilation unit for the public StateMachine module; it only includes StateMachine.h and the private State and StateMachine headers and defines no functions.

nodes.name: State_PathId.h
nodes.summary: Defines State_PathId_T, a 32-bit union that encodes the whole active sub-state path as eight 4-bit fields (root at the LSB, leaf toward the MSB), together with the field-width constants and the _STATE_ID macro that places an id at a given depth.
nodes.languageNotes: Id 0 at depth >= 1 is reserved as "no state at this level", which lets the depth be recovered from the value alone.

nodes.name: _State.h
nodes.summary: Private inline operations on a single State_T: resolving and calling input handlers, running the LOOP/NEXT synchronous output, entry and exit actions, and dispatch through the command, accessor, and action tables. Also provides State_Active_T, a minimal active-state holder for orthogonal sub-machines.

nodes.name: _StateMachine.c
nodes.summary: Implements the flat (top-level) state machine core over StateMachine_Active_T: reset, unconditional and conditional transitions, synchronous output, direct input calls, and the buffered sync-input and sync-transition processing combined in _StateMachine_ProcState.
nodes.languageNotes: Functions are defined `inline` here and declared `extern` in the header, so they inline within this compilation unit while still emitting an external definition.

nodes.name: _StateMachine.h
nodes.summary: Protected StateMachine interface for derived machines: the StateMachine_Active_T runtime record (active state, sync input buffer and mask, buffered next state, signal lock), inline getters and sync-buffer setters, vtable accessor wrappers, and extern declarations of the core processing functions.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Internal.h
nodes.summary: Internal helper header for StateMachine implementation files; it gathers the private State and StateMachine includes and defines the _STATE_INLINE always-inline attribute, with its template meta helpers currently commented out.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Lock.h
nodes.summary: Inline acquire/release helpers that synchronize asynchronous inputs with the periodic state process, selected at compile time between a global interrupt-disable critical section, an atomic-flag signal lock, or lock-free operation.
nodes.languageNotes: The strategy is chosen by STATE_MACHINE_ASYNC_CRITICAL / STATE_MACHINE_ASYNC_SIGNAL; with neither defined the helpers compile to no-ops that return true.

nodes.name: State_T
nodes.summary: Const state descriptor acting as a vtable: id, ENTRY/EXIT/LOOP actions, NEXT clock transition, input transition table and mapper, action/command/accessor tables, an adapter pointer, and the parent/top/depth/path-id links that mount it into a state hierarchy.

nodes.name: State_PathId_T
nodes.summary: Const union overlaying a 32-bit id with eight 4-bit depth fields, encoding the active state path from root (Depth0) to leaf.

nodes.name: State_TransitionOfOutput
nodes.summary: Runs a state's LOOP action when defined, then its NEXT handler, returning the next state or NULL when there is no clock-driven transition.

nodes.name: State_TransitionOfOutput_AsTop
nodes.summary: Top-level variant of the sync output step that calls LOOP without a NULL check (asserting depth 0) and returns the NEXT handler's result.

nodes.name: State_AcceptInput
nodes.summary: Resolves an input id to the state's handler: ids below the mapper threshold index P_TRANSITION_TABLE, higher ids go through TRANSITION_MAPPER, and NULL means the input is not accepted.

nodes.name: State_TransitionOfInput
nodes.summary: Looks up the handler for an input id and calls it with the input value, returning the next state, the same state for a self-transition, or NULL for an internal transition.

nodes.name: State_AcceptInput_AsTop
nodes.summary: Top-level input lookup that indexes the transition table directly with the low 8 bits of the id, asserting depth 0 and a non-NULL table.

nodes.name: State_TransitionOfInput_AsTop
nodes.summary: Resolves and calls a top-level state's input handler through the direct table lookup and returns the resulting next state.

nodes.name: State_Entry
nodes.summary: Calls the state's ENTRY action when one is defined.

nodes.name: State_Exit
nodes.summary: Calls the state's EXIT action when exit functions are compiled in, otherwise does nothing.

nodes.name: State_OnTransition
nodes.summary: Runs the exit action of the current state followed by the entry action of the new state.

nodes.name: _State_Reset
nodes.summary: Enters a non-NULL initial state and stores it in a State_Active_T holder.

nodes.name: _State_TransitionTo
nodes.summary: Unconditionally exits the holder's current state, enters the next state, and updates the active pointer.

nodes.name: _State_Transition
nodes.summary: Performs a transition on a State_Active_T holder only when the next state is non-NULL.

nodes.name: _State_Input
nodes.summary: Asynchronous input on a State_Active_T holder: resolves the input on the active state and applies the resulting transition immediately.

nodes.name: State_Cmd
nodes.summary: Invokes the command handler at the given index of the state's P_CMD_TABLE and returns its value, or 0 when the entry is NULL.

nodes.name: State_GetValue
nodes.summary: Reads a field through the getter of the state's accessor table entry, returning 0 when no getter is defined.

nodes.name: State_SetValue
nodes.summary: Writes a field through the setter of the state's accessor table entry when one is defined.

nodes.name: State_ActionInput
nodes.summary: Calls the action at the given index of the state's P_ACTION_TABLE when the table and entry exist, without any transition.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Reset
nodes.summary: Clears the buffered sync transition and input mask, runs the initial state's entry action, and sets it as the active state.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_TransitionTo
nodes.summary: Unconditional transition: exits the active state, enters the next state, then updates the active state pointer; the caller guarantees validity and thread context.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Transition
nodes.summary: Transitions to the next state only when it is non-NULL, treating NULL as no transition.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_InvokeTransition
nodes.summary: Calls a caller-supplied transition handler and applies its result only if the given start state is still the active state.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ProcSyncOutput
nodes.summary: Runs the active top state's LOOP and NEXT handlers and applies any transition they return.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_CallInput
nodes.summary: Resolves an input on the active top state, calls its handler with the value, and applies the resulting transition immediately.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ProcSyncInput
nodes.summary: Drains the sync input bit mask lowest bit first, dispatching each buffered input value through _StateMachine_CallInput, then clears the mask.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ProcSyncNextState
nodes.summary: Applies the buffered next state, if any, and clears the buffer.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ApplyInputSyncTransition
nodes.summary: Runs the input handler on the caller's thread but only buffers the returned state, deferring exit and entry to the next ProcState.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ProcState
nodes.summary: Periodic state process: applies the buffered transition, runs the sync output of the active state, then processes buffered sync inputs.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Active_T
nodes.summary: Runtime record of a state machine: the active (leaf) state pointer, the volatile sync input mask with its per-input value buffer, the buffered next state, and an atomic_flag input signal lock.

nodes.name: StateMachine_GetActiveState
nodes.summary: Returns the active state pointer; for a hierarchical machine this is the leaf state.

nodes.name: StateMachine_IsActiveState
nodes.summary: Tests whether the given state is exactly the active state.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_SetSyncInput
nodes.summary: Buffers an input value by id and sets its bit in the sync input mask for processing at the next ProcState.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_SetSyncTransition
nodes.summary: Stores a non-NULL next state in the sync transition buffer, leaving any pending state in place when given NULL.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Cmd
nodes.summary: Dispatches a command id to the active state's command table and returns its value without a transition.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_SetValue
nodes.summary: Sets a field through the active state's accessor table.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_GetValue
nodes.summary: Gets a field through the active state's accessor table.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ActionInput
nodes.summary: Invokes an action-table entry on the active leaf state only, without walking up the branch.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_AcquireAsyncIsr
nodes.summary: Lock acquire for the periodic state process: disables interrupts only when inputs can preempt it in critical mode, tries the signal flag in signal mode, and always succeeds when lock-free.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ReleaseAsyncIsr
nodes.summary: Releases the state-process side of the async lock by re-enabling interrupts or clearing the signal flag, depending on the configured mode.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_AcquireAsyncInput
nodes.summary: Lock acquire for an asynchronous input: disables interrupts in critical mode, or tries the signal flag and reports failure if the state process holds it.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ReleaseAsyncInput
nodes.summary: Releases the input-side async lock by unconditionally enabling interrupts or clearing the signal flag; nested use reopens interrupts early.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_AcquireAsyncTransition
nodes.summary: Acquires the lock for an asynchronous transition by delegating to the async input acquire.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ReleaseAsyncTransition
nodes.summary: Releases the lock for an asynchronous transition by delegating to the async input release.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_AcquireSyncInput
nodes.summary: Acquires the signal flag guarding the sync input buffer when the sync-input signal option is enabled, otherwise always succeeds.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ReleaseSyncInput
nodes.summary: Clears the sync-input signal flag when that option is enabled.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_EnterCritical
nodes.summary: Unconditionally disables interrupts for a state machine critical section and returns true.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ExitCritical
nodes.summary: Unconditionally re-enables interrupts at the end of a state machine critical section.

nodes.name: _State_Node.c
nodes.summary: Hierarchical state machine tree operations on State_T nodes: ancestor and descendant queries, common-ancestor search, upward traversal that resolves inputs and sync-output transitions (leaf-first or root-first), and exit-up/entry-down traversal for transitions between branches.
nodes.languageNotes: Traversals share one ApplyUpUntil loop driven by small visitor functions; entry order comes from recursion up the parent chain, so no path buffer is needed.

nodes.name: _State_Node.h
nodes.summary: Private header for State_T as a tree node: inline root lookup, sub-state test, PATH_ID construction and validation, and extern declarations of the hierarchy query, input resolution, and entry/exit traversal functions.

nodes.name: MotNvm.c
nodes.summary: Motor controller non-volatile storage service: initializes Flash and the optional EEPROM, writes and reads user config and the manufacturer block through the compile-time-selected backend, saves or loads every config partition in the descriptor table, and writes the phase board calibration records.
nodes.languageNotes: Backend selection (EEPROM vs Flash for user config, write-once vs Flash for the manufacturer block) is done with #if blocks inside each function.

nodes.name: MotNvm.h
nodes.summary: Declares the MotNvm_T descriptor (Flash/EEPROM handles, main config region, partition table, manufacturer block, boot reference) and the MotNvm_Entry_T NVM-to-RAM mapping, sets default backend selection macros, and exposes the MotNvm init, write, and save API.

nodes.name: EEPROM.c
nodes.summary: EEPROM driver built on the NvMemory base: defines the write operation control (skip-if-equal unit write, protection error parsing) and blocking init and write functions with optional compare verification.

nodes.name: EEPROM.h
nodes.summary: EEPROM module header that aliases the NvMemory base types as EEPROM_T and EEPROM_Partition_T, maps the HAL size constants, provides the EEPROM_INIT initializer macro, and declares the blocking init and write functions.

nodes.name: HAL_EEPROM.h
nodes.summary: HAL selector header that pulls in the chip-specific HAL_EEPROM.h through the HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH macro.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a computed `#include HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH(...)` so the chip implementation is chosen by build configuration.

nodes.name: Flash.c
nodes.summary: Flash driver built on the NvMemory base: wraps HAL flash commands into operation control tables for write, erase, verify, write-once, read-once, and erase-all, and provides blocking public functions that run each operation with interrupts disabled, including padded writes of unaligned remainders.
nodes.languageNotes: HAL command starters are placed in a RAM section (FLASH_ATTRIBUTE_RAM_SECTION) because code cannot execute from flash while it is being programmed.

nodes.name: State_IsAncestor
nodes.summary: Walks up the parent chain from the reference state, bounded by depth, to test whether the candidate is one of its ancestors.

nodes.name: State_IsDescendant
nodes.summary: Tests whether the candidate is a descendant of the reference state by reversing the ancestor test.

nodes.name: State_IsAncestorOrSelf
nodes.summary: Tests whether a state lies on the branch from the root to the active state, including the active state itself.

nodes.name: State_IsDirectLineage
nodes.summary: Tests whether two states are the same, or one is an ancestor or descendant of the other.

nodes.name: State_CommonAncestorOf
nodes.summary: Finds the lowest common ancestor of two states by levelling their depths and climbing both parent chains together; returns the parent for a self-transition and NULL across roots.

nodes.name: ApplyUpUntil
nodes.summary: Generic upward traversal that applies a visitor to each state from start up to, but excluding, the end state and stops at the first non-NULL result.

nodes.name: State_TransitionOfOutputUp
nodes.summary: Runs sync output from the leaf up to the root and returns the first transition any state in the branch produces.

nodes.name: State_TransitionOfOutputUpTo
nodes.summary: Runs sync output up the branch until a given end state (exclusive) and returns the first transition produced.

nodes.name: State_TransitionOfOutput_RootFirst
nodes.summary: Runs the root state's sync output first so the top level takes precedence, then the sub-states from the leaf upward if the root yields no transition.

nodes.name: State_AcceptInputUp
nodes.summary: Resolves an input id by walking from the leaf to the root and returning the first handler that accepts it.

nodes.name: State_TransitionOfInputUp
nodes.summary: Resolves an input leaf-first up the branch and calls the accepted handler, returning the next state.

nodes.name: State_AcceptInputUntil
nodes.summary: Resolves an input id walking up the branch from start until an exclusive end state.

nodes.name: State_TransitionOfInputUntil
nodes.summary: Resolves an input up the branch to an exclusive end state and calls the accepted handler.

nodes.name: State_AcceptInput_RootFirst
nodes.summary: Resolves an input on the root state's table first, then on the sub-states from the leaf upward when the root does not accept it.

nodes.name: State_TransitionOfInput_RootFirst
nodes.summary: Resolves an input root-first and calls the accepted handler, returning the next state.

nodes.name: ExitUp
nodes.summary: Calls exit actions from a state up to, but excluding, a target ancestor when exit functions are compiled in.

nodes.name: EntryDown
nodes.summary: Recursively climbs from the target state to the starting ancestor, then calls entry actions on the way back down so they run top-down.

nodes.name: State_TraverseEntryExitThrough
nodes.summary: Performs a branch transition through a known common ancestor: exits up from the start to the ancestor, then enters down to the end state, skipping the ancestor itself.

nodes.name: State_TraverseEntryExit
nodes.summary: Performs a branch transition between two states by computing their common ancestor and running the exit-up and entry-down traversal through it.

nodes.name: _State_GetRoot
nodes.summary: Returns the compile-time mapped top state of a node, or the node itself when P_TOP is NULL.

nodes.name: State_BuildPathId
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the path id of a state by walking its parent chain and OR-ing each id into its depth field.

nodes.name: State_IsPathIdValid
nodes.summary: Verifies a state's stored PATH_ID against the id rebuilt from its ancestry, also accepting a sub-state that reports its parent's path until numbered.

nodes.name: MotNvm_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the Flash driver and, when EEPROM is the user config backend, the EEPROM driver.

nodes.name: MotNvm_Write_Blocking
nodes.summary: Writes a RAM block to its NVM address through the selected user config backend, EEPROM or aligned Flash.

nodes.name: MotNvm_Read_Blocking
nodes.summary: Copies a block from its memory-mapped NVM address into a destination buffer.

nodes.name: MotNvm_ReadManufacture_Blocking
nodes.summary: Reads the manufacturer block either with the Flash read-once command or by a bounded copy from mapped Flash.

nodes.name: _MotNvm_WriteManufacture_Blocking
nodes.summary: Writes manufacturer data with the Flash write-once command or a normal Flash write, depending on the build option.

nodes.name: MotNvm_WriteManufacture_Blocking
nodes.summary: Guarded manufacturer write that reads the current contents first and skips the write when they already match or the source is blank.

nodes.name: MotNvm_SaveConfigAll_Blocking
nodes.summary: Saves every config partition to NVM: erases the main config region first on the Flash backend, then writes each descriptor entry and reports the last error.

nodes.name: MotNvm_LoadConfigAll
nodes.summary: Copies every config partition from its NVM address into its RAM image.

nodes.name: MotNvm_WritePhaseBoard
nodes.summary: Writes the 16-byte Phase_Board_T board reference record to its Flash location.

nodes.name: MotNvm_WritePhaseAnalogBoard
nodes.summary: Writes the Phase_AdcBoard_T analog board reference record to its Flash location.

nodes.name: MotNvm_Entry_T
nodes.summary: Config partition descriptor pairing an NVM address with its RAM image address and size in bytes.

nodes.name: MotNvm_T
nodes.summary: Const descriptor of the motor controller's NVM layout: Flash and optional EEPROM handles, main config region, partition table, manufacturer block location, and the boot reference pointer.

nodes.name: StartCmdWrite
nodes.summary: EEPROM write command starter that issues the HAL unit write only when the destination word differs from the source.

nodes.name: EEPROM_SetWrite
nodes.summary: Prepares an EEPROM write by binding the write operation control with the destination, source, and size.

nodes.name: EEPROM_Init_Blocking
nodes.summary: Initializes the EEPROM HAL and base state, disables verify, buffering, and forced alignment, then waits for the device ready flag.

nodes.name: EEPROM_Write_Blocking
nodes.summary: Sets up and runs a blocking EEPROM write, followed by a memory compare when verify is enabled.

nodes.name: Flash_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the Flash HAL and base NvMemory state and enables forced alignment.

nodes.name: ProcOp_Blocking
nodes.summary: Runs the prepared flash operation to completion with interrupts disabled, so no ISR vector stored in flash is invoked during programming.

nodes.name: WriteRemainder
nodes.summary: Writes the unaligned tail of a write by copying it into a write-unit buffer padded with the erase pattern and running one more aligned operation.

nodes.name: Flash_Write_Blocking
nodes.summary: Blocking flash write: programs the aligned portion, then pads and writes any unaligned remainder.

nodes.name: Flash_SetContinueWrite
nodes.summary: Validates the address range and prepares the operation state for a sequence of appended writes without supplying data.

nodes.name: Flash_ContinueWrite_Blocking
nodes.summary: Appends a write at the current operation address and advances it, requiring the previous write to have ended on an aligned boundary.

nodes.name: Flash_Erase_Blocking
nodes.summary: Blocking sector erase over an address range, with the size aligned up to the erase unit.

nodes.name: Flash_VerifyWrite_Blocking
nodes.summary: Verifies written data with the hardware verify command when available, otherwise by a direct memory compare.

nodes.name: Flash_VerifyErase_Blocking
nodes.summary: Blocking hardware check that an address range is erased.

nodes.name: Flash_WriteOnce_Blocking
nodes.summary: Blocking program of the write-once (OTP) area; the caller supplies aligned data.

nodes.name: Flash_ReadOnce_Blocking
nodes.summary: Blocking read of the write-once area into a caller buffer through the HAL read-once command.

nodes.name: Flash_EraseAll_Blocking
nodes.summary: Blocking erase of the entire flash device.

nodes.name: NvMemory.c
nodes.summary: Base implementation of non-volatile memory operations using a command pattern: validates the target address against partitions and alignment, sets operation size and data (optionally buffered), and runs the blocking per-unit command loop with completion/error flag polling and error parsing.
nodes.languageNotes: The per-command wait loop is forced non-inline and placed in a RAM section so it can run while flash is busy.

nodes.name: NvMemory.h
nodes.summary: Abstract base interface for non-volatile memory drivers: status codes, HAL function-pointer types, the per-operation control vtable, partition descriptors, runtime operation state, the const NvMemory_T device descriptor with initializer macros, alignment helpers, and declarations of the operation setup and processing functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Emulates an abstract base class in C: NvMemory_T holds HAL function pointers and a state pointer, and concrete drivers (Flash, EEPROM) typedef it and supply NvMemory_OpControl_T tables.

nodes.name: NvMemory_Map.h
nodes.summary: Draft header for a generic NVM-to-RAM mapping table with save-all and load-all helpers; its whole body is commented out, leaving only the NvMemory.h include.

nodes.name: BootRef.h
nodes.summary: Defines the BootRef_T boot option word stored at a fixed non-volatile address (validity pattern, fast boot, beep, blink flags) and inline queries that fall back to defaults when the word has never been written.
nodes.languageNotes: A 2-bit validity field (01 or 10 valid, 00 or 11 invalid) distinguishes written data from both erased-memory patterns.

nodes.name: Critical.c
nodes.summary: Defines the global nesting counter _Critical_InterruptDisableCount used by the nested interrupt disable/enable functions in Critical.h.

nodes.name: Critical.h
nodes.summary: Critical-section primitives for bare-metal Cortex-M: raw and PRIMASK-saving interrupt disable/enable, a nesting-counted global disable/enable pair, and a lightweight atomic_flag try-lock with acquire, release, and blocking await.

nodes.name: ProcCmd_Blocking
nodes.summary: RAM-resident step that starts one HAL command for the current unit and polls the complete and error flags, calling the optional yield callback while waiting.

nodes.name: NvMemory_ProcOp_Blocking
nodes.summary: Runs the prepared operation unit by unit: clears error flags, issues each command, maps hardware errors through the operation's parser, and calls the finalize hook; returns busy if the device is not ready.

nodes.name: NvMemory_Init
nodes.summary: Sets the default operation options: buffering when a buffer is allocated, verify enabled, and forced alignment enabled.

nodes.name: NvMemory_MemCompare
nodes.summary: Software verify by memcmp, returning success or a verify error status.

nodes.name: SearchPartitionTable
nodes.summary: Finds the first partition whose address range fully contains the requested address and size.

nodes.name: NvMemory_SetOpAddress
nodes.summary: Stores the operation address and checks that the range fits a partition and that the address is aligned to the operation unit size.

nodes.name: NvMemory_SetOpSize
nodes.summary: Stores the operation size and derives the aligned size, either by the operation's force-align function or by requiring exact alignment.

nodes.name: NvMemory_SetOpData
nodes.summary: Sets the operation data pointer, copying the source into the internal buffer first when buffered mode is enabled and the data fits.

nodes.name: NvMemory_SetOpControl
nodes.summary: Binds an operation control table and validates the address and size for it.

nodes.name: NvMemory_SetOpControl_Read
nodes.summary: Sets up an operation with an output buffer that receives data captured by the finalize hook.

nodes.name: NvMemory_SetOpControl_Write
nodes.summary: Sets up an operation together with its input data source.

nodes.name: NvMemory_OpControl_T
nodes.summary: Per-operation vtable: HAL start-command, finalize, and error-parse functions with the unit size and force-align function for that command type.

nodes.name: NvMemory_Partition_T
nodes.summary: Writable address range descriptor (start address, size, optional hardware op-address offset) used for boundary checks.

nodes.name: NvMemory_State_T
nodes.summary: Mutable operation state: the bound operation control, address, size, aligned size, data pointer, option flags, and the yield callback.

nodes.name: NvMemory_T
nodes.summary: Const device descriptor serving as the abstract base for Flash and EEPROM: HAL pointer and flag functions, state pointer, partition table, and internal buffer.

nodes.name: BootRef_T
nodes.summary: Word-aligned union of boot option bit fields (2-bit validity, FastBoot, Beep, Blink) over a volatile 32-bit word.

nodes.name: _Critical_DisableIrq
nodes.summary: Disables interrupts globally through the CMSIS __disable_irq intrinsic.

nodes.name: _Critical_EnableIrq
nodes.summary: Enables interrupts globally through the CMSIS __enable_irq intrinsic.

nodes.name: Critical_DisableIrq
nodes.summary: Disables interrupts and increments the global nesting counter.

nodes.name: Critical_EnableIrq
nodes.summary: Decrements the nesting counter and re-enables interrupts only when it reaches zero.

nodes.name: Critical_AcquireLock
nodes.summary: Non-blocking try-lock on an atomic_flag, returning true when the lock was free.

nodes.name: Critical_ReleaseLock
nodes.summary: Releases the atomic_flag lock.

nodes.name: Datagram.c
nodes.summary: Implements Datagram mode: validates and installs a host-supplied var mapping, packs the mapped values into datagram payloads, and runs the ack-paced streaming exchange as a resumable Protocol request handler.

nodes.name: Datagram.h
nodes.summary: Declares Datagram mode, a host-configured set of variables streamed continuously over the request engine: map entry encoding, the application binding interface, wire payloads, status codes and the per-run state kept in the socket's sub-state buffer.

nodes.name: Protocol_DataMode.h
nodes.summary: Header-only stateful bulk transfer (Read and Write) above the packet layer: an opening request declares an address and size, then chunk frames follow, paced by host acks for a read and by the data frames for a write. Built in three tiers (outer handlers, typed step handlers, cursor utilities), with each pass classified from the arriving id and the cursor rather than from stored progress.
nodes.languageNotes: Step handlers keep the Protocol_ProcReqResp_T shape with narrowed pointer types, so the outer switch dispatches without casts: void * converts implicitly to any object pointer.

nodes.name: Protocol_FlashLoader.h
nodes.summary: Adapts a Flash_T to the generic Protocol_DataMode_Ops_T memory operations (open, read, write) and provides the PROTOCOL_FLASH_LOADER macro that builds a DataMode interface for flash transfers.

nodes.name: _Datagram_StatusOfMap
nodes.summary: Validates a requested mapping read from the packed request: entry count within DATAGRAM_MAP_MAX, each width 1, 2 or 4 bytes, and the total within one payload.

nodes.name: Datagram_Begin
nodes.summary: Rewrites the run whole from the opening request: validates the map, records the cycle budget and request id, and copies the accepted entries into the state.

nodes.name: Datagram_Build
nodes.summary: Packs one datagram by fetching each mapped var through the application GET callback and writing its bytes in map order; returns the bytes written.

nodes.name: Datagram_Data
nodes.summary: Step handler that stages one datagram as the response, labels it with the data id and advances the cycle count.

nodes.name: Datagram_Malformed
nodes.summary: Step handler for an opening request too short to carry its fixed fields: replies with a malformed status under the arriving id and closes.

nodes.name: _Datagram_StateIdOf
nodes.summary: Classifies a pass as open, error, idle, data or close from the arriving packet id and the run, never from stored progress.

nodes.name: Datagram_Proc
nodes.summary: Outer request handler in the Protocol_ProcReqResp_T shape: derives the pass state and dispatches to the open, data, close, malformed or idle step.

nodes.name: Datagram_Interface_T
nodes.summary: Application binding for Datagram mode: the GET callback and its context, the config and data packet ids, and the payload length bound.

nodes.name: Datagram_State_T
nodes.summary: Per-run Datagram state held in the socket's sub-state buffer: the installed map, cycle budget and count, the echoed request id and the last status.

nodes.name: Protocol_DataMode_Ops_T
nodes.summary: Function table of application memory operations (OPEN, READ, WRITE), each returning an application status with 0 for success.

nodes.name: Protocol_DataMode_Interface_T
nodes.summary: Application binding shared by read and write transfers: the ops table, module context, the read, write, data and status packet ids, and the chunk size bound.

nodes.name: Protocol_DataMode_State_T
nodes.summary: Transfer cursor held in the socket's sub-state buffer: base address, declared size, bytes transferred, the echoed request id and the last op status.

nodes.name: Protocol_DataMode_ReadChunk
nodes.summary: Reads the next chunk, clamped to CHUNK_MAX, through the application READ op into the tx payload, advances the cursor and labels the frame as data.

nodes.name: Protocol_DataMode_Reply
nodes.summary: Stages a status reply under the given id and returns the continuation code; any non-OK status closes the transfer.

nodes.name: Protocol_DataMode_Open
nodes.summary: Opening step shared by both directions: sets the cursor from the request, calls the application OPEN op and replies with the result; a zero-size transfer completes here.

nodes.name: Protocol_DataMode_Read
nodes.summary: Outer read handler: the device streams memory to the host, one chunk per pacing ack until the cursor is spent, then a closing status.

nodes.name: _DataModeWrite_StateOf
nodes.summary: Classifies a write pass from the arriving id and the cursor: open, idle on a pacing ack, overrun, data, or close on the last chunk.

nodes.name: Protocol_DataMode_Write
nodes.summary: Outer write handler: the host streams memory to the device, each data frame absorbed with ACCEPT, and only the opening request and the last chunk earn a status reply.

nodes.name: Protocol_FlashLoader_Open
nodes.summary: DataMode OPEN op for flash: arms the controller's continue-write cursor for the declared address and size.

nodes.name: Protocol_FlashLoader_Read
nodes.summary: DataMode READ op for flash: copies a chunk straight out of memory-mapped flash.

nodes.name: Protocol_FlashLoader_Write
nodes.summary: DataMode WRITE op for flash: writes a chunk at the cursor armed by Open through the blocking continue-write.

nodes.name: Packet.h
nodes.summary: Defines the packet layer vocabulary shared by the whole protocol stack: normalized frame metadata, the buffer allocation context, per-id frame shapes and the Packet_Codec_T table of framing callbacks, plus frame-length, packet-class and checksum helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: PACKET_CONTEXT_ALLOC declares the buffer as a union containing Packet_Context_T so that reading the storage back as the struct is defined under strict aliasing; alignas alone fixes the address, not the effective type.

nodes.name: Packet_RxParser.h
nodes.summary: Pure, sans-I/O frame boundary parser: a three-state machine (start delimiter, length resolution, frame end) that tells the caller how many bytes it needs next and resolves each frame as complete, unframeable, invalid or timed out.

nodes.name: Protocol.h
nodes.summary: Composition layer of the protocol engine and the only one that owns the Xcvr and the clock: it drains bytes into the parser, folds frames and deadlines into sync events, dispatches the bound request handler, and transmits responses, acks and retransmissions in one non-blocking pass.
nodes.languageNotes: Protocol_T overlays its buffer pointers with a Packet_Xfer_T through an anonymous union, backed by static_assert offsetof checks, so the engine sees whole buffers while handlers see only Meta from one flash-resident object.

nodes.name: Protocol_Request.h
nodes.summary: Request dispatch layer: looks up the handler for an incoming packet id in a const request table, binds it for the life of the exchange, and invokes it as a resumable handler whose Protocol_ReqCode_T tells the engine what to send next.

nodes.name: Packet_Meta_T
nodes.summary: Normalized virtual header of a frame (id, payload length, sequence, source, dest, flags) that decouples handlers from the wire header shape.

nodes.name: Packet_Context_T
nodes.summary: Buffer allocation context pairing a Packet_Meta_T with the contiguous physical header and payload bytes.

nodes.name: Packet_FrameFormat_T
nodes.summary: Const frame shape (header, fixed body and trailer lengths) that fixes the payload offsets for a packet id.

nodes.name: Packet_Codec_T
nodes.summary: Const codec table for one framing: length bounds, start delimiter, the Rx length, validation and parse callbacks, the Tx frame builder, control ids and the frame timeout.

nodes.name: Packet_FrameLengthOf
nodes.summary: Total frame length for a format and Meta: header plus trailer plus the fixed or Meta-declared body length.

nodes.name: Packet_ControlIdOf
nodes.summary: Maps a packet class (ack, nack, abort) to the control id declared by the codec.

nodes.name: Packet_ClassOf
nodes.summary: Classifies a packet id as ack, nack, abort or data from the control ids declared on the codec.

nodes.name: Packet_Checksum
nodes.summary: Default additive 16-bit checksum over a frame excluding the checksum field, choosing the header or trailer form by where the field sits.

nodes.name: Packet_RxParser_T
nodes.summary: Frame parser progress: state, bytes held, bytes still needed, the parser's own resolved frame length and the frame deadline base.

nodes.name: Packet_ProcRxParser
nodes.summary: Byte event of the frame parser: scans for the start delimiter, grows the header until the codec's PARSE_RX_LENGTH yields a bounded frame length, then validates the complete frame with IS_RX_VALID.

nodes.name: Packet_ProcRxTimeout
nodes.summary: Time event of the frame parser: resolves a frame stalled part way as a timeout error once the codec's RX_TIMEOUT elapses.

nodes.name: Protocol_Binding_T
nodes.summary: Const unit selected together: the codec, the request table, the app context passed to every handler, the exchange timeout and a default ack policy.

nodes.name: Protocol_State_T
nodes.summary: Mutable engine state of one socket: Rx parser, sync handshake, request dispatch, last complete frame time and the link diagnostic counters.

nodes.name: Protocol_T
nodes.summary: Flash-resident per-socket wiring: the Rx and Tx buffers and sub-state overlaid with the handler's Packet_Xfer_T, plus pointers to the engine state and the timer.

nodes.name: Protocol_TxResponse
nodes.summary: Builds the frame header of the staged response through the codec and transmits the frame on the Xcvr.

nodes.name: Protocol_TxControl
nodes.summary: Builds and transmits a payload-less control frame (ack, nack or abort) from a local buffer so the staged response survives for retransmission.

nodes.name: Protocol_CaptureRx
nodes.summary: Drains the Xcvr into the frame buffer, feeding the sans-I/O parser exactly the bytes the current frame still needs.

nodes.name: Protocol_Reset
nodes.summary: Full reset of the engine state: drops any frame in progress together with the request and sync exchange, while the counters survive.

nodes.name: Protocol_Init
nodes.summary: Stamps every deadline base (frame, ack, last complete frame) with the current timer reading.

nodes.name: Protocol_ProcRxFrame
nodes.summary: Turns incoming bytes into one intact frame and its Meta, applies the frame deadline after draining, nacks unusable frames and updates the link statistics.

nodes.name: Protocol_StartRequest
nodes.summary: Binds the handler for an arriving data frame from the request table, nacks an unknown id or an inconsistent frame, and sends the arrival ack when the handler's policy asks for it.

nodes.name: Protocol_ProcRequest
nodes.summary: Invokes the bound handler with payload pointers offset by the row's frame format, then acts on its verdict: transmit the response and arm or clear the ack wait, ack, nack or abort.

nodes.name: Protocol_Proc
nodes.summary: One pass of the engine: receive a frame or a deadline, derive a single sync event, then act on it by starting or resuming a request, retransmitting, aborting, rejecting or failing.

nodes.name: Packet_Xfer_T
nodes.summary: Handler context: the Rx Meta of the frame that caused the call, the Tx Meta the handler fills in, and the handler's own sub-state storage.
