nodes.name: Protocol_Req_T
nodes.summary: Request table entry binding a packet id and its frame format to one resumable PROC handler and an ack policy.

nodes.name: Protocol_ReqState_T
nodes.summary: Dispatch state: idle, opening or step, with the request row bound for the life of the exchange.

nodes.name: Protocol_CaptureReqOfTable
nodes.summary: Binds the request-table row for an incoming id and enters OPENING; a request already in STEP keeps its binding without a new lookup.

nodes.name: _Protocol_ProcReq
nodes.summary: Invokes the bound handler's PROC; unbinds on DONE or ABORT, otherwise moves the request to STEP for the next pass.

nodes.name: Protocol_Sync.h
nodes.summary: Sender-side stop-and-wait ARQ with a window of one: a two-state handshake (open, awaiting ack) that turns classified frames and deadline expiry into sync events such as request, resume, retransmit, abort and failed, under a per-handler ack policy.

nodes.name: Socket.c
nodes.summary: Socket lifecycle and selection: initializes from the NVM config, enables and disables the port, switches the Xcvr or baud rate only while idle, and exposes config fields through an id-keyed getter and setter.

nodes.name: Socket.h
nodes.summary: Defines a protocol socket instance: one Xcvr selection, one Protocol_T engine and one Protocol_Binding_T with NVM-backed port configuration, plus the non-blocking Socket_Proc pass, status queries and the link-liveness Rx watchdog.

nodes.name: MotPacket.c
nodes.summary: Implements the MotPacket wire codec bound into MOT_PACKET_CODEC: checksum, sync and data header builders, id-driven frame length parsing, validation and Meta extraction for the two frame shapes (4-byte sync, 8-byte header data).

nodes.name: Protocol_AckPolicy_T
nodes.summary: Per-handler ack policy bitfield: send and expect acks for the opening exchange and for continuation steps, ack on abort, and the retransmit budget.

nodes.name: Protocol_SyncState_T
nodes.summary: Handshake state: open or awaiting ack, retries spent, the budget and frame shape latched at transmit for retransmission, and the ack deadline base.

nodes.name: _Protocol_EvaluatePacket
nodes.summary: Pure evaluation of what an arriving frame class means given the handshake state: request, resume, retransmit, reject, abort or nothing.

nodes.name: Protocol_ExpectAck
nodes.summary: Enters AWAIT_ACK after a response goes out, latching the retry budget, the frame shape for retransmission and the ack deadline base.

nodes.name: _Protocol_ResolveSync
nodes.summary: The single place sync state moves: applies an event's state change, retry count and deadline re-arm.

nodes.name: Protocol_ProcSyncPacket
nodes.summary: Folds one classified frame into the handshake and returns the resulting sync event.

nodes.name: Protocol_ProcSyncTimeout
nodes.summary: Time event of the handshake: once the exchange deadline expires, yields a retransmit or a failure event.

nodes.name: Socket_Disable
nodes.summary: Resets the protocol engine and marks the socket disabled.

nodes.name: Socket_Enable
nodes.summary: Configures the selected Xcvr's baud rate, resets the engine, restamps the deadlines and enables the socket; fails when no Xcvr is selected.

nodes.name: Socket_SetXcvr
nodes.summary: Selects a transport from the instance's Xcvr table while the socket is idle, discarding bytes buffered from the old port.

nodes.name: Socket_SetBaudRate
nodes.summary: Stores a new baud rate and applies it to the Xcvr when enabled; refused while an exchange is in flight.

nodes.name: Socket_Init
nodes.summary: Loads the NVM config, stamps the deadlines, selects the stored Xcvr and enables the socket when configured to start on init.

nodes.name: _Socket_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a socket config field by Socket_ConfigId_T from the state's working copy.

nodes.name: _Socket_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a socket config field by Socket_ConfigId_T into the state's working copy.

nodes.name: Socket_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Null-safe wrapper that reads a config field by id from a socket instance.

nodes.name: Socket_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Null-safe wrapper that writes a config field by id on a socket instance.

nodes.name: Socket_Config_T
nodes.summary: NVM-backed port configuration: Xcvr and format selection, baud rate, frame, request and watchdog timeouts, and enable-on-init.

nodes.name: Socket_State_T
nodes.summary: Mutable socket state: the selected Xcvr, the working copy of the config, the enabled flag and the Rx watchdog arming.

nodes.name: Socket_T
nodes.summary: Const socket instance: state pointer, Protocol_T engine wiring, Protocol_Binding_T, buffer length, the selectable Xcvr table and the initial NVM config.

nodes.name: Socket_Proc
nodes.summary: One non-blocking pass of the socket: runs the protocol engine with the selected Xcvr when the socket is enabled.

nodes.name: Socket_StatusOf
nodes.summary: Reports the socket as disabled, busy with an exchange, part way through a frame, or idle.

nodes.name: Socket_IsRxLost
nodes.summary: Link-liveness watchdog: true when armed and no intact frame has arrived within the configured WatchdogTimeout.

nodes.name: MotPacket_Checksum
nodes.summary: 16-bit sum checksum over a MotPacket frame, excluding the header's checksum field.

nodes.name: MotPacket_BuildControl
nodes.summary: Builds a 4-byte sync control frame (ping, ack, nack, abort) with its XOR check byte.

nodes.name: MotPacket_BuildHeader
nodes.summary: Fills the 8-byte data header (start, id, total length) and computes the checksum once the payload is written.

nodes.name: IsSyncShape
nodes.summary: Tells whether a packet id uses the 4-byte sync frame shape; must agree with MotPacket_ParseLength.

nodes.name: MotPacket_ParseLength
nodes.summary: Codec phase 1: returns the total frame length from the id (sync and fixed-length packets) or from the header length field, 0 while unknown, and a value past the maximum for an impossible length.

nodes.name: MotProtocol_IsRxValid
nodes.summary: Codec phase 2: checks the 16-bit checksum of a complete data frame; sync frames pass by their length.

nodes.name: MotProtocol_ParseRxHeader
nodes.summary: Extracts id, payload length, sequence and flags from a complete frame into Packet_Meta_T, writing every field for both frame shapes.

nodes.name: MotProtocol_BuildTxHeader
nodes.summary: Builds the Tx frame header from Meta, choosing the sync or the data shape by id.

nodes.name: MotPacket.h
nodes.summary: Defines the MotPacket wire format of the motor controller serial protocol: packet id opcodes, sync and data header layouts, the packet union, and packed request and response payload structs for version, stop, call, variable, memory and data-mode commands.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a C23 fixed-underlying-type enum (enum : uint8_t) when available, and packed 4-byte-aligned structs as transparent data transfer objects.

nodes.name: MotProtocol.c
nodes.summary: Fixed flash loader handlers for MotProtocol with a Flash_T bound directly as the app context: stateful ack-paced read, data-paced write and blocking erase of flash regions over the DataMode cursor.

nodes.name: MotProtocol.h
nodes.summary: Declares the MotProtocol fixed flash loader request handlers (read, write, erase) that register through PROTOCOL_REQ with a Flash_T as the app context, and gathers the MotPacket, Protocol and FlashLoader headers.

nodes.name: MotorController_Include.h
nodes.summary: Umbrella header that pulls in the MotorController application, thread, MotProtocol and user interface headers together with the per-motor includes.

nodes.name: MotPacket_Header_T
nodes.summary: 8-byte data frame header: start byte, id, total frame length, sequence, 16-bit checksum and flags.

nodes.name: MotPacket_Control_T
nodes.summary: 4-byte sync control frame: start byte, sync id, option and XOR check byte, carrying no payload.

nodes.name: MotPacket_T
nodes.summary: Union view of a MotPacket buffer as a prefix, a long data frame, a control frame or raw bytes.

nodes.name: MotProtocol_FlashLoader_Open
nodes.summary: Shared opening step: refuses a short request, sets the transfer cursor and arms the flash continue-write, replying with the status.

nodes.name: MotProtocol_FlashLoader_ReadData
nodes.summary: Stages the next chunk copied from memory-mapped flash, or the closing status once the cursor is spent.

nodes.name: MotProtocol_FlashLoader_Read
nodes.summary: Stateful ack-paced flash read handler that dispatches to the open and read-data steps.

nodes.name: MotProtocol_FlashLoader_WriteData
nodes.summary: Writes one arriving chunk to flash: refuses an overrun, silently accepts intermediate chunks, and replies with the status on a fault or on completion.

nodes.name: MotProtocol_FlashLoader_Write
nodes.summary: Stateful data-paced flash write handler that dispatches to the open and write-data steps.

nodes.name: MotProtocol_FlashLoader_Erase_Blocking
nodes.summary: Blocking erase of the flash region declared by the request, replying with the flash status.

nodes.name: MotorController_MotProtocol.c
nodes.summary: MotProtocol request handlers over MotorController_T (ping, version, stop all, system call, single and batched variable read/write, memory read/write, optional data-mode flash transfers) and the request table binding each packet id to its handler, frame shape and ack policy.

nodes.name: MotorController_MotProtocol.h
nodes.summary: Declares the MotorController MotProtocol request table and provides packet-to-variable helpers that read and write single, 16-bit and 32-bit batched vars through the MotorController Var interface, plus the memory-region selector enum.

nodes.name: MotorController_Var.h
nodes.summary: Field-like property interface of the motor controller: enumerates controller-level var ids (outputs, user inputs, NVM config, board reference, debug) and declares the id-keyed getter and setter used by the wire protocol.

nodes.name: Version.h
nodes.summary: Motor library software version constants and the Version_Flags_T bitfield reporting which precompile features (field weakening, open loop, electrical calibration, open-loop fallback) are built in.

nodes.name: Ping
nodes.summary: Answers a ping with a bare sync ack frame that the codec builds from the id alone.

nodes.name: Version
nodes.summary: Reports the protocol, library and firmware version words.

nodes.name: StopAll
nodes.summary: Forces control off on all motors and replies with a success status.

nodes.name: Call_Blocking
nodes.summary: Runs a MotorController system command by id with one argument and returns its status; may block.

nodes.name: ReadVar
nodes.summary: Reads a single 32-bit var by MotVarId.

nodes.name: WriteVar
nodes.summary: Writes a single 32-bit var by MotVarId and returns its status.

nodes.name: Var16Read
nodes.summary: Reads up to 16 vars as 16-bit values, with the count bounded to the response payload.

nodes.name: Var16Write
nodes.summary: Writes up to 8 id and value pairs of 16-bit vars and returns a status per var.

nodes.name: ReadVar32
nodes.summary: Reads up to 8 vars as 32-bit values, with the count bounded to the response payload.

nodes.name: WriteVar32
nodes.summary: Writes up to 4 32-bit vars and returns a status per var.

nodes.name: ReadMem_Blocking
nodes.summary: Reads a memory region selected by the request's config (RAM, write-once manufacture data, board reference), gated by the controller's config state.

nodes.name: WriteMem_Blocking
nodes.summary: Writes write-once manufacture data or a phase board record to NVM, gated by the config state and size bounds.

nodes.name: ReadData
nodes.summary: Data-mode read handler, compiled only in flash loader builds, that delegates to Protocol_DataMode_Read with a flash-backed interface.

nodes.name: WriteData_Blocking
nodes.summary: Data-mode write handler, compiled only in flash loader builds, that delegates to Protocol_DataMode_Write with a flash-backed interface.

nodes.name: MotorController_ReadVar
nodes.summary: Fills a single-var read response from MotorController_Var_Get and returns the payload length.

nodes.name: MotorController_WriteVar
nodes.summary: Applies a single-var write through MotorController_Var_Set and returns the status payload length.

nodes.name: MotorController_ReadVar32s
nodes.summary: Reads a batch of vars as 32-bit values into the response and returns the payload length.

nodes.name: MotorController_WriteVar32s
nodes.summary: Writes a batch of 32-bit vars and records a status per var in the response.

nodes.name: MotorController_ReadVar16s
nodes.summary: Reads a batch of vars truncated to 16-bit values into the response and returns the payload length.

nodes.name: MotorController_WriteVar16s
nodes.summary: Writes a batch of 16-bit id and value pairs and records a status per var in the response.

nodes.name: Flash.h
nodes.summary: Flash memory interface layered on the generic NvMemory module: aliases Flash_T with its status and partition types, maps the HAL unit sizes, and declares the blocking write, erase, verify, write-once and continue-write operations.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Sync.h
nodes.summary: Extension that runs a StateMachine_T as a fully synchronous machine: one periodic call processes the buffered inputs under the sync-input guard and then runs the active state's output. Intended for machines whose inputs are all set with SetInput and handled on the state machine's own tick.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Sync_ProcState
nodes.summary: Periodic step of a synchronous machine: acquires the sync-input guard to process the buffered inputs, releases it, then runs the active state's synchronous output and any transition it returns.

nodes.name: StateMachine.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of the state machine framework: the StateMachine_T handle (owner context, runtime state, machine definition) and guarded input, transition and accessor functions for both flat and hierarchical (tree) machines. Wraps the two-pointer _StateMachine core and the lock selection in one layer.
nodes.languageNotes: The public functions are defined static in the header, one copy per including translation unit, so the compiler can fold the const StateMachine_T handle into direct calls on the shared _StateMachine implementation.

nodes.name: StateMachine_TransitionCmd_T
nodes.summary: Compile-time transition command pairing a known starting state (P_START) with the input handler (NEXT) that yields the next state, for inputs that are valid from one state or branch only.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Machine_T
nodes.summary: Shared, stateless machine definition holding the initial state and the transition table length common to all states; plays the role of a vtable for every instance of the same machine.

nodes.name: StateMachine_T
nodes.summary: Const state machine handle binding the owner context pointer, the mutable runtime state (StateMachine_Active_T) and the machine definition; the object passed to every public StateMachine function.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Init
nodes.summary: Resets the runtime state to the machine's initial state, running its entry action, then releases the input signal lock so inputs are accepted.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Reset
nodes.summary: Returns the machine to its initial state under the async input guard; the current state's exit action is not run.

nodes.name: StateMachine_InputAsyncTransition
nodes.summary: Applies an input immediately: under the async input guard, calls the active state's handler for the input id and performs the resulting top-level transition (exit, then entry).

nodes.name: StateMachine_InputSyncTransition
nodes.summary: Evaluates the input's transition handler now but buffers the resulting state change, which is applied on the next synchronous process step.

nodes.name: StateMachine_SetInput
nodes.summary: Buffers an input id and value under the sync-input guard for handling on the next synchronous process step; a repeated set overwrites, so only the last value is processed.

nodes.name: StateMachine_ApplyInput
nodes.summary: Selection point for the default input discipline; currently forwards to StateMachine_InputAsyncTransition.

nodes.name: StateMachine_ForceTransition
nodes.summary: Transitions directly to a compile-time-known state under the async transition guard without consulting the input table, e.g. to enter a fault state.

nodes.name: StateMachine_InvokeTransition
nodes.summary: Invokes a StateMachine_TransitionCmd_T under the transition guard: the handler runs and the machine transitions only when the active state is the command's starting state.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Tree_InputAsyncTransition
nodes.summary: Hierarchical async input: under the input guard, resolves the input from the active leaf state up through its ancestors and traverses to the resulting state.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Tree_InputSyncTransition
nodes.summary: Hierarchical input that resolves its handler up the active branch immediately but defers the resulting transition to the next synchronous process step.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Tree_Input
nodes.summary: Default input entry for hierarchical machines; forwards to StateMachine_Tree_InputAsyncTransition.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Tree_InvokeTransition
nodes.summary: Invokes a transition command on a hierarchical machine: runs when the command's starting state lies on the active branch, then traverses exit and entry actions to the next state.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Tree_InputRootFirst
nodes.summary: Applies an input to a hierarchical machine with root-first resolution under the async input guard: the root state is checked once before the leaf-to-ancestor walk.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Tree_InputRootOnly
nodes.summary: Applies an input to the root (top-level) state's handler only, under the async input guard, and traverses to the state it returns.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Thread.h
nodes.summary: Thread entry points that run a state machine's synchronous process step from a periodic thread or ISR under the async ISR guard, in flat, root-first hierarchical and leaf-up hierarchical variants.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Synchronous_Thread
nodes.summary: Runs one flat-machine process step (pending transition, output, buffered inputs) on the runtime state and context when the async ISR guard is acquired, and skips the step otherwise.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Synchronous_Thread
nodes.summary: Handle-based wrapper that runs the flat synchronous process step for a StateMachine_T.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Synchronous_RootFirst
nodes.summary: Runs one root-first hierarchical process cycle on the runtime state and context under the async ISR guard.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Synchronous_RootFirst_Thread
nodes.summary: Handle-based wrapper that runs the root-first hierarchical process cycle for a StateMachine_T.

nodes.name: StateMachine_Hsm_Thread
nodes.summary: Periodic step for a hierarchical machine that uses asynchronous inputs only: under the ISR guard, runs the active branch's synchronous output from the leaf upward and applies any resulting transition.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Tree.c
nodes.summary: Hierarchical state machine core: traversal transitions that run exit and entry actions between the active leaf and a target state, and the leaf-up (Branch) and root-first routines for output, immediate input, buffered input and buffered transition built on them.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_TraverseTransitionTo
nodes.summary: Runs the exit and entry actions along the path from the active leaf state to a known-valid target state, then makes the target the active state.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_TraverseTransition
nodes.summary: Null-tolerant traversal transition: traverses to the given state only when it is non-NULL, NULL meaning no transition.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_InvokeTraverseTransition
nodes.summary: Runs an input handler and traverses to its result only when the test state lies on the active branch, for transitions mapped to specific states.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Branch_ProcSyncOutput
nodes.summary: Runs the synchronous output of the active branch from the leaf up toward the root and traverses to the transition it yields.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Branch_CallInput
nodes.summary: Resolves an input from the active leaf up through its ancestors and transitions immediately to the returned state.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Branch_ProcSyncInput
nodes.summary: Drains the buffered sync inputs by iterating the set bits of the input mask, applying each through the branch input handler, then clears the mask.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Branch_ProcSyncTransition
nodes.summary: Applies the transition buffered by an earlier input, if any, and clears the pending next state.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Branch_ApplyAsyncInput
nodes.summary: Resolves an input up the active branch and stores the resulting state as the pending transition for the next process step.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Branch_Proc
nodes.summary: Full leaf-up process cycle: the pending transition first, then the branch output, then the buffered sync inputs.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_RootFirst_ProcSyncOutput
nodes.summary: Runs synchronous output with root-first precedence, the root state once and then the leaf-to-ancestor walk excluding the root, and traverses to the resulting transition.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_RootFirst_CallInput
nodes.summary: Resolves an input with root-first precedence and transitions immediately to the returned state.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_RootOnly_CallInput
nodes.summary: Applies an input to the root state's handler only and traverses to the state it returns.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_RootFirst_ProcSyncInput
nodes.summary: Drains the buffered sync input mask, applying each input with root-first resolution, then clears the mask.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_RootFirst_ProcSyncTransition
nodes.summary: Applies the pending buffered transition, to a root-level or branch target, and clears it.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_RootFirst_ApplyAsyncInput
nodes.summary: Resolves an input root-first and buffers the resulting state as the pending transition; the last input wins.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_RootFirst_Proc
nodes.summary: Full root-first process cycle: the pending transition, then output transitions, then buffered sync inputs, so the effect of a sync input appears one cycle later.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_Tree.h
nodes.summary: Hierarchical state machine header, modelled as a parent-node tree following UML conventions: inline queries on the active state path (root, leaf, branch membership, sub-state id, path id) and declarations of the traversal, Branch and RootFirst routines implemented in _StateMachine_Tree.c.

nodes.name: StateMachine_GetRootState
nodes.summary: Returns the top-level (root) ancestor of the active state.

nodes.name: StateMachine_GetLeafState
nodes.summary: Returns the active state, which in the hierarchical model is the leaf of the active branch.

nodes.name: StateMachine_IsActiveBranch
nodes.summary: Tests whether a state is the active leaf or one of its ancestors, i.e. lies on the active path.

nodes.name: StateMachine_GetActiveSubStateId
nodes.summary: Returns the active leaf's id when the leaf is a descendant of the given ancestor state, otherwise STATE_ID_NULL.

nodes.name: StateMachine_GetPathId
nodes.summary: Returns the active leaf's PATH_ID, one value for the full root-to-leaf path that stays unambiguous when sibling branches reuse leaf ids; asserts that the state defines one.

nodes.name: _StateMachine_ActionInputRootState
nodes.summary: Dispatches an action input by id to the root state of the active branch.

nodes.name: Version.h
nodes.summary: Defines Version_T, a 32-bit version word viewable as Fix, Minor, Major and Opt bytes, as a Word32_T or as a raw value, plus the VERSION_VALUE packing macro.

nodes.name: Word.h
nodes.summary: Defines the packed Word32_T and Word64_T unions for viewing a machine word as chars, bytes, 16-bit halves or a value, with a Word32 constructor helper.

nodes.name: Motor_Debug.h
nodes.summary: Debug-only motor extension header declaring the externally provided LED and beep hooks (Debug_LED, Debug_LedOn, Debug_LedOff, Debug_Beep) when NDEBUG is not defined; its timing-capture helpers are commented out.

nodes.name: MotorController_AppTable.c
nodes.summary: Defines the default motor-command application MC_APP_MOTOR_CMD, a MotorController_App_T whose ENTER_MAIN handler selects the MC_STATE_MAIN_MOTOR_CMD state and whose analog-user handler is an empty stub. The table-based app selection below it is commented out.

nodes.name: MotorCmdApp_ProcAnalogUser
nodes.summary: Analog-user handler of the default motor-command app; currently a stub, with the shifter and throttle handling commented out.

nodes.name: EnterMain
nodes.summary: ENTER_MAIN handler of the default app: returns MC_STATE_MAIN_MOTOR_CMD as the main state to enter.

nodes.name: MotorController_AppTable.h
nodes.summary: Declares the MotorController_MainMode_T operation mode enum (motor command or traction), shared by config and state machine input, with an accessor for the configured init mode.

nodes.name: MotAnalogUser.h
nodes.summary: Defines the user input counts (MOT_USER_DIN_COUNT, MOT_USER_AIN_COUNT) and the fixed slot ids that bind throttle and brake to the controller's analog input array. Marked for deprecation.

nodes.name: MotorController_AnalogUser.h
nodes.summary: Facade that keeps the MotAnalogUser VarId and ConfigId interface stable for the protocol layer while resolving directly against MotorController_T: pedals through the analog input array, direction pins through the shifter, and the switch brake through the optional digital inputs.

nodes.name: MotAnalogUser_VarId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a live analog-user value by id: processed throttle and brake values and their on-states, the switch brake state, and the debounced direction pin states.

nodes.name: MotAnalogUser_VarId_GetAsInput
nodes.summary: Reads the raw input behind each analog-user id: ADC counts for the pedals, edge pin levels, and physical pin levels for the switch brake and direction pins.

nodes.name: MotAnalogUser_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads an analog-user config value by id: pedal zero and max ADC calibration, edge-pin enable, the switch brake floor and the shifter pin mode.

nodes.name: MotAnalogUser_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes an analog-user config value by id; pedal settings go through UserAIn_Config_Set, which rescales the units, and a direction pin mode change is applied to the shifter.

nodes.name: MotorController_OptPin.h
nodes.summary: Maps each optional digital input mode to its edge callback through a constant function table; only Standby has a handler, the other modes resolve to the null command and are polled where they are used.

nodes.name: _MotorController_OptDinFn
nodes.summary: Returns the UserDIn callback for an optional digital input mode from a static table that is statically asserted to cover every mode; an out-of-range mode gets the null command.

nodes.name: MotorController_StandbyPin.h
nodes.summary: Standby pin handling for the motor controller: maps pin edges to exiting or entering the main state, polls a compile-time assigned standby pin, and reports whether any digital input is configured as Standby.

nodes.name: MotorController_CallStandbyPin
nodes.summary: Standby pin edge handler: a rising edge exits the main state and a falling edge enters it.

nodes.name: MotorController_ProcStandbyPin
nodes.summary: Polls the compile-time assigned standby pin for an edge and passes it to the standby handler; a no-op when MOTOR_CONTROLLER_OPT_DIN_STANDBY_ID is not defined.

nodes.name: MotorController_IsStandbyPinMapped
nodes.summary: Returns true when any user digital input is configured with the Standby command, which decides whether the standby exit is manual or automatic.

nodes.name: MotorController_SwitchBrake.h
nodes.summary: Motor controller wrappers for the switch brake: resolves the bound switch brake pin and fuses it with the analog brake value.

nodes.name: MotorController_FuseSwitchBrake
nodes.summary: Returns the brake command combined with the switch brake: the larger of the analog brake value and the configured floor while the switch brake pin is on.

nodes.name: OptDin.h
nodes.summary: Optional digital input functions of the motor controller: the mode enum, the config and binding-state types, handlers for the switch brake and pin-gated limits, resolution of which pin serves each role, and a ConfigId accessor interface.

nodes.name: OptDin_Config_T
nodes.summary: Optional digital input settings: a speed preset (unimplemented), the speed and torque limit ratios applied while a pin is on, and the switch brake floor.

nodes.name: OptDin_State_T
nodes.summary: Runtime bindings from optional input roles to pins: pointers to the digital inputs resolved as switch brake, speed limit and current limit.

nodes.name: OptDin_FuseSwitchBrake
nodes.summary: Returns the larger of the analog brake value and the switch brake floor gated by the pin; passes the brake value through when no pin is bound.

nodes.name: OptDin_LimitOf
nodes.summary: Returns the given limit ratio while the pin is on, and 1.0 (FRACT16_MAX) when the pin is off or unbound.

nodes.name: OptDin_SwitchBrake
nodes.summary: Returns the switch brake pin: a fixed slot when OPT_DIN_SWITCH_BRAKE_ID is defined, otherwise the runtime-resolved binding.

nodes.name: OptDin_ResolveBindings
nodes.summary: Scans the digital inputs' configured command ids and records the pin for switch brake, speed limit and current limit; a role assigned to two pins is cleared, failing closed.

nodes.name: OptDin_ResolveCallbacks
nodes.summary: Sets each digital input's edge callback from a command table indexed by its configured command id.

nodes.name: OptDin_ResolveConfig
nodes.summary: Resolves both the role bindings and the edge callbacks of the digital inputs.

nodes.name: OptDin_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads an OptDin_Config_T field by config id.

nodes.name: OptDin_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes an OptDin_Config_T field by config id.

nodes.name: Shifter.c
nodes.summary: Shifter implementation: the pin-state to direction decode tables for the forward/reverse and reverse-only wiring variants, initialization, pin mode selection, and VarId and ConfigId read access.

nodes.name: Shifter_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Initializes the shifter: copies the config when one is given, initializes the direction pins, selects the decode table for the configured pin mode and starts in Neutral.

nodes.name: Shifter_SetPinMode
nodes.summary: Stores the wiring variant and caches the matching decode table pointer in the shifter state.

nodes.name: Shifter_VarId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a shifter variable by id: the resolved direction or an individual pin state.

nodes.name: Shifter_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a shifter config value by id; currently only the pin mode.

nodes.name: Shifter.h
nodes.summary: Direction selector (shifter) module: forward and reverse pins with an optional neutral pin, decoded to a direction through a table selected by pin mode and cached in state. Defines the config, state and const-context types with inline poll and direction query functions.
nodes.languageNotes: The pin levels are packed into a bit-field union used directly as the decode table index, so resolving the direction is a table lookup without branches.

nodes.name: Shifter_Config_T
nodes.summary: Shifter configuration holding the wiring variant (pin mode) that selects the decode table.

nodes.name: Shifter_State_T
nodes.summary: Shifter runtime state: the debounce state of each direction pin, the cached decode table pointer, the last resolved direction for edge detection, and the config.

nodes.name: Shifter_T
nodes.summary: Compile-time shifter context: a pointer to the runtime state plus the forward, reverse and optional neutral digital input descriptors.

nodes.name: Shifter_Decode
nodes.summary: Looks up the direction for a packed pin value in the cached decode table.

nodes.name: Shifter_Poll
nodes.summary: Polls and debounces the reverse, forward and optional neutral pins.

nodes.name: Shifter_GetPins
nodes.summary: Packs the current debounced pin states into the Shifter_Pins_T decode index.

nodes.name: Shifter_ResolveDirection
nodes.summary: Returns the direction decoded from the current pin states, without polling.

nodes.name: Shifter_PollDirection
nodes.summary: Polls the pins, resolves the direction and stores it as the last direction.

nodes.name: Shifter_PollDirectionEdge
nodes.summary: Polls the direction and returns true when it differs from the previous poll.

nodes.name: MotLimits.h
nodes.summary: Fully commented-out header for system-scope derate arbitration: LimitArray-based current and speed limit source ids and the MotLimits_T container. Nothing in it compiles; the system derates are composed by hand in MotorController.c.

nodes.name: MotorController_MotLimits.h
nodes.summary: Placeholder header that only includes MotorController.h and MotLimits.h and defines nothing of its own.

nodes.name: MotorController.c
nodes.summary: Motor controller core: initializes NVM config, ADC, UART and CAN, protocol sockets, user inputs, voltage and heat monitors, the motors and the state machine, resolves the standby exit policy, and composes the system current and speed derates stored to every motor.

nodes.name: MotorController_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the whole controller in order: NVM and config load, ADCs, UARTs, optional CAN, protocol sockets, shifter, analog and digital user inputs with their optional-pin callbacks, VBus and monitors, each motor, indicators, the millisecond timer and the app; then marks the first ADC conversions, resolves the standby exit mode and starts the state machine.

nodes.name: MotorController_ResetBootDefault
nodes.summary: Resets the runtime boot reference word to its default: valid, fast boot off, beep and blink on.

nodes.name: MotorController_ResolveStandbyExitMode
nodes.summary: Derives the standby exit policy from configuration: manual for non-analog input modes or when a Standby pin is mapped, automatic for headless analog input where the throttle is the only enable.

nodes.name: _MotorController_IDerate
nodes.summary: Composes the system current derate as the minimum of the MOSFET heat derate and the torque limit gated by the optional current-limit pin.

nodes.name: _MotorController_SpeedDerate
nodes.summary: Composes the system speed derate as the minimum of the VBus speed derate and the speed limit gated by the optional speed-limit pin.

nodes.name: MotorController_ProcILimits
nodes.summary: Recomputes the system current derate and stores it to every motor for both the motoring and generating sides.

nodes.name: MotorController_ProcSpeedLimits
nodes.summary: Recomputes the system speed derate and stores it to every motor.

nodes.name: MotorController.h
nodes.summary: Facade header of the multi-motor controller: defines the fault flags, input and standby-exit modes, the persisted config, the runtime context, and the const MotorController_T allocation that wires the motor table, ADC/UART/CAN peripherals, user inputs, voltage and heat monitors, protocol sockets, NVM, the state machine and the app plug-in. Also provides inline dispatch into the app vtable and Rx-lost polling on the main socket.
nodes.languageNotes: The object is split into a const context struct (flash-resident, holding pointers and sub-object contexts) and a mutable runtime struct reached through P_MC, which keeps the design heap-free.

nodes.name: MotorController_Analog.c
nodes.summary: Implements the Lock state's ADC-calibration sub-state: averages the throttle and brake analog inputs for about two seconds, commits the averages as each input's ADC zero, then returns to Lock.

nodes.name: MotorController_Analog.h
nodes.summary: Declares the Lock-branch ADC-calibration sub-state object (MC_STATE_LOCK_CALIBRATE_ADC) and the command that enters it.

nodes.name: MotorController_App.h
nodes.summary: Defines the MotorController_App_T plug-in interface: a fixed vtable (init, analog-user processing, enter-main) through which an application mode such as Traction mounts its own sub-state tree under the controller's Main state.
nodes.languageNotes: Forward-declares MotorController_T so the interface can be included by MotorController.h without a circular dependency.

nodes.name: MotorController_StateMachine.c
nodes.summary: Implements the controller-level hierarchical state machine - Init, Standby, Main (with the MotorCmd sub-state), MotorTuning, Lock and Fault - including each state's entry, loop and transition handlers, the standby-entry guards, blocking lock operations (NVM save, calibration, reboot) and latching fault-flag handling.
nodes.languageNotes: States are const State_T objects whose transition tables are designated-initializer arrays indexed by input id; handlers are cast to a generic function-pointer type, and a NULL slot means the input is ignored or left to the parent state.

nodes.name: MotorController_StateMachine.h
nodes.summary: Public interface of the controller state machine: root and sub-state id enums, input ids, state and lock command enums, the fault-command encoding, and inline query and input functions (state predicates, InputStateCommand, InputLock, SetFault and ClearFault).

nodes.name: MotorController_Config_T
nodes.summary: Persisted controller configuration: the app mode selected at init, the user input source (serial, analog or CAN), and the optional-digital-input and direction-shifter configs.

nodes.name: MotorController_Context_T
nodes.summary: Mutable runtime state of the controller: the active state machine data, latched fault flags, standby-exit policy, PWM control counter, lock-operation and NVM status, the RAM copy of the config, the boot reference, calibration averaging buffers and timing profile counters.

nodes.name: MotorController_T
nodes.summary: Compile-time constant controller context that aggregates everything the controller owns: the runtime state pointer, ADC/UART/CAN peripherals, the motor table, shifter and user digital/analog inputs, buzzer, meter and relay, protocol sockets, the NVM manager, VBus and board voltage/heat monitors with their ADC conversions, the millisecond timer, the state machine and the app plug-in.

nodes.name: MotorController_App_T
nodes.summary: Vtable interface for an application mode plugged into the controller: PROC_ANALOG_USER handles analog user input, INIT initializes the app state, and ENTER_MAIN resolves the app's initial sub-state when leaving Standby.

nodes.name: MotorController_App_EnterMain
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the plugged-in app's ENTER_MAIN handler, which returns the app sub-state to enter when leaving Standby.

nodes.name: MotorController_GetMainSocket
nodes.summary: Returns the protocol socket designated as the user's main channel, asserting that the index is in range.

nodes.name: MotorController_PollRxLost
nodes.summary: Updates the RxLost fault flag from the main socket's receive-timeout status and returns it.

nodes.name: StartCalibrateAdc
nodes.summary: Entry action of the ADC-calibration sub-state: resets the state counter and averaging buffers and marks the throttle and brake conversions.

nodes.name: ProcCalibrateAdc
nodes.summary: Per-millisecond loop of the calibration sub-state: accumulates the throttle and brake ADC results into running averages and re-marks the conversions.

nodes.name: EndCalibrateAdc
nodes.summary: Completion check of the calibration sub-state: after about 2 s commits the averaged readings as the throttle and brake ADC zeros, reports success and returns to Lock.

nodes.name: MotorController_Lock_CalibrateAdc
nodes.summary: Invokes a tree transition from the Lock state into the ADC-calibration sub-state.

nodes.name: MotorController_PollFaultFlags
nodes.summary: Refreshes the monitor-driven fault flags (VBus, accessory and analog rails, PCB and MOSFET overheat) from the current monitor status, so resolved conditions release their latch.

nodes.name: TransitionFault
nodes.summary: Shared fault-input handler for the non-fault states: ORs the requested flags into the latch and transitions to Fault if any flag is set.

nodes.name: Common_InputStandby
nodes.summary: Guarded entry to Standby: releases motors that are held at zero speed, refuses with a buzzer error while any motor is still moving, and otherwise latches manual standby exit and returns the Standby state.

nodes.name: Init_Next
nodes.summary: Init state's exit check: after the startup wait, validates the board, the VBus config and monitor enablement and that all motors are deactivated, then proceeds to Standby or to Fault.

nodes.name: Standby_Next
nodes.summary: Automatic Standby exit: under the AUTO policy enters the app's Main sub-state once fault-free and stationary; under MANUAL waits for an explicit start command.

nodes.name: Standby_InputStateCmd
nodes.summary: Standby's state-command handler: stop and E-stop re-latch manual Standby, start delegates to the app to choose the Main sub-state.

nodes.name: Main_InputStateCmd
nodes.summary: Main's default state-command handler, inherited by its sub-states: stop and E-stop go through the guarded Standby entry, start enters the app sub-state only from bare Main.

nodes.name: MotorTuning_InputTuning
nodes.summary: Lock-input handler in the tuning state: allows entering Lock when the motors are stationary, treats re-selecting tuning as a no-op, and re-enters the state on reset to reload the gains from NVM.

nodes.name: MotorTuning_InputStateCmd
nodes.summary: State-command handler in the tuning state: an accepted stop discards live tuning on all motors and moves to Standby, while a rejected stop leaves the gains intact.

nodes.name: Lock_InputLockOp_Blocking
nodes.summary: Lock state's operation dispatcher, accepted only when no sub-state is active: exit to Standby, blocking NVM config save with the VBus monitor paused, ADC calibration, reboot, and exits into motor-command or tuning mode, recording the operation status.

nodes.name: Fault_Entry
nodes.summary: Fault state entry: requests zero-voltage output from every motor on bus overvoltage, otherwise releases the motor outputs, and starts the periodic buzzer.

nodes.name: Fault_InputFault
nodes.summary: Fault state's set/clear handler: clears the requested flags, re-verifies the board and monitor conditions, accumulates new flags, tries to clear every motor's faults, and returns to Standby once no flag remains.

nodes.name: Fault_InputLockSaveConfig_Blocking
nodes.summary: Allows a blocking NVM config save from the Fault state, but only while every motor is at zero speed, because the save runs with interrupts off.

nodes.name: MotorController_InputStateCommand
nodes.summary: Sends a state command (E-stop, stop main, start main) to the active state branch, synchronously on the caller's thread.

nodes.name: MotorController_InputLock
nodes.summary: Sends a lock command to the active branch and returns the resulting operation status, which defaults to error when no state accepts the command.

nodes.name: MotorController_SaveConfig_Blocking
nodes.summary: Requests the blocking NVM config save through the lock input and returns the NVM status.

nodes.name: MotorController_IsLockOpComplete
nodes.summary: Reports whether Lock has no active sub-state and every motor's calibration is complete.

nodes.name: MotorController_SetFault
nodes.summary: Posts an asynchronous fault input to the state machine that sets the given fault flags.

nodes.name: MotorController_ClearFault
nodes.summary: Posts an asynchronous fault input to the state machine that clears the given fault flags.

nodes.name: MotorController_TryClearFaultAll
nodes.summary: Attempts to clear all fault flags and reports whether the controller has left the Fault state.

nodes.name: MotorController_Thread.h
nodes.summary: Inline thread bodies that the application maps onto its execution contexts: the main loop (1 ms state machine output, protocol sockets, input-mode handling, plus ~10 ms and ~1 s dividers for inputs, monitors and limits), the 1 ms timer thread (VBus monitor) and the PWM thread (ADC marking and per-motor control).

nodes.name: MotorController_User.c
nodes.summary: Implements the host-facing system command dispatcher (beep, clear fault, force disable, lock operations and status, state commands, Rx watchdog) and a direction check that sounds the buzzer on mismatch.

nodes.name: MotorController_User.h
nodes.summary: User interface wrapper for inputs arriving from outside the chip: the system command and generic status enums, a force-disable that bypasses state-machine checks, and Rx watchdog control on the main protocol socket.

nodes.name: MotorController_Var.c
nodes.summary: Implements the controller's variable-ID interface: routes MotVarId get and set requests by prefix to the motor, general, voltage-monitor, heat-monitor, communication and app handlers, and enforces a per-type write policy based on the input mode and controller state.

nodes.name: _MotorController_ProcAnalogUser
nodes.summary: Captures all user analog inputs from their ADC results, polls the direction shifter, runs the app's analog-user handler, and re-marks the conversions on the analog-user divider.

nodes.name: _MotorController_HeatMonitor_Thread
nodes.summary: Polls the PCB and MOSFET temperature monitors, raises overheat faults, triggers the buzzer on warnings, re-marks the thermistor conversions and runs each motor's heat thread.

nodes.name: _MotorController_VBus_Thread
nodes.summary: Polls the DC bus monitor, raising a VBus fault on over- or undervoltage, optionally resolves the motors' supply current limits, and re-marks the VBus conversion.

nodes.name: _MotorController_VMonitorBoard_Thread
nodes.summary: Polls the accessory and analog-rail voltage monitors, raises their faults, re-posts any latched fault flags and re-marks the conversions.

nodes.name: MotorController_Main_Thread
nodes.summary: Main loop body: on each millisecond tick runs the state machine's synchronous output, the protocol sockets and CAN broadcast, and the selected input mode (analog user, or serial Rx-lost safe stop); on ~10 ms and ~1 s dividers it services the buzzer and meter, digital-input commands, board monitors, current and speed limits, motor-fault escalation and UART Rx restart.

nodes.name: MotorController_Timer1Ms_Thread
nodes.summary: 1 ms timer thread body, which runs the VBus monitor at medium-high priority.

nodes.name: MotorController_PWM_Thread
nodes.summary: PWM-rate thread body: marks the phase-current conversions on sample cycles and the VBus conversion, activates the marked ADC conversions, runs each motor's PWM thread and advances the control counter.

nodes.name: MotorController_CallSystemCmd
nodes.summary: Executes a host system command by id - beep, clear fault, force disable, lock input and status queries, state command, Rx watchdog - and returns a generic status value.

nodes.name: MotorController_CheckDirection
nodes.summary: Compares the motors' common direction with the requested one, blinking the buzzer and returning false on a mismatch.

nodes.name: MotorController_ForceDisableControl
nodes.summary: Disables all motor outputs without state-machine checks, then issues a stop-main command so later inputs do not overwrite the disabled state.

nodes.name: MotorController_Var_Output_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a general controller output variable: milliseconds, root state id, state path id, fault flags or direction.

nodes.name: MotorController_Var_Input_Set
nodes.summary: Placeholder setter for general user-input variables; every case is currently disabled.

nodes.name: MotorController_Var_OutputDebug_Get
nodes.summary: Reads debug output variables such as the control-loop and current-sequence timing profiles.

nodes.name: MotorController_Config_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a controller config variable: the init app mode, the input mode or a boot-reference flag.

nodes.name: MotorController_Config_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a controller config variable: the init app mode, the input mode or a boot-reference flag.

nodes.name: MotorController_InstancesRef_Get
nodes.summary: Reports board constants: the counts of motors, voltage monitors, MOSFET thermistors, protocol and CAN sockets, digital and analog inputs, plus the rotor sensor options and version flags.

nodes.name: _HandleGeneral_Get
nodes.summary: Get handler for the general prefix, routing by type to the controller outputs, config, board constants, debug values, and the analog-user, optional-DIN and user digital input accessors.

nodes.name: _HandleGeneral_Set
nodes.summary: Set handler for the general prefix, rejecting read-only types and routing writable ones to the controller config, analog-user, optional-DIN and user digital input config setters.

nodes.name: _HandleVMonitor_Get
nodes.summary: Get handler for the voltage-monitor prefix, covering the VBus output, config, monitor state and divider plus the accessory and analog rail monitors.

nodes.name: _HandleVMonitor_Set
nodes.summary: Set handler for the voltage-monitor prefix; a VBus config write pauses the monitor, applies the value, reinitializes and resumes.

nodes.name: _HandleHeatMonitor_Get
nodes.summary: Get handler for the heat-monitor prefix, covering the PCB monitor and the MOSFET monitor group and its instances.

nodes.name: _HandleHeatMonitor_Set
nodes.summary: Set handler for the heat-monitor prefix; only the PCB and MOSFET-group monitor configs are writable.

nodes.name: _HandleCommunication_Get
nodes.summary: Get handler for the communication prefix, reading the protocol socket config and, when CAN is enabled, the CAN config by instance.

nodes.name: _HandleCommunication_Set
nodes.summary: Set handler for the communication prefix, writing the protocol socket and CAN config by instance and rejecting state types as read-only.

nodes.name: _HandleAppUser_Get
nodes.summary: Get handler for the app-user prefix, forwarding to the Traction app's control and config getters.

nodes.name: _HandleAppUser_Set
nodes.summary: Set handler for the app-user prefix, forwarding to the Traction app's control and config setters.

nodes.name: CheckInputPolicy
nodes.summary: Write guard evaluated before every variable set: by prefix and type it requires protocol input mode for control variables, motor-command or tuning access for motor commands, Lock for calibration and sensor commands, and Lock or Fault for config writes.

nodes.name: MotorController_Var_Get
nodes.summary: Public variable read: dispatches a MotVarId by prefix to the motor variable layer or to the controller's general, voltage-monitor, heat-monitor, communication and app handlers.

nodes.name: MotorController_Var_Set
nodes.summary: Public variable write: applies the input policy check, then dispatches by prefix to the motor variable layer or the controller's handlers and returns a status code.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction.c
nodes.summary: Traction (vehicle drive) application plugged into the controller: defines the Drive and Neutral sub-states under Main, maps throttle, brake, lever and direction inputs onto motor-table commands according to the configured modes, and exposes the app's analog-input processing and variable accessors.
nodes.languageNotes: The app reaches its own state through the controller's opaque P_APP_STATE pointer, so MotorController_T carries no type dependency on Traction.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction.h
nodes.summary: Interface of the Traction app adapter: its state-input and state-id enums, the MC_APP_TRACTION vtable instance, casts from the controller's opaque app pointers, and the throttle, brake, lever, direction and variable accessor declarations.

nodes.name: SysTime.c
nodes.summary: Defines the global millisecond counter, configures the Cortex-M SysTick for a 1 ms tick, and provides a blocking delay with an optional yield callback.

nodes.name: SysTime.h
nodes.summary: System time interface: SysTick register definitions, the millisecond counter with its ISR capture hook, and inline getters for milliseconds, ticks within the current millisecond and microseconds.
nodes.languageNotes: Requires CPU_FREQ and SYSTIME_SYSTICK at compile time (#error otherwise) and accesses SysTick through raw memory-mapped register macros.

nodes.name: Debounce.h
nodes.summary: Header-only time-based debouncer: tracks the latest raw input level with its timestamp and changes the output only after the input has been stable for the configured time.

nodes.name: Debounce_T
nodes.summary: Debouncer runtime state: the configured stability time, the timestamp and value of the latest raw input level, and the debounced output.

nodes.name: EnterMain
nodes.summary: The app's ENTER_MAIN handler: picks the sub-state when leaving Standby - Neutral if any motor is moving or no direction is selected, Drive for forward or reverse.

nodes.name: Traction_StartThrottleMode
nodes.summary: Starts throttle control on the motor table: selects speed-current or current feedback per the throttle mode and enables PWM output, or releases the outputs for an unsupported mode.

nodes.name: Traction_ApplyThrottleValue
nodes.summary: Applies a throttle value to all motors as a motoring speed or current command, according to the throttle mode.

nodes.name: Traction_ApplyLeverValue
nodes.summary: Applies a signed lever value in the user-forward frame to all motors as a speed or torque command.

nodes.name: Traction_StartBrakeMode
nodes.summary: Starts braking: torque brake mode selects current feedback and enables PWM, while passive and other modes release the motor outputs.

nodes.name: Traction_ApplyBrakeValue
nodes.summary: In torque brake mode applies the brake value as an opposing current command and holds zero speed once no motor is still advancing.

nodes.name: Traction_StartDriveZero
nodes.summary: Handles release of throttle and brake per the zero mode: a zero-torque hold, a zero throttle command, or floating the outputs.

nodes.name: Drive_InputDirection
nodes.summary: Direction input in Drive: a null direction goes to Neutral, while forward or reverse is applied only at standstill and otherwise ignored.

nodes.name: Drive_InputCmdStart
nodes.summary: On a drive-command edge in Drive, starts brake, throttle or release handling.

nodes.name: Drive_InputAppUser
nodes.summary: Drive state's app-input dispatcher: reads the buffered Traction input and routes direction, drive-command edges and throttle, brake and lever values to their handlers.

nodes.name: Neutral_InputDirection
nodes.summary: Direction input in Neutral: forward or reverse moves to Drive when the motors already match or are stopped, while null stays in Neutral.

nodes.name: Neutral_InputCmdStart
nodes.summary: Drive-command edge in Neutral: release floats the outputs, brake starts braking, and throttle is ignored.

nodes.name: Neutral_InputAppUser
nodes.summary: Neutral state's app-input dispatcher: accepts direction, drive-command edges and brake values, while throttle and lever inputs have no effect.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_GetDirection
nodes.summary: Returns the traction direction: null while in Neutral, otherwise the motors' common direction.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_GetStateId
nodes.summary: Returns whether the active leaf state is Traction's Drive or Neutral, or a null id when it is neither.

nodes.name: _MotorController_Traction_ApplyCmd
nodes.summary: Sends a Traction input id to the active branch of the controller state machine as an app-user input.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_PollStartCmd
nodes.summary: Detects a change of the resolved drive command (throttle, brake or release) and forwards the edge to the state machine.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_SetThrottle
nodes.summary: Buffers a throttle value and sends either a drive-command edge, if the command changed, or the throttle value.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_SetBrake
nodes.summary: Buffers a brake value and sends either a drive-command edge, if the command changed, or the brake value.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_SetRelease
nodes.summary: Zeros the buffered throttle and brake and polls for the resulting release edge.

nodes.name: ApplyDriveCmd
nodes.summary: Polls the start edge, then sends the value input of whichever drive command is active.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_SetThrottleBrake
nodes.summary: Buffers throttle and brake together and applies the resolved drive command and its value.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_SetLever
nodes.summary: Handles a single-axis lever: requests the lever direction on engage, resolves the lever into throttle or brake per the lever mode, and applies the command as a lever or throttle value.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_ApplyDirectionCmd
nodes.summary: Buffers a direction command, sends it to the state machine and blinks the buzzer if the resulting direction differs.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_CaptureDirection
nodes.summary: Forwards the direction to the state machine only when it changes.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_ProcAnalogUser
nodes.summary: The app's analog-user handler: captures the shifter direction and applies throttle and brake from the analog inputs, fusing in the brake switch.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_VarId_Set
nodes.summary: Protocol write access to the Traction control variables: direction, throttle, brake and lever.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_VarId_Get
nodes.summary: Protocol read access to the Traction variables: direction, the buffered throttle, brake and lever values, and the state id.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a Traction config value by id from the app's runtime config.

nodes.name: MotorController_Traction_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a Traction config value by id to the app's runtime config.

nodes.name: SysTime_Init
nodes.summary: Configures SysTick to reload every millisecond from the CPU clock and enables its interrupt.

nodes.name: SysTime_Delay
nodes.summary: Blocks for the given number of milliseconds, calling an optional yield function once per millisecond.

nodes.name: SysTime_CaptureMillis_ISR
nodes.summary: Increments the millisecond counter; the application calls it from its 1 ms interrupt.

nodes.name: SysTime_GetMillis
nodes.summary: Returns the millisecond counter.

nodes.name: SysTime_GetMicros
nodes.summary: Returns the microseconds elapsed within the current millisecond, derived from the SysTick counter with a fixed-point scale.

nodes.name: debounce
nodes.summary: Pure debounce step: returns the new input level only if it differs from the output and has been stable for the required time.

nodes.name: Debounce_Poll
nodes.summary: Updates the debouncer with the current time and pin level, restarting the timer on any change, and returns the debounced output.

nodes.name: Debounce_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the debouncer with its stability time and clears its state.

nodes.name: UserAIn.c
nodes.summary: Implements user analog input handling: filtered capture of ADC readings scaled to Percent16, optional gating and edge detection through a digital pin, and config application including ADC zero calibration.

nodes.name: UserAIn.h
nodes.summary: Defines the user analog input module (potentiometer-style throttle or brake): config, runtime state and const context types, inline value, on and edge queries that respect the optional edge pin, config validation and the config-ID accessors.

nodes.name: UserDIn.c
nodes.summary: Implements the debounced user digital input: polarity-aware pin reads, state and edge polling, a mode-gated variant that can be disabled at runtime, edge-triggered command callbacks, and initialization from persisted config.

nodes.name: UserDIn.h
nodes.summary: Defines the user digital input module, which adds debounce, edge detection and an optional command callback to a Pin_T: edge and mode enums, config, state and const context types, inline state queries, runtime enable/disable and variable/config ID accessors.

nodes.name: UserDIn_Cmd.h
nodes.summary: Command-table extension for user digital inputs: a table type pairing callback functions with a context, and a helper that resolves each pin's persisted command id to its callback at init.

nodes.name: UserAIn_Config_T
nodes.summary: Analog input calibration config: the ADC values for 0% and 100% and whether the optional edge pin is used.

nodes.name: UserAIn_State_T
nodes.summary: Analog input runtime state: current and previous filtered values, the raw ADC reading, the ADC-to-Percent16 linear conversion and the active config.

nodes.name: UserAIn_T
nodes.summary: Constant analog input context: the optional gating/edge digital pin, pointers to the runtime state and NVM config, and the filter shift.

nodes.name: UserDIn_Config_T
nodes.summary: Persisted digital input config: trigger mode, the command id resolved to a callback at init, and user polarity inversion.

nodes.name: UserDIn_State_T
nodes.summary: Digital input runtime state: the debouncer, the previous output for edge detection, the runtime mode (which allows disabling), the resolved command callback and the active config.

nodes.name: UserDIn_T
nodes.summary: Constant digital input context wrapping a Pin_T with pointers to the runtime state, a millisecond timer source, the debounce time and an optional NVM config.

nodes.name: UserDIn_CmdTable_T
nodes.summary: Constant table of digital-input command callbacks with its length and the context pointer passed to them, decoupling the input module from the service it triggers.

nodes.name: UserAIn_CaptureValue
nodes.summary: Polls the optional edge pin, then filters and stores the scaled ADC reading unless the pin gate blocks capture, in which case the last value persists.

nodes.name: UserAIn_PollEdge
nodes.summary: Captures a reading and reports an edge, taken from the edge pin when it is enabled or else from the analog value crossing zero.

nodes.name: UserAIn_PollRisingEdge
nodes.summary: Captures a reading and reports a rising edge from the edge pin or the analog value.

nodes.name: UserAIn_PollFallingEdge
nodes.summary: Captures a reading and reports a falling edge from the edge pin or the analog value.

nodes.name: UserAIn_ReinitScale
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the ADC-to-Percent16 linear conversion from the configured zero and max ADC values.

nodes.name: UserAIn_SetAdcZero
nodes.summary: Commits a calibrated ADC zero, validates the config and rebuilds the scale.

nodes.name: UserAIn_ApplyConfig
nodes.summary: Applies the config to the runtime state: rebuilds the scale and enables or disables the edge pin gate.

nodes.name: UserAIn_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Initializes the analog input from a given config: validates it, initializes the edge pin, applies the config and seeds the value at the zero reading.

nodes.name: UserAIn_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the analog input from its NVM config.

nodes.name: UserAIn_GetValue
nodes.summary: Returns the filtered Percent16 value, or zero while the edge pin gate is off.

nodes.name: UserAIn_Config_Validate
nodes.summary: Repairs a config whose ADC range is too narrow to scale by moving it above the ADC range, so every reading saturates to zero.

nodes.name: _UserAIn_Config_Get
nodes.summary: Reads an analog input config field by id.

nodes.name: _UserAIn_Config_Set
nodes.summary: Writes an analog input config field by id.

nodes.name: UserAIn_Config_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a config field on the device, then validates and re-applies the config so the scale and edge-pin gating follow.

nodes.name: UserDIn_PollState
nodes.summary: Reads the pin with polarity applied and returns the debounced on/off state.

nodes.name: UserDIn_PollEdge
nodes.summary: Stores the previous output, polls the debounced state and reports whether it changed.

nodes.name: UserDIn_PollRisingEdge
nodes.summary: Polls the input and reports a transition to on.

nodes.name: UserDIn_PollFallingEdge
nodes.summary: Polls the input and reports a transition to off.

nodes.name: UserDIn_PollEdgeValue
nodes.summary: Polls the input and returns the edge as rising, falling or null.

nodes.name: UserDIn_Modal_PollEdgeValue
nodes.summary: Mode-aware edge poll that returns null while the input is disabled.

nodes.name: _UserDIn_Modal_PollEdgeCmd
nodes.summary: Polls for an edge and, when one occurs, invokes the input's resolved command callback with the caller-supplied context.

nodes.name: UserDIn_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Initializes the input from a config: disables it when no pin is connected, otherwise initializes the pin, loads the config and seeds the debouncer with the current pin reading.

nodes.name: UserDIn_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the digital input from its NVM config.

nodes.name: UserDIn_GetState
nodes.summary: Returns the debounced output state.

nodes.name: UserDIn_Var_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a digital input variable by id: the debounced output or the physical pin level.

nodes.name: _UserDIn_Config_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a digital input config field by id.

nodes.name: _UserDIn_Config_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a digital input config field by id.

nodes.name: UserDIn_Config_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a config field on the device and mirrors a mode change into the runtime mode.

nodes.name: UserDIn_Var_GetInstance
nodes.summary: Bounds-checked variable read for one input of an array.

nodes.name: UserDIn_Config_GetInstance
nodes.summary: Bounds-checked config read for one input of an array.

nodes.name: UserDIn_Config_SetInstance
nodes.summary: Bounds-checked config write for one input of an array.

nodes.name: UserDIn_Array_ResolveCallbacks
nodes.summary: Resolves each input's persisted command id to a callback from the table and stores it in the input's runtime state.

nodes.name: CANopen.h
nodes.summary: Defines the CANopen COB-ID scheme: the function-code bases of the predefined connection set (SDO, RxPDO/TxPDO 1-4, EMCY), the function and node masks, and a bitfield view of the 11-bit identifier.

nodes.name: Cob_T
nodes.summary: Bitfield view of an 11-bit CANopen COB-ID, split into a 7-bit node ID and a 4-bit function code.

nodes.name: OD.h
nodes.summary: CANopen Object Dictionary primitives: CiA 301 index areas, object type and access metadata, SDO abort codes, the typed value codec, and the OD_Interface_T callback interface through which the generic SDO server and PDO codec reach objects.
nodes.languageNotes: Object-oriented C: OD_Interface_T is a const struct of function pointers taking a void * context; typed callbacks are cast to it at the definition site.

nodes.name: OD_Info_T
nodes.summary: Object metadata record giving an object's data type, access rights and size in bytes; a type of OD_TYPE_NONE marks an absent object.

nodes.name: OD_Interface_T
nodes.summary: Dictionary vtable of GetInfo, Get and Set callbacks taking a caller-supplied context, which keeps the SDO server and PDO codec generic over whatever backs the objects.

nodes.name: OD_Area_Of
nodes.summary: Classifies a 16-bit object index into its CiA 301 area (data types, communication profile, manufacturer, device profile or reserved) from the top nibble.

nodes.name: OD_Type_Size
nodes.summary: Returns the byte width of an object data type, or 0 for OD_TYPE_NONE.

nodes.name: OD_Data_Decode
nodes.summary: Reads an OD_Data_T value as the given type and widens it to int32, sign-extending the signed widths.

nodes.name: OD_Data_Encode
nodes.summary: Narrows an int32 value into an OD_Data_T of the given type for the wire.

nodes.name: PDO.c
nodes.summary: Implements the CANopen PDO parameter objects (communication and mapping records) as the PDO_PARAM_OD dictionary over a node's channel tables, enforcing the CiA 301 rules for COB-ID changes, event-driven transmission and mapping edits.
nodes.languageNotes: The accessors are static inline in the .c file and reach other modules only through the exported const OD_Interface_T instance.

nodes.name: _PDO_ChannelOf
nodes.summary: Resolves a PDO parameter index to the RX or TX channel it addresses, or NULL when the record or channel number is out of range.

nodes.name: _PDO_Channel_SetCobId
nodes.summary: Accepts a COB-ID write only for 11-bit IDs, never enabling a PDO with nothing mapped and never moving the CAN ID of a PDO that is still valid.

nodes.name: _PDO_Channel_SetMapCount
nodes.summary: Validates and closes a mapping: every entry must have a supported width and the total must fit one 64-bit CAN payload before the count is accepted.

nodes.name: _PDO_Channel_SetMapping
nodes.summary: Writes a mapping sub-index under the CiA 301 edit order: only while the PDO is disabled, and entries only while the count is 0.

nodes.name: PDO_OdGetInfo
nodes.summary: Returns type and access metadata for a PDO communication or mapping sub-index, reporting absent for unknown channels and for the event timer on RPDOs.

nodes.name: PDO_OdGet
nodes.summary: Reads a PDO parameter (COB-ID, transmission type, event timer, map count or map entry) from the addressed channel.

nodes.name: PDO_OdSet
nodes.summary: Writes a PDO parameter after existence and access checks, delegating to the COB-ID, transmission and mapping setters that enforce the edit rules.

nodes.name: PDO.h
nodes.summary: CANopen Process Data Object layer: the RAM channel record (COB-ID, transmission type, event timer, mapping), per-node channel tables, and the mapping-driven codec that decodes RPDO frames into dictionary Set calls and builds TPDO frames from Get calls.
nodes.languageNotes: One channel type serves both directions; the parameter index carries direction, record and channel, so no direction is stored. Bitfield unions overlay the 32-bit COB-ID and mapping-entry objects.

nodes.name: PDO_Channel_T
nodes.summary: One PDO's master-rewritable configuration for either direction: COB-ID, transmission type, TPDO event timer and up to eight mapping entries.

nodes.name: PDO_Table_T
nodes.summary: Const descriptor of a node's PDO channels in one direction: a pointer to the channel array and its count.

nodes.name: PDO_Tables_T
nodes.summary: A node's RX and TX channel tables together, the context the PDO parameter dictionary addresses.

nodes.name: PDO_Channel_IsWellFormed
nodes.summary: Checks that a channel is in a state the parameter objects could have left, rejecting contents loaded from erased or stale NVM.

nodes.name: PDO_Channel_IsFor
nodes.summary: Tests whether an enabled channel is configured for a received COB-ID, either exactly or with node bits 0 standing for this node's predefined ID.

nodes.name: _PDO_Channel_WriteEntry
nodes.summary: Decodes one mapped entry's bytes from a received frame and writes the object through the dictionary Set callback.

nodes.name: PDO_HandleRx
nodes.summary: Shared RxPDO handler: finds the channel configured for the COB-ID, requires the exact mapped length, and writes each mapped object through the dictionary in map order.

nodes.name: PDO_Channel_IsTxDue
nodes.summary: Wrap-safe check that a valid TPDO's event timer has elapsed since its last transmission.

nodes.name: _PDO_Channel_ReadEntry
nodes.summary: Reads one mapped object through the dictionary Get callback and encodes its bytes into the frame at the entry's offset.

nodes.name: PDO_BuildTx
nodes.summary: Builds a TPDO frame by reading each mapped object through the dictionary and packing it little-endian; returns the frame length.

nodes.name: SDO.h
nodes.summary: CANopen Service Data Object layer: the 8-byte SDO frame and command-specifier overlays, response encoders, and a minimal expedited-transfer server that dispatches upload and download requests through an OD_Interface_T.
nodes.languageNotes: Packed bitfield unions overlay the wire bytes directly, relying on GCC allocating the first-declared bitfield at the LSB on little-endian targets.

nodes.name: SDO_T
nodes.summary: Packed 8-byte SDO frame overlay: command specifier, little-endian index, sub-index, and four data bytes viewed as a typed value or an abort code.

nodes.name: SDO_EncodeAbort
nodes.summary: Builds an SDO abort frame carrying a CiA 301 abort code for the given index and sub-index.

nodes.name: SDO_EncodeDownloadAck
nodes.summary: Builds the download-initiate response that acknowledges a successful write.

nodes.name: SDO_EncodeUploadResponse
nodes.summary: Builds an expedited upload response with the size bits set and the value encoded per the object's type.

nodes.name: SDO_HandleRequest
nodes.summary: Expedited SDO server entry point: looks up object metadata, enforces access rights, performs the dictionary Get or Set, and fills the response or abort frame; returns the reply length, 0 for an inbound abort.

nodes.name: Cia402.c
nodes.summary: Holds the spec-fixed CiA 402 object metadata table (index, type, access) and the lookup behind Cia402_Od_GetInfo for the supported drive-profile objects.

nodes.name: _TableIndex
nodes.summary: Switch-mapped lookup from a CiA 402 object index to its row in the metadata table, returning NULL for unsupported objects.

nodes.name: Cia402_Od_GetInfo
nodes.summary: Common-layer metadata entry point: returns the spec-fixed type, access and size of a supported CiA 402 object at sub-index 0, or an absent record otherwise.

nodes.name: Cia402.h
nodes.summary: CiA 402 drive-profile data interface: Controlword and Statusword bitfields with state decoding, modes of operation and option codes, per-axis object index paging, the per-axis adapter context, dictionary metadata types, and the default RxPDO/TxPDO overlays.
nodes.languageNotes: Controlword and Statusword are packed bitfield unions over a uint16; the default PDO layouts are packed structs cast directly onto CAN payload bytes.

nodes.name: Cia402_Control_T
nodes.summary: Controlword (0x6040) bitfield union: state-machine command bits, fault reset, halt, and mode-specific and manufacturer-specific bits.

nodes.name: Cia402_Status_T
nodes.summary: Statusword (0x6041) bitfield union reporting the drive state bits plus warning, remote, target-reached and internal-limit flags.

nodes.name: Cia402_Input_T
nodes.summary: Per-axis runtime input: the last Controlword received and the active mode of operation.

nodes.name: Cia402_Config_T
nodes.summary: Per-axis stored option codes (quick stop, shutdown, disable operation, halt, fault reaction) and the quick-stop deceleration; all-zero is the conservative default.

nodes.name: Cia402_Adapter_T
nodes.summary: Adapter context for one CiA 402 axis, pairing its runtime input with its stored option-code config; owned by the outer controller and passed into the motor adapter.

nodes.name: Cia402_OdMeta_T
nodes.summary: Spec-fixed metadata row for one object: index, sub-index, data type and access.

nodes.name: Cia402_OdEntry_T
nodes.summary: Table-driven dictionary entry combining metadata with either an adapter field offset or Get/Set function pointers; groundwork for a table-based dictionary that is not wired in yet.

nodes.name: Cia402_DecodeControlCmd
nodes.summary: Reduces a raw Controlword to one canonical state-machine command from the enable-voltage, quick-stop, switch-on and enable-operation bits.

nodes.name: Cia402_IsFaultResetEdge
nodes.summary: Detects the rising edge of the FaultReset bit between the previous and current Controlword.

nodes.name: Cia402_DecodeStatus
nodes.summary: Decodes a Statusword into the drive state enum using the two CiA 402 state masks.

nodes.name: Cia402_OdIndex_DecodeAxis
nodes.summary: Extracts the axis number from a device-profile index, where each axis occupies one 0x800 page above 0x6000.

nodes.name: Cia402_OdIndex_EncodeAxis
nodes.summary: Re-pages a device-profile object index onto a given axis, keeping only the object bits.

nodes.name: Cia402_OdDeviceIndex
nodes.summary: Normalizes any axis's index to its axis-0 canonical form, the value the object index constants name.

nodes.name: Cia402_Adapter_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Loads stored option codes into an adapter, leaving it unchanged when no config is supplied.

nodes.name: Cia402_OdTable_Find
nodes.summary: Linear search of a dictionary entry table for a matching index and sub-index.

nodes.name: Cia402_Pdo.c
nodes.summary: Defines this drive's PDO channel set: the CiA 402 power-on default mappings for RPDO and TPDO 1-2, the RAM config instance, the channel tables over it, and loading of a stored copy with per-channel fallback to the defaults.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses C23 constexpr for the default config so its channels can be read at init as per-channel fallbacks.

nodes.name: Cia402_Pdo_InitFrom
nodes.summary: Copies each stored RX and TX channel into RAM if it is well-formed, otherwise substitutes that channel's default (erased flash or an image from another layout).

nodes.name: Cia402_Pdo.h
nodes.summary: Declares the drive's PDO set, four channels per direction as in the predefined connection set: the RAM config type and instance, the channel tables over it, and the loader.

nodes.name: Cia402_PdoConfig_T
nodes.summary: RAM image of the node's four RPDO and four TPDO channel records, named for the application's NVM map.

nodes.name: MotorController_Cia402.c
nodes.summary: Binds CiA 402 to the multi-motor controller as a CAN service: the per-axis application dictionary over the motor adapter, the SDO and RxPDO route handlers, the timer-driven TxPDO builder, and the route and broadcast tables published as MOTOR_CONTROLLER_CIA402_SERVICE.
nodes.languageNotes: Handlers are written against MotorController_T and cast to the generic void * handler types in the const route and broadcast tables.

nodes.name: _AppOd_GetInfo
nodes.summary: Application-dictionary metadata callback: accepts device-profile indices whose axis exists and returns the CiA 402 metadata of the axis-0 form.

nodes.name: _AppOd_Get
nodes.summary: Application-dictionary read callback: decodes the axis from the index and forwards to that motor's CiA 402 object read.

nodes.name: _AppOd_Set
nodes.summary: Application-dictionary write callback: decodes the axis from the index and forwards to that motor's CiA 402 object write.

nodes.name: MotorController_Cia402_HandleSdo
nodes.summary: SDO route handler: serves communication-area indices from the PDO parameter dictionary and everything else from the application dictionary, then addresses the reply to the SDO response COB-ID.

nodes.name: MotorController_Cia402_HandleRxPdo
nodes.summary: Single handler for every RxPDO route; the channel table decides which PDO the frame is and writes its mapped objects through the application dictionary.

nodes.name: MotorController_Cia402_BuildTxPdo
nodes.summary: Broadcast builder shared by all TPDO entries: derives the channel from the seeded ID and fills a frame only when that channel's event timer is due.

nodes.name: MotorController_Cia402_BuildTxPdo1
nodes.summary: Fixed-layout alternative that builds TxPDO1 as the Statusword of motor 0.

nodes.name: MotorController_Cia402_BuildTxPdo2
nodes.summary: Fixed-layout alternative that builds TxPDO2 as the Statusword plus the actual value matching the active mode (torque, velocity or position).

nodes.name: MotorController_Cia402_HandleRxPdoCw
nodes.summary: Fixed-layout RxPDO1 handler that applies a Controlword-only frame to motor 0.

nodes.name: MotorController_Cia402_HandleRxPdoCwMode
nodes.summary: Fixed-layout RxPDO2 handler that applies the Controlword plus a setpoint overlay selected by the active mode.

nodes.name: MotorController_Cia402_HandleSdo_Direct
nodes.summary: Alternative SDO handler that calls the motor-level SDO server directly instead of going through the generic dictionary interface.

nodes.name: MotorController_Cia402.h
