nodes.summary: Public interface of the controller-level CiA 402 CAN service: the SDO and RxPDO route handlers, the TxPDO builders, the exported service descriptor, and a node-ID acceptance filter helper.

nodes.name: Cia402_RxFilter
nodes.summary: Builds a hardware Rx acceptance filter that matches only the node-ID bits of a COB-ID.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402.c
nodes.summary: CiA 402 adapter for a single motor: maps the motor state machine to the Statusword, the mode of operation to the feedback mode, and the supported drive-profile objects to motor accessors, with fixed-layout PDO producers and consumers and a motor-level SDO server.
nodes.languageNotes: The switch-based dictionary is the live path; a set of one-line OdGet_/OdSet_ accessors and a commented-out table sketch the table-driven alternative.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_ReadStatus
nodes.summary: Builds the Statusword from the motor state machine state and live phase output, then adds the voltage-enabled and remote flags.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_WriteOpMode
nodes.summary: Applies a requested mode of operation by selecting the motor feedback mode for the velocity and torque modes and recording it as the active mode; unknown values are refused.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_BuildTxPdo_Sw
nodes.summary: Fills a Statusword-only TxPDO.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_BuildTxPdo_SwVelocity
nodes.summary: Fills a TxPDO with the Statusword and the per-unit actual speed.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_BuildTxPdo_SwTorque
nodes.summary: Fills a TxPDO with the Statusword and the q-axis current as the actual torque.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_BuildTxPdo_SwPosition
nodes.summary: Fills a TxPDO with the Statusword and the rotor sensor's mechanical angle.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_HandleRxPdo_Cw
nodes.summary: Applies a Controlword-only RxPDO.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_HandleRxPdo_CwTorque
nodes.summary: Applies the torque setpoint, then the Controlword, from a torque RxPDO.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_HandleRxPdo_CwVelocity
nodes.summary: Applies the speed setpoint, then the Controlword, from a velocity RxPDO.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_HandleRxPdo_CwPosition
nodes.summary: Applies the Controlword from a position RxPDO; the position setpoint is not wired through yet.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_HandleSdo
nodes.summary: Motor-level expedited SDO server that checks object metadata and access, then reads or writes through the motor's CiA 402 dictionary functions and fills the response or abort frame.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_Od_Get
nodes.summary: Reads one supported CiA 402 object for a motor, taken from the adapter input, its config or live motor values.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_Od_Set
nodes.summary: Writes one supported CiA 402 object: Controlword, mode of operation, option codes, quick-stop deceleration, or a torque or velocity target.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402.h
nodes.summary: Interface of the per-motor CiA 402 adapter, documenting the Controlword-to-motor-command and motor-state-to-Statusword mappings and declaring the dictionary accessors, SDO server, and RxPDO and TxPDO handlers.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_ProcControl
nodes.summary: Translates a decoded Controlword command into motor actions (disable, release to high-Z, release to V0, activate control); nothing on the PDO or dictionary path calls it yet.

nodes.name: Motor_Cia402_WriteControl
nodes.summary: Stores the received Controlword in the adapter input; the path taken by PDO and dictionary writes.

nodes.name: MotCan.h
nodes.summary: Wire-format layer of the manufacturer CAN service: CAN IDs and node filter macros, the bijection between a MotVarId and a CANopen manufacturer-area index and sub-index, status-to-abort-code mapping, the typed SDO overlay, and the telemetry and command frame layouts.
nodes.languageNotes: Overlays are packed at every level because they are cast onto byte-aligned CAN buffers and Cortex-M0+ faults on unaligned word loads; static_assert pins size, offset and alignment.

nodes.name: MotCan_VarSdo_T
nodes.summary: Packed overlay of the 8-byte SDO frame whose index and sub-index fields are expanded into the MotVarId fields they carry.

nodes.name: MotCan_Od_VarIdOf
nodes.summary: Decodes a manufacturer-area index and sub-index into the MotVarId they address.

nodes.name: MotCan_Od_StatusOf
nodes.summary: Maps a MotVarId access status to the corresponding CiA 301 SDO abort code.

nodes.name: MotCan_Od_GetInfo
nodes.summary: Reports every valid MotVar address in the manufacturer area as a 32-bit read/write object, and any address with reserved bits set as absent.

nodes.name: MotorController_MotCan.h
nodes.summary: Controller-level manufacturer CAN service: an SDO server exposing the controller variables in the 0x2000 area alongside the CiA 402 objects, telemetry broadcast builders, a traction command handler, and the route and broadcast tables forming MOTOR_CONTROLLER_MOT_CAN_SERVICE.
nodes.languageNotes: Header-only module: handlers and the const route, broadcast and service tables are all static in the header.

nodes.name: _MotCan_OdGetInfo
nodes.summary: Dictionary metadata callback bound to the controller context; forwards to the static MotVar address mapping.

nodes.name: _MotCan_OdGet
nodes.summary: Dictionary read callback that fetches the controller variable named by the index and sub-index.

nodes.name: _MotCan_OdSet
nodes.summary: Dictionary write callback that sets the controller variable and converts its status to an SDO abort code.

nodes.name: _MotCan_HandleSdo
nodes.summary: Runs the generic SDO server over the MotVar dictionary and addresses the reply to the SDO response COB-ID.

nodes.name: MotCan_HandleSdo
nodes.summary: SDO route handler that splits one server address into two object ranges: manufacturer-area MotVar objects and CiA 402 profile objects.

nodes.name: Req_Traction
nodes.summary: Rx handler that applies the throttle and brake values of a traction command frame; its route is currently commented out.

nodes.name: _BuildTelemetry1
nodes.summary: Fills the primary telemetry frame with the per-unit speed, phase current, phase voltage and bus voltage of motor 0.

nodes.name: _BuildTelemetry_Si
nodes.summary: Variant of the primary telemetry frame in engineering units (RPM, amps, volts).

nodes.name: BuildTelemetry1
nodes.summary: Broadcast builder for the primary motion telemetry frame.

nodes.name: _BuildTelemetry2
nodes.summary: Fills the secondary status frame with MOSFET and motor heat, controller fault flags and the motor state.

nodes.name: BuildTelemetry2
nodes.summary: Broadcast builder for the secondary system status frame.

nodes.name: MotVarId.h
nodes.summary: Defines MotVarId_T, the 16-bit wire identifier for controller and motor variables (base, type, prefix, instance), with the prefix and per-prefix type enums shared by all MotProtocol transports, compile-time field-width checks, and the access status codes.
nodes.languageNotes: static_assert pins every enum to the 4-bit wire fields, because an overflowing enum would silently alias ids in the CANopen index mapping.

nodes.name: MotVarId_T
nodes.summary: 16-bit variable identifier union: Base names the member, Type the object type, Prefix the namespace and Instance the instance.

nodes.name: CAN.c
nodes.summary: CAN bus driver implementation: initializes the HAL, programs the hardware Rx acceptance filters from the config, enables the default service, and exposes the config fields through an integer var-ID get/set interface.

nodes.name: ApplyRxFilters
nodes.summary: Programs every hardware filter bank from the config, repeating the last filter in unused banks so none is left open, or accepts all frames when the count is 0.

nodes.name: CAN_Init
nodes.summary: Loads the config from NVM or defaults, initializes the HAL, applies the Rx filters, enables the Rx interrupt, and enables or disables the default service.

nodes.name: CAN_SetRxFilters
nodes.summary: Replaces the Rx filters at runtime and reprograms the hardware.

nodes.name: CAN_InitBaudRate
nodes.summary: Sets the bus bit rate through the HAL.

nodes.name: _CAN_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a CAN config field by ID from a config struct.

nodes.name: CAN_ConfigId_Get
nodes.summary: Null-safe read of a config field by ID from an instance's active config.

nodes.name: _CAN_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a CAN config field by ID into a config struct, clamping the filter count.

nodes.name: CAN_ConfigId_Set
nodes.summary: Null-safe write of a config field by ID; the change takes effect on the next init.

nodes.name: CAN.h
nodes.summary: CAN bus driver interface: the const CAN_T instance with its HAL, state, service and config pointers, the message buffer and Rx filter types, polling and ISR entry points, and the config var-ID interface.
nodes.languageNotes: Object-oriented C: CAN_T is a const descriptor placed in flash that points at mutable RAM state, so one instance needs no runtime construction.

nodes.name: CAN_Buffer_T
nodes.summary: Message buffer holding one frame with its buffer state and timestamp.

nodes.name: CAN_Config_T
nodes.summary: Persistent CAN configuration: the service enable flag and the Rx acceptance filter list.

nodes.name: CAN_State_T
nodes.summary: Mutable runtime state of a CAN instance: its message buffer channels and the active copy of the config.

nodes.name: CAN_T
nodes.summary: Const CAN instance descriptor binding the HAL peripheral, runtime state, application context, default and selectable services, timer and NVM config source.

nodes.name: CAN_PollRx
nodes.summary: Polls the HAL for a received message into the channel 0 buffer and returns whether one was read.

nodes.name: CAN_RxData_ISR
nodes.summary: Rx interrupt handler that only buffers the received frame for later processing.

nodes.name: CAN_Service.h
nodes.summary: CAN service layer: a protocol's stateless route table and periodic broadcast table, per-bus service selection and broadcast timing, ID-mask request dispatch from the Rx buffer or ISR, and timer-driven broadcast transmission.
nodes.languageNotes: Service tables are const and stateless while timing state is per bus, so switching protocol is a single pointer store that the Rx ISR sees whole.

nodes.name: CAN_BroadcastEntry_T
nodes.summary: Const periodic broadcast entry: default CAN ID, frame-builder callback and interval.

nodes.name: CAN_Request_T
nodes.summary: Const inbound route: ID match value, ID mask and the handler invoked for matching frames.

nodes.name: CAN_Service_T
nodes.summary: A protocol's complete CAN service: its route table and broadcast table with their counts, defined by the protocol module and selected as a whole.

nodes.name: CAN_ServiceState_T
nodes.summary: Per-bus service state: the currently selected service pointer and the last transmission time of each of its broadcasts.

nodes.name: CAN_ProcBroadcast
nodes.summary: Builds one broadcast frame seeded with the entry's ID and transmits it when the builder produced data.

nodes.name: CAN_SearchRxTable
nodes.summary: Finds the first route whose masked ID matches a received CAN ID.

nodes.name: _CAN_ProcRequestService
nodes.summary: Dispatches a received frame to its route handler and transmits the reply when the handler filled one.

nodes.name: CAN_ProcRequestService
nodes.summary: Processes the buffered Rx frame against the routes of the currently selected service.

nodes.name: CAN_RxService_ISR
nodes.summary: Rx interrupt entry that polls the buffer and dispatches the frame to the service in ISR context.

nodes.name: CAN_ProcBroadcastService
nodes.summary: Sends each broadcast of the selected service whose interval has elapsed and records its transmission time.

nodes.name: CAN_EnableService
nodes.summary: Selects a service, first rephasing all broadcast timers so its broadcasts start one interval out.

nodes.name: CAN_SetService
nodes.summary: Selects a service by index from the instance's service table.

nodes.name: LimitArray.c
nodes.summary: Translation unit of the LimitArray module that only includes its header; the whole implementation is inline in LimitArray.h.

nodes.name: LimitArray.h
nodes.summary: Multi-source limit (derate) arbitration: a slot-indexed array of limit values with a cached min/max aggregate, so the effective upper and lower limits read in O(1) and only loosening or clearing the active slot rescans the array.
nodes.languageNotes: limit_t is uint16_t by default and int32_t under LIMIT_ARRAY_SIGNED. The const LimitArray_T descriptor points at separately allocated values and augments, which LIMIT_ARRAY_ALLOC creates with compound literals.

nodes.name: LimitArray_Augments_T
nodes.summary: Cached aggregate of a limit array: the current minimum (the effective upper limit) and maximum (the effective lower limit), with the slot ids that set them.

nodes.name: LimitArray_T
nodes.summary: Const descriptor handle of a limit array: pointer to the slot value buffer, its length, and pointer to the LimitArray_Augments_T state.

nodes.name: _LimitArray_ProcCompare
nodes.summary: O(n) rescan of the slot values, skipping cleared slots, that rewrites the cached Min and Max without tracking the slot ids.

nodes.name: _LimitArray_ProcUpdate
nodes.summary: Non-inlined slow path shared by every set and clear site: rescans all slots and rewrites the cached Min, Max and the ids of the slots that set them.

nodes.name: _LimitArray_TestSetUpper
nodes.summary: Writes a slot and updates the upper limit (array minimum): tightening is O(1), loosening the active slot triggers a rescan. Returns true when the upper limit changed.

nodes.name: _LimitArray_TestSetLower
nodes.summary: Writes a slot and updates the lower limit (array maximum): raising it is O(1), lowering the active slot triggers a rescan. Returns true when the lower limit changed.

nodes.name: _LimitArray_TestSetEntry
nodes.summary: Writes a slot against both bounds and returns true when the cached Min or Max differs from the prior state.

nodes.name: _LimitArray_TestClearEntry
nodes.summary: Clears a slot to the no-constraint value and rescans only when that slot was the active minimum or maximum; returns whether it was.

nodes.name: LimitArray_Upper
nodes.summary: Returns the effective upper limit of a LimitArray_T, the cached array minimum, in O(1).

nodes.name: LimitArray_Lower
nodes.summary: Returns the effective lower limit of a LimitArray_T, the cached array maximum, in O(1).

nodes.name: LimitArray_Apply
nodes.summary: Clamps a requested value against the cached Min and Max of the array.

nodes.name: LimitArray_ClearAll
nodes.summary: Resets the cached aggregate and sets every slot of the descriptor's buffer to the cleared (no-constraint) value.

nodes.name: LimitArray_TestSetEntry
nodes.summary: Public slot write on a LimitArray_T: asserts the id is within LENGTH, sets the entry, and returns true when the effective limits changed.

nodes.name: LimitArray_TestSetUpper
nodes.summary: Public slot write that updates only the upper limit of a LimitArray_T, returning true when it changed.

nodes.name: LimitArray_TestClearEntry
nodes.summary: Public slot clear on a LimitArray_T; returns true when the cleared slot was the active limit and the aggregate was recomputed.

nodes.name: RingT.h
nodes.summary: User-facing, bounds-checked ring buffer API over a by-value Ring_Type_T shape descriptor: status, FIFO and deque push/pop, overwrite-on-full variants, zero-copy contiguous spans for DMA, and batch array transfers.
nodes.languageNotes: Emulates a C++ template: the const Ring_Type_T (unit size, length) is passed by value into static inline functions, so the compiler specialises each call site. RING_T_INIT allocates the state with a compound literal.

nodes.name: RingT_T
nodes.summary: Const ring handle pairing the Ring_Type_T shape descriptor with a pointer to its Ring_State_T, whose allocation includes the buffer.

nodes.name: RingT_GetFullCount
nodes.summary: Returns the occupied unit count as the plain difference Tail - Head of the free-running cursors.

nodes.name: RingT_GetEmptyCount
nodes.summary: Returns the free unit count, the capacity less the occupied count.

nodes.name: RingT_IsFull
nodes.summary: True when the occupied count equals the full LENGTH capacity; no slot is reserved for empty detection.

nodes.name: RingT_IsEmpty
nodes.summary: True when the Tail and Head cursors are equal.

nodes.name: RingT_At
nodes.summary: Bounds-checked pointer to the unit at an index from the front; NULL when the index is beyond the occupied count.

nodes.name: RingT_PushBack
nodes.summary: Enqueues one unit at the back; returns false, rejecting the unit, when the ring is full.

nodes.name: RingT_PopFront
nodes.summary: Dequeues one unit from the front into the result; returns false when the ring is empty.

nodes.name: RingT_PushFront
nodes.summary: Pushes one unit at the front (deque use); returns false when the ring is full.

nodes.name: RingT_PopBack
nodes.summary: Pops the most recently pushed unit from the back (deque use); returns false when the ring is empty.

nodes.name: RingT_PushBackOverwrite
nodes.summary: Pushes at the back with an evict-on-full policy, dropping the front unit to make room; returns true when a unit was evicted. Single-threaded use only.

nodes.name: RingT_PushFrontOverwrite
nodes.summary: Pushes at the front with an evict-on-full policy, dropping the back unit to make room; returns true when a unit was evicted. Single-threaded use only.

nodes.name: RingT_FrontSpan
nodes.summary: Returns the first contiguous span of occupied units from Head, for zero-copy read-out such as a DMA send.

nodes.name: RingT_BackSpan
nodes.summary: Returns the first contiguous span of free units from Tail, for zero-copy writes into the ring.

nodes.name: RingT_PeekFrontArray
nodes.summary: Copies count units from the front into an array without removing them, handling the wrap; false when fewer than count are held.

nodes.name: RingT_PopFrontArray
nodes.summary: Copies exactly count units out of the front and removes them, all or nothing.

nodes.name: RingT_PushBackArray
nodes.summary: Appends exactly count units from an array, all or nothing, placing across the wrap before advancing Tail once.

nodes.name: RingT_PushBackMax
nodes.summary: Appends as many units as fit, up to maxCount, and returns the number pushed.

nodes.name: RingT_PopFrontMax
nodes.summary: Removes as many units as are held, up to maxCount, into an array and returns the number popped.

nodes.name: RingT_PushBackArrayOverwrite
nodes.summary: Always accepts the whole array: evicts front units as needed, skips leading source units beyond the capacity, and returns the number of units lost.

nodes.name: _RingT.h
nodes.summary: Private core of the generic ring buffer: the Ring_Type_T shape descriptor, Ring_State_T storage with free-running power-of-2 counter cursors, and the unchecked place/peek/push/pop, random access and wrap-split span primitives that RingT.h wraps with boundary checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Length must be a power of 2, enforced by a static_assert hidden in a sizeof expression. Head and Tail are volatile free-running counters masked on access, a single-producer / single-consumer contract. The state ends in a flexible array member allocated through a union compound literal.

nodes.name: Ring_Type_T
nodes.summary: Const flyweight shape descriptor of a ring: unit size in bytes and length in units (a power of 2), passed by value so each operation specialises at compile time.

nodes.name: Ring_State_T
nodes.summary: Ring runtime state: volatile free-running Head and Tail counters, an optional critical-section lock, and the flexible Buffer[] storage.

nodes.name: array_index_of_counter
nodes.summary: Maps a free-running ring counter to an array index by masking with (pow2len - 1).

nodes.name: ring_at
nodes.summary: Returns a pointer to the unit at a ring index in a strided power-of-2 array, masking the index on access.

nodes.name: _RingT_RemoveFront
nodes.summary: Advances Head by count, dropping units from the front without copying.

nodes.name: _RingT_IncBack
nodes.summary: Advances Tail by count, committing units already placed at the back.

nodes.name: _RingT_RemoveBack
nodes.summary: Moves Tail back by count, dropping units from the back.

nodes.name: _RingT_PushBack
nodes.summary: Unchecked enqueue: copies the unit to the Tail slot, then advances Tail.

nodes.name: _RingT_PopFront
nodes.summary: Unchecked dequeue: copies the Head unit to the result, then advances Head.

nodes.name: _RingT_PushFront
nodes.summary: Unchecked front push: moves Head back by one, then copies the unit into the new Head slot.

nodes.name: _RingT_PopBack
nodes.summary: Unchecked back pop: moves Tail back by one, then copies that unit to the result.

nodes.name: _RingT_At
nodes.summary: Unchecked pointer to the unit at Head + index.

nodes.name: _RingT_SplitOf
nodes.summary: Splits a run of units starting at a cursor: returns the unit count of the first contiguous segment, up to the end of the array.

nodes.name: _RingT_SpanOf
nodes.summary: Builds the ArraySpanT_T of the first segment of a run, from the cursor to the end of the array.

nodes.name: _RingT_SpanWrapOf
nodes.summary: Builds the ArraySpanT_T of the wrapped remainder of a run, based at Buffer[0], with length 0 when the run does not wrap.

nodes.name: _RingT_PlaceBackWrap
nodes.summary: Copies units into the free space at Tail as two memcpy segments across the wrap, without advancing Tail.

nodes.name: _RingT_PeekFrontWrap
nodes.summary: Copies units out from Head as two memcpy segments across the wrap, without advancing Head.

nodes.name: Array.h
nodes.summary: Array span types and static allocation macros: ArraySpan_T (buffer and length), the typed view ArraySpanT_T (unit size, buffer, length) with size, element access and memcpy helpers, and compound-literal buffer allocators used by containers such as Ring and LimitArray.

nodes.name: ArraySpan_T
nodes.summary: Untyped array span: a buffer pointer and its length in units.

nodes.name: ArraySpanT_T
nodes.summary: Typed array view returned by value: unit size, buffer pointer and length in units, describing one contiguous run.

nodes.name: ArraySpan_Size
nodes.summary: Returns the span size in bytes, LENGTH times TYPE_SIZE.

nodes.name: ArraySpan_At
nodes.summary: Returns a pointer to the unit at an index of the span.

nodes.name: ArraySpan_CopyTo
nodes.summary: Copies the whole span out to a destination buffer with memcpy.

nodes.name: ArraySpan_CopyFrom
nodes.summary: Fills the whole span from a source buffer with memcpy.

nodes.name: void_array.h
nodes.summary: Type-erased array primitives keyed by element size: strided element access, get/set by value, bulk copy, foreach / every / any iteration with callback accessors, and min/max search by value or comparator.
nodes.languageNotes: The element size is passed as a size_t argument to static inline functions so the compiler folds it to a constant. array_foreach_call selects the iterator with _Generic on the callback function-pointer type.

nodes.name: void_array_at
nodes.summary: Returns a pointer to the element at an index of an untyped buffer, striding by the element size.

nodes.name: void_array_assign_at
nodes.summary: Copies one element by pointer into the slot at an index.

nodes.name: void_array_get
nodes.summary: Reads the element at an index as a sign-extended value_t.

nodes.name: void_array_set
nodes.summary: Writes a value_t into the element at an index, truncated to the element size.

nodes.name: array_get_instance
nodes.summary: Bounds-checked read of a field of the instance at an index through a get_field_t accessor; 0 when the instance is out of range.

nodes.name: array_set_instance
nodes.summary: Bounds-checked write of a field of the instance at an index through a set_field_t accessor.

nodes.name: void_array_foreach
nodes.summary: Calls a proc_t on every element of the array.

nodes.name: void_array_for_every
nodes.summary: Runs a try_proc_t on every element without stopping early; true when all returned true.

nodes.name: void_array_for_any
nodes.summary: Runs a try_proc_t on every element without stopping early; true when at least one returned true.

nodes.name: void_array_is_every
nodes.summary: Const test that every element satisfies a test_t predicate, returning early at the first failure.

nodes.name: void_array_is_any
nodes.summary: Const test that any element satisfies a test_t predicate, returning early at the first match.

nodes.name: void_array_foreach_set
nodes.summary: Calls a set_t with the same value on every element.

nodes.name: void_array_for_every_set
nodes.summary: Applies a try_set_t with one value to every element; true when all accepted it.

nodes.name: void_array_for_any_set
nodes.summary: Applies a try_set_t with one value to every element; true when at least one accepted it.

nodes.name: void_array_is_every_value
nodes.summary: Const test that every element passes a test_value_t against a value, returning early.

nodes.name: void_array_is_any_value
nodes.summary: Const test that any element passes a test_value_t against a value, returning early.

nodes.name: void_array_min
nodes.summary: Returns a pointer to the element with the smallest numeric value, read by element size.

nodes.name: void_array_max
nodes.summary: Returns a pointer to the element with the largest numeric value, read by element size.

nodes.name: void_array_min_with
nodes.summary: Returns a pointer to the minimum element under a caller-supplied compare_t.

nodes.name: void_array_max_with
nodes.summary: Returns a pointer to the maximum element under a caller-supplied compare_t.

nodes.name: Field.h
nodes.summary: Generic struct field access for variable tables and packet serialization: offset/size Field_T descriptors, the getter/setter pair VField_T, the guarded VarAccess_T table, and the id-indexed Accessor_T interface.

nodes.name: Field_T
nodes.summary: Const field descriptor giving a struct member's size and offset, built by the FIELD(Type, Member) macro.

nodes.name: VField_T
nodes.summary: Const virtual field: a generic getter and setter function-pointer pair for one variable.

nodes.name: VarAccess_T
nodes.summary: Const variable-access table: an array of VField_T entries with its count, an optional TEST_SET guard and an ON_SET notification.

nodes.name: Accessor_T
nodes.summary: Const accessor interface of id-indexed GET_FIELD and SET_FIELD function pointers, for sub-modules that dispatch their variables with a switch.

nodes.name: get_field
nodes.summary: Reads a 1, 2 or 4 byte field at a byte offset of a context struct as an int.

nodes.name: set_field
nodes.summary: Writes an int, truncated to the field size, at a byte offset of a context struct.

nodes.name: Field_Get
nodes.summary: Reads a struct field through a Field_T descriptor.

nodes.name: Field_Set
nodes.summary: Writes a struct field through a Field_T descriptor.

nodes.name: VarAccess_TrySet
nodes.summary: Guarded variable write: refuses when TEST_SET fails, otherwise calls the variable's SET and then the ON_SET notification.

nodes.name: accessor.h
nodes.summary: Vocabulary of generic function-pointer types (proc, poll, get, set, test, field get/set, compare, apply) over a void context and a register-width value_t, with NULL-safe call shorthands and a _Generic dispatch macro.

nodes.name: call_proc
nodes.summary: Calls a proc_t on a context when the pointer is not NULL.

nodes.name: call_get_field
nodes.summary: Calls a get_field_t when not NULL, returning 0 otherwise.

nodes.name: call_set_field
nodes.summary: Calls a set_field_t when not NULL.

nodes.name: call_test
nodes.summary: Calls a test_t when not NULL; a NULL test passes.

nodes.name: call_test_set
nodes.summary: Calls a test_value_t with a value when not NULL; a NULL test passes.

nodes.name: void_pointer.h
nodes.summary: Size-keyed operations on untyped pointers: copy by unit size, sign-extending read of 1, 2, 4 or 8 byte values, truncating write, and a pointer-cast union with a _Generic value macro.

nodes.name: switch_copy
nodes.summary: Copies one unit by size: a direct 1/2/4/8 byte assignment when the size is a compile-time constant, memcpy otherwise.

nodes.name: pointer_assign
nodes.summary: Copies one unit of the given size between untyped pointers with memcpy, transparent when the size is a compile-time constant.

nodes.name: pointer_value_as
nodes.summary: Reads the unit at a pointer as a signed 1, 2, 4 or 8 byte value, sign-extended to int; 0 for other sizes.

nodes.name: pointer_assign_value_as
nodes.summary: Writes an int through a pointer, truncated to a signed 1, 2, 4 or 8 byte unit; other sizes are ignored.

nodes.name: ADC.h
nodes.summary: ADC base for one converter addressed by channel mask: the const ADC_T context (HAL, pin table, results buffer) and ADC_State_T, with the channel marker and completion flag operations shared by the software, hardware-triggered and hardware-sequenced activation styles.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes its private header _ADC.h after the typedefs. The struct tag is ADC_Module because vendor headers define ADC as a peripheral base macro.

nodes.name: ADC_State_T
nodes.summary: ADC runtime state shared by the ISR and the requesting thread: channel markers (to convert), completion flags (landed, not yet consumed), the active-channel fifo mirror, and debug error counters.

nodes.name: ADC_T
nodes.summary: Const ADC context wrapping HAL_ADC with a pointer to its state, the channel-to-pin table and count, and the per-channel results buffer.

nodes.name: ADC_Mask_IsContiguous
nodes.summary: Tests that the set bits of a channel mask form one contiguous run, as a hardware slot range requires.

nodes.name: ADC_ReadIsActive
nodes.summary: Reads the HAL conversion-active flag.

nodes.name: ADC_ResultOf
nodes.summary: Returns the latest result of a channel from the results buffer.

nodes.name: ADC_MarkChannel
nodes.summary: Marks one channel for conversion in the software walker's work queue.

nodes.name: ADC_MarkAll
nodes.summary: Marks every channel of a mask for conversion.

nodes.name: ADC_IsComplete
nodes.summary: Peeks whether every channel of a mask has landed, without consuming the flags.

nodes.name: ADC_PollComplete
nodes.summary: All-or-nothing take: clears the completion flags of a mask only when every one is set, so a partial set can still complete.

nodes.name: ADC_ClearComplete
nodes.summary: Greedy take: clears and returns whichever completion flags of a mask have landed.

nodes.name: ADC_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the HAL ADC and leaves it deactivated; trigger and transfer resources are set up by the board.

nodes.name: ADC_Batch.h
nodes.summary: Board-layer join of channel sets over 1..N ADCs converted by one trigger: each part is an ADC_Sequence_T, the last transfer ISR to land takes every part's completion flags, runs the batch handler and applies a deferred batch selection.

nodes.name: ADC_Batch_T
nodes.summary: Const batch descriptor: the array of ADC_Sequence_T parts that one trigger converts, the part count, and the completion handler with its context.

nodes.name: ADC_BatchTrigger_T
nodes.summary: Per-trigger selection state for batches: the active batch in flight and the next batch, applied at the join.

nodes.name: _ADC_Batch_PartOf
nodes.summary: Finds the part of a batch that the given ADC converts; NULL when the ADC is not one of its parts.

nodes.name: _ADC_Batch_IsEachComplete
nodes.summary: Peeks that every part of the batch has landed, before any flags are taken.

nodes.name: _ADC_Batch_TakeEach
nodes.summary: Takes the completion flags of every part of the batch.

nodes.name: _ADC_Batch_ActivateEachDma
nodes.summary: Writes every part of the batch to its ADC's hardware sequencer; only while all ADCs of the trigger are idle.

nodes.name: ADC_Batch_TakeComplete
nodes.summary: Join test: when every part has landed, takes the whole set so the handler runs once.

nodes.name: ADC_Batch_Poll
nodes.summary: Takes the batch when complete and runs its ON_COMPLETE handler; returns true where it joined on this call.

nodes.name: ADC_BatchTrigger_OnComplete_ISR
nodes.summary: Transfer-complete ISR body, one per ADC of the trigger: flags that ADC's part, runs the join when the last part lands, then applies a deferred batch selection by reprogramming every part.

nodes.name: ADC_BatchTrigger_ActivateDma
nodes.summary: Immediate activation of a batch, on init or while the trigger source is inactive; sets both Active and Next.

nodes.name: ADC_BatchTrigger_Select
nodes.summary: Deferred batch selection in one store from any thread, applied at the next join.

nodes.name: ADC_Channel.h
nodes.summary: Single-channel ADC collaborator: an ADC_Channel_T binds a channel id and pin to its ADC with an optional capture handler, providing mark/activate/result access and an ISR dispatcher that pushes each landed channel to its handler.

nodes.name: ADC_Channel_T
nodes.summary: Const channel handle: channel id, pin, optional capture handler with context, and the ADC it belongs to.

nodes.name: ADC_Channel_Mark
nodes.summary: Marks the channel for conversion on its ADC.

nodes.name: ADC_Channel_Activate
nodes.summary: Marks the channel and starts the marked channels of its ADC, asserting that the channel's pin matches the base pin table.

nodes.name: ADC_Channel_Result
nodes.summary: Returns the channel's latest result from its ADC's results buffer.

nodes.name: ADC_Channel_TakeComplete
nodes.summary: Consumes the channel's completion flag; true once per landed conversion.

nodes.name: ADC_Channel_Capture
nodes.summary: Pushes the channel's buffered result to its CAPTURE handler when one is registered.

nodes.name: _ADC_Channel_CaptureEach_Ctz
nodes.summary: Dispatches the capture of every landed channel by iterating the set bits with count-trailing-zeros.

nodes.name: _ADC_Channel_CaptureEach_Branch
nodes.summary: Dispatches the capture of every landed channel with a linear bit scan, for cores without CLZ.

nodes.name: ADC_Channel_CaptureEach
nodes.summary: Pushes each landed channel of a channel table to its handler in channel order, selecting the ctz or branch scan by __ARM_FEATURE_CLZ.

nodes.name: ADC_Channel_OnComplete_ISR
nodes.summary: ADC ISR body for a channel table: runs the base completion capture, then takes every flag and pushes the landed channels to their handlers.

nodes.name: ADC_Sequence.h
nodes.summary: Channel-set ADC collaborator: an ADC_Sequence_T is a channel mask on one ADC converted as a unit by software walk or by the hardware sequencer with DMA, with completion polling and an ADC_SequenceTrigger_T that alternates sets on one trigger.

nodes.name: ADC_Sequence_T
nodes.summary: Const activation record of a channel set on one ADC: the channel mask, an optional completion handler with context, and the ADC pointer.

nodes.name: ADC_SequenceTrigger_T
nodes.summary: Per-trigger selection state for sequences: the active sequence and the next sequence, applied at the completion that follows.

nodes.name: ADC_Sequence_Mark
nodes.summary: Marks every channel of the set for a software conversion.

nodes.name: ADC_Sequence_Activate
nodes.summary: Software activation: marks the set and starts the marked channels of its ADC.

nodes.name: ADC_Sequence_ActivateDma
nodes.summary: Hardware-sequenced activation: asserts the mask is contiguous and writes the slot range to the sequencer, repeating on every trigger.

nodes.name: ADC_Sequence_IsComplete
nodes.summary: Peeks whether every channel of the set has landed.

nodes.name: ADC_Sequence_PollComplete
nodes.summary: All-or-nothing take of the set's completion flags.

nodes.name: ADC_Sequence_Poll
nodes.summary: Closes the set where it has landed and runs its COMPLETE handler once; returns true where it closed on this call.

nodes.name: ADC_SequenceTrigger_SetNext
nodes.summary: Deferred sequence selection in one store from any thread, applied at the completion that follows.

nodes.name: ADC_SequenceTrigger_ActivateDma
nodes.summary: Immediate activation of a sequence on the trigger, setting both Active and Next before writing the sequencer.

nodes.name: ADC_SequenceTrigger_OnCompleteDma_ISR
nodes.summary: Transfer-complete ISR body: flags and closes the active set, runs its handler, then activates the next set when the selection changed.

nodes.name: ADC_SequenceTrigger_OnComplete
nodes.summary: Software counterpart run after the base ISR or from a polling thread: closes the active set, switches to the selected set, and starts the next conversion.

nodes.name: ADC_Thread.h
nodes.summary: ISR and thread entry points of the ADC base: the software-activation completion ISR and marked-channel start, and the hardware-triggered arm/disarm path with its capture-only ISR.

nodes.name: ADC_OnComplete_ISR
nodes.summary: Software-activation ADC ISR: clears the hardware flag, captures the active channels, then continues with the remaining marked channels or deactivates the ADC.

nodes.name: ADC_PollCompleteFifo
nodes.summary: Polling substitute for the ISR: runs the completion capture when the conversion-complete flag is set.

nodes.name: ADC_ActivateMarked
nodes.summary: Thread-side start of the marked channels when the ADC is idle; while it is active the ISR continues the walk, counted as an incomplete cycle in debug builds.

nodes.name: ADC_OnCompleteArmed_ISR
nodes.summary: Hardware-triggered ADC ISR: clears the flag, captures the armed fifo and deactivates, continuing nothing.

nodes.name: _ADC_Disarm
nodes.summary: Resets the fifo of an armed set whose trigger did not come and counts the missed trigger; the channels stay marked.

nodes.name: ADC_Arm
nodes.summary: Arms a channel mask, as given, to convert on the next hardware trigger, disarming a stale arm first.

nodes.name: ADC_ArmMarked
nodes.summary: Arms the marked channels that fall within a filter mask when the ADC is idle; returns true where a set was armed.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC.h
nodes.summary: HAL contract for the ADC: the prototypes each platform implements (read result, activate, fifo, flags, hardware trigger, DMA sequence), the adc_result_t and adc_pin_t value types, and fifo write/activate/arm/capture helpers built on them. Includes the chip-specific HAL through HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH.
nodes.languageNotes: Compile-time polymorphism: the header declares static inline prototypes, then #includes the platform implementation selected by the HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH macro.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC_WriteFifo
nodes.summary: Writes a list of pins into the ADC fifo, asserting the count fits the platform fifo length.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC_WriteFifo_ActivateOnLast
nodes.summary: Writes all but the last pin to the fifo, then writes the last with the activating call.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC_ActivateEach
nodes.summary: Starts a conversion of a pin list: sets the fifo count and fills the fifo on platforms with a fifo, otherwise activates the single pin.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC_ArmEach
nodes.summary: Arms a pin list to convert on the next hardware trigger where the platform has a hardware-trigger fifo; a no-op otherwise.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC_CaptureEach
nodes.summary: Reads the result of each pin of a list into a results array.

nodes.name: _ADC.h
nodes.summary: Private ADC helpers for fifo capture and activation: resolves channel ids to pins, fills the active-channel fifo mirror from the marker mask (ctz or branch scan), starts or arms conversions through the HAL, and moves captured channels from markers to completion flags.

nodes.name: _ADC_CaptureTo
nodes.summary: Reads the fifo results back in the order pushed and stores each by channel id, returning the captured mask; a fifo count mismatch captures nothing.

nodes.name: _ADC_ActivateFrom
nodes.summary: Resolves the active channel ids to pins and starts their conversion through the HAL.

nodes.name: _ADC_ArmFrom
nodes.summary: Resolves the active channel ids to pins and arms them on the hardware trigger through the HAL.

nodes.name: _ADC_Capture
nodes.summary: Captures the active channels of an ADC_T into its results buffer.

nodes.name: _ADC_Activate
nodes.summary: Starts the conversion of the active channels of an ADC_T.

nodes.name: _ADC_Arm
nodes.summary: Arms the active channels of an ADC_T on the hardware trigger.

nodes.name: _ADC_ActivateDma
nodes.summary: Selects the hardware sequencer slot range, start and count derived from a contiguous channel mask.

nodes.name: _ADC_SetStateFrom_Ctz
nodes.summary: Fills the active-channel list from the marker mask, lowest channel first up to the fifo depth, with count-trailing-zeros; returns the markers processed.

nodes.name: _ADC_SetStateFrom_Branch
nodes.summary: Fills the active-channel list from the marker mask with a linear bit scan, for cores without CLZ; returns the markers processed.

nodes.name: _ADC_SetStateFrom
nodes.summary: Selects the ctz or branch marker scan by __ARM_FEATURE_CLZ.

nodes.name: _ADC_ActivateMarked
nodes.summary: Loads the next fifo depth of marked channels into the active list and starts their conversion.

nodes.name: _ADC_CaptureActive
nodes.summary: Captures the active channels, clears their markers, sets their completion flags and empties the active list; false where nothing was active. Debug builds count errors and fifo mismatches.

nodes.name: _ADC_MarkComplete
nodes.summary: Sets the completion flags of the armed set, run in the transfer-complete ISR for hardware-sequenced conversions.

nodes.name: CAN_Frame.h
nodes.summary: CAN frame data types: a SocketCAN-style 32-bit can_id_t union with EFF/RTR/ERR flag bits, and the packed CAN_Frame_T holding the id, data length and 8 data bytes.

nodes.name: CAN_Frame_T
nodes.summary: Packed CAN frame: can_id_t identifier with flag bits, data length, option and reserved bytes, and 8 data bytes.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN.h
nodes.summary: HAL contract for CAN: register-granularity prototypes for Tx/Rx id, data, flags, interrupts, baud rate and acceptance filters, with default frame-level write/read/poll helpers over CAN_Frame_T. Includes the chip-specific HAL through HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH.
nodes.languageNotes: The default frame helpers compile out when the platform defines HAL_CAN_OVERRIDE_DEFAULT_IMPLEMENTATION.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_WriteTxId
nodes.summary: Default implementation: writes a can_id_t to the Tx registers as an extended or standard id and sets the remote flag when RTR.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_ReadRxId
nodes.summary: Default implementation: builds a can_id_t from the Rx extended flag, remote flag and the matching id register.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_WriteTxMessage
nodes.summary: Writes a CAN_Frame_T to the Tx buffer, id then data; the data write launches the transmission.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_ReadRxMessage
nodes.summary: Reads the Rx id and data into a CAN_Frame_T.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_PollRxMessage
nodes.summary: Polls the Rx full flag; when set, reads the frame, clears the flag and returns true.

nodes.name: ClockTimer.h
nodes.summary: Thin clock timer wrapper over the timer HAL: a const instance pairing a HAL timer with its counting frequency, with inline init, reset and delta-T capture for timing the interval between clock edges.

nodes.name: ClockTimer_T
nodes.summary: Const clock timer instance: a pointer to the HAL timer and the frequency it counts at.

nodes.name: ClockTimer_CaptureDeltaT
nodes.summary: Captures the timer ticks elapsed since the previous capture, saturated on overflow, and restarts the count; called on a clock edge from polling or an ISR.

nodes.name: ClockTimer_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the HAL timer and sets its counting frequency.

nodes.name: ClockTimer_SetInitial
nodes.summary: Clears the overflow flag and zeroes the counter to start a fresh measurement.

nodes.name: HAL_ClockTimer.h
nodes.summary: HAL contract for a free-running clock timer: declares the read, write, overflow, enable and init functions a platform must provide, includes the build-selected platform implementation, and adds a platform-independent period capture that saturates on overflow.
nodes.languageNotes: The prototypes act as a compile-time interface: the matching definitions come from the macro-computed include `#include HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH(HAL_ClockTimer.h)` that follows them.

nodes.name: HAL_ClockTimer_CapturePeriod
nodes.summary: Reads the timer count, substitutes HAL_CLOCK_TIMER_MAX when the overflow flag is set, then zeroes the counter and clears the flag.

nodes.name: HAL_Peripheral.h
nodes.summary: Defines the HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH() include-path macro that resolves every peripheral HAL header to either an external directory or the library's Platform/<chip> directory at build time, plus the WEAK attribute macro.
nodes.languageNotes: Dependency inversion without function pointers: module headers write `#include HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH(File)` and the build defines HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH_DIRECTORY or HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH_PLATFORM; an #error fires if neither is set.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash.h
nodes.summary: HAL contract for on-chip flash: prototypes for the completion and error flags, the write, erase, verify and write-once command starts, security unlock and init, followed by the include of the build-selected platform implementation.
nodes.languageNotes: The completion and error flag reads carry FLASH_ATTRIBUTE_RAM_SECTION so they can execute from RAM while a flash command is in progress.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM.h
nodes.summary: Selector header that pulls in the platform-specific PWM HAL through HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH, supplying the HAL PWM channel and module types and register functions used by PWM.h.

nodes.name: PWM.c
nodes.summary: Empty translation unit for the PWM module; it only includes PWM.h and HAL_PWM.h because the whole API is inline in the header.

nodes.name: PWM.h
nodes.summary: Header-only PWM driver split into a per-channel object (duty write and read scaled to PWM_DUTY_MAX, output enable, polarity inversion) and a shared timer-module object (period, interrupt, synchronized loading of buffered values).
nodes.languageNotes: Instances are `typedef const struct` objects holding only constants and a HAL pointer, so they sit in flash and every call inlines down to a register access.

nodes.name: PWM_Module_T
nodes.summary: Const descriptor of a shared PWM timer module: HAL module pointer, period in ticks and the combined channel mask used for synchronized updates.

nodes.name: PWM_T
nodes.summary: Const descriptor of one PWM channel: HAL pointer, channel id and the period in ticks used to scale duty values.

nodes.name: _PWM_DutyTicksOf
nodes.summary: Converts a duty value scaled to PWM_DUTY_MAX into timer ticks for the channel's period.

nodes.name: PWM_WriteDuty_Ticks
nodes.summary: Writes a duty expressed in timer ticks to the channel through the HAL.

nodes.name: PWM_WriteDuty
nodes.summary: Writes a duty scaled to PWM_DUTY_MAX (100 percent) to the channel.

nodes.name: PWM_WriteDutyMidPlus
nodes.summary: Writes a duty offset upward from 50 percent: half the period plus half the scaled duty.

nodes.name: PWM_WriteDutyMidMinus
nodes.summary: Writes a duty offset downward from 50 percent: half the period minus half the scaled duty.

nodes.name: PWM_ReadDuty
nodes.summary: Reads the channel's duty back from the HAL and returns it scaled to PWM_DUTY_MAX.

nodes.name: PWM_Enable
nodes.summary: Enables the channel's output.

nodes.name: PWM_Disable
nodes.summary: Disables the channel's output.

nodes.name: PWM_ClearInterrupt
nodes.summary: Clears the interrupt flag of the shared PWM module.

nodes.name: PWM_Module_WriteSyncDuty
nodes.summary: Triggers a synchronized load of the buffered duty values for the channels in the module's SYNC_MASK.

nodes.name: PWM_Module_WriteSyncOnOff
nodes.summary: Triggers a synchronized load of the buffered output on/off states for the channels in the module's SYNC_MASK.

nodes.name: PWM_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes both the timer module and the channel from a single channel descriptor.

nodes.name: PWM_Channel_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes only the channel, for use when the timer module is initialized separately.

nodes.name: PWM_Module_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the shared PWM timer module and sets its period in ticks.

nodes.name: HAL_Pin.h
nodes.summary: Selector header that includes the platform-specific GPIO pin HAL through HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH for use by the Pin module.

nodes.name: HAL_SPI.h
nodes.summary: Selector header that includes the platform-specific SPI HAL through HAL_PERIPHERAL_PATH, supplying the HAL SPI type and register-level functions to the SPI driver.

nodes.name: SPI.c
nodes.summary: Implements the SPI master transaction driver: the transfer start and end lifecycle with chip-select handling, interrupt-driven submit, a bounded blocking transfer, and Xcvr-shaped half-duplex Tx and Rx.

nodes.name: StartTransfer
nodes.summary: Prepares the loaded transfer: drains a stale Rx byte, resets the Tx and Rx indices, marks the bus busy and asserts chip select.

nodes.name: _SPI_EndTransfer
nodes.summary: Ends the active transfer: disarms both interrupts, releases chip select unless a successful transfer asked to hold it, clears mode-fault errors, records the terminal status and invokes the completion callback.

nodes.name: SPI_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the SPI HAL as master with the instance's clock mode, bit order and baud rate, deasserts chip select and sets the state idle.

nodes.name: SPI_Deinit
nodes.summary: Deinitializes the SPI HAL.

nodes.name: SPI_Submit
nodes.summary: Starts an interrupt-driven transfer by copying the descriptor into the state and arming the Rx and Tx interrupts; returns a busy error if a transfer is already running.

nodes.name: SPI_Transfer_Blocking
nodes.summary: Runs a transfer by polling the same transfer step with interrupts unarmed, ending it with a timeout status after SPI_BLOCKING_TIMEOUT_LOOPS iterations.

nodes.name: SPI_Exchange_Blocking
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that builds a transfer from Tx and Rx buffers and a size, then runs it blocking.

nodes.name: SPI_Tx
nodes.summary: Xcvr-shaped blocking write: clocks out the buffer and discards the echo, returning true on success.

nodes.name: SPI_Rx
nodes.summary: Xcvr-shaped blocking read: clocks out fill characters and captures the echo, returning true on success.

nodes.name: SPI.h
nodes.summary: SPI master transaction driver interface: defines the transfer descriptor, per-bus state and const instance types, and the inline transfer step shared by the interrupt handler and the blocking path.
nodes.languageNotes: The unit of work is a whole transfer rather than a byte: state is an index pair over caller-owned buffers, with RxIndex trailing TxIndex because each received byte is the echo of a transmitted one.

nodes.name: SPI_Transfer_T
nodes.summary: One SPI transfer, the driver's unit of work: caller-owned Tx and Rx buffers (either may be NULL for a read-only or write-only transfer), a size, and a completion callback with its context.

nodes.name: SPI_State_T
nodes.summary: Mutable per-bus state: the active transfer, the Tx and Rx indices, the terminal status and the chip-select hold flag.

nodes.name: SPI_T
nodes.summary: Const SPI master instance for one bus and one device: HAL pointer, state pointer, chip-select pin, clock frequency, clock mode and bit order.

nodes.name: _SPI_CaptureRx
nodes.summary: Reads the Rx data register, which also clears the full flag, stores the byte when the transfer has an Rx buffer, and advances RxIndex.

nodes.name: _SPI_FeedTx
nodes.summary: Writes the next Tx byte, or the fill character when the transfer has no Tx buffer, and advances TxIndex.

nodes.name: SPI_ProcTransfer
nodes.summary: Transfer step used as the interrupt entry point and by the blocking poll: handles a mode fault, captures a received byte, feeds the next Tx byte, and ends the transfer once the last echo has landed.

nodes.name: SPI_GetStatus
nodes.summary: Returns the status of the current or most recent transfer.

nodes.name: SPI_IsBusy
nodes.summary: Returns true while a transfer is in progress.

nodes.name: SPI_SetCsHold
nodes.summary: Sets the sticky flag that keeps chip select asserted after the next transfer, so consecutive transfers reach the device as one framed transaction.

nodes.name: SPI_Xcvr.h
nodes.summary: Adapts an SPI instance to the generic Xcvr transport interface with a vtable that maps TX and RX to SPI_Tx and SPI_Rx and the transfer-pending flag to chip-select hold.
nodes.languageNotes: The vtable is a `static const` object defined in the header and the SPI functions are cast to the void-pointer Xcvr signatures; SET_TARGET and CONFIG_BAUD_RATE are left NULL, which the Xcvr wrappers treat as nothing to set.

nodes.name: SetFlags
nodes.summary: Translates the generic Xcvr flag word into SPI chip-select hold: XCVR_FLAG_XFER_PENDING keeps chip select asserted after the transfer.

nodes.name: HAL_UART.h
nodes.summary: HAL contract for a UART: prototypes for data register access, FIFO counts, error and interrupt control, baud rate and init that the build-selected platform header implements, plus platform-independent polled send and receive helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: The helpers take one snapshot of the hardware count and loop min(count, length) times, so they need no per-character flag check and no FIFO size macro.

nodes.name: HAL_UART_SendChar
nodes.summary: Writes one byte to the hardware Tx register or FIFO if it has space and returns whether it was written.

nodes.name: HAL_UART_RecvChar
nodes.summary: Reads one byte from the hardware Rx register or FIFO if one is available and returns whether a byte was read.

nodes.name: HAL_UART_Send
nodes.summary: Writes up to length bytes into the hardware Tx buffer, bounded by one snapshot of its free space, and returns the count written.

nodes.name: HAL_UART_Recv
nodes.summary: Reads up to length bytes out of the hardware Rx buffer, bounded by one snapshot of its fill count, and returns the count read.

nodes.name: UART.c
nodes.summary: Implements the buffered UART API: init, baud-rate change, and single-byte, exact-length and best-effort send and receive through the Tx and Rx ring buffers, each guarded by a per-direction critical section.
nodes.languageNotes: The critical section is selected by macro: by default only the channel's own interrupt is masked (single-threaded callers); defining UART_ENTER_CRITICAL and UART_EXIT_CRITICAL swaps in a global critical section for multithreaded use.

nodes.name: UART_SendN
nodes.summary: Queues exactly length bytes into the Tx ring, or none if they do not fit, then enables the Tx interrupt if the ring holds data.

nodes.name: UART_RecvN
nodes.summary: Pops exactly length bytes from the Rx ring, succeeding only when that many have been received.

nodes.name: UART_Init
nodes.summary: Initializes the UART HAL, switches the transmitter and receiver on, clears both rings and enables the Rx and Tx interrupts.

nodes.name: UART_Deinit
nodes.summary: Deinitializes the UART HAL.

nodes.name: UART_ConfigBaudRate
nodes.summary: Changes the baud rate with the transmitter and receiver switched off during the update and returns whether the HAL accepted the rate.

nodes.name: UART_FlushBuffers
nodes.summary: Clears the Tx and Rx ring buffers.

nodes.name: UART_SendByte
nodes.summary: Queues one byte into the Tx ring and enables the Tx interrupt if the ring holds data.

nodes.name: UART_RecvByte
nodes.summary: Pops one byte from the Rx ring if one is available.

nodes.name: UART_SendMax
nodes.summary: Queues as many bytes as fit in the Tx ring, clipping the rest, and returns the count queued.

nodes.name: UART_RecvMax
nodes.summary: Pops up to destSize received bytes from the Rx ring and returns the count read.

nodes.name: UART.h
nodes.summary: Buffered UART byte-stream driver interface: a const instance holding Rx and Tx ring buffers, inline Rx and Tx ISRs that move bytes between the hardware and the rings, and polling to recover from Rx overrun.
nodes.languageNotes: Both ISRs move min(available, space) bytes from one snapshot of each count; since each count only grows from the other side, the loop body needs no per-byte check.

nodes.name: UART_T
nodes.summary: Const UART instance: the HAL pointer plus the Rx and Tx ring buffer contexts.

nodes.name: UART_RxData_ISR
nodes.summary: Rx interrupt handler: moves min(hardware count, ring space) bytes from the hardware into the Rx ring and disables the Rx interrupt when bytes remain with no ring space left.

nodes.name: UART_TxData_ISR
nodes.summary: Tx interrupt handler: moves min(hardware space, pending) bytes from the Tx ring to the hardware and disables the Tx interrupt once the ring is drained.

nodes.name: UART_PollRestartRxIsr
nodes.summary: Polled recovery: when an Rx overrun has occurred and the ring has space again, clears the error and re-enables the Rx interrupt; returns whether it restarted.

nodes.name: UART_GetRxFullCount
nodes.summary: Returns the number of received bytes waiting in the Rx ring.

nodes.name: UART_GetTxEmptyCount
nodes.summary: Returns the free space in the Tx ring.

nodes.name: UART_IsRxOverrun
nodes.summary: Returns true when the hardware reports an Rx overrun while the Rx ring is not full.

nodes.name: UART_Xcvr.h
nodes.summary: Adapts a UART instance to the generic Xcvr transport interface with a vtable that maps TX and RX to UART_SendN and UART_RecvN and baud-rate configuration to UART_ConfigBaudRate.
nodes.languageNotes: SET_TARGET and SET_FLAGS stay NULL because a UART has no addressed target and no transaction to hold open.

nodes.name: Xcvr.h
nodes.summary: Generic message transport interface: a vtable of whole-message Tx and Rx functions plus optional target, flags and baud-rate setters, and a const instance binding a base object to it, so a protocol can run over UART, SPI or another bus interchangeably.
nodes.languageNotes: Runtime polymorphism in C: a const struct of function pointers taking `void *` as the object, with optional entries left NULL and treated as success by the inline wrappers.

nodes.name: Xcvr_VTable_T
nodes.summary: Transport interface vtable: the required TX and RX message functions and the optional SET_TARGET, SET_FLAGS and CONFIG_BAUD_RATE property setters.

nodes.name: Xcvr_T
nodes.summary: Const transport instance pairing an opaque base object, such as a UART or SPI instance, with its vtable.

nodes.name: Xcvr_TxN
nodes.summary: Sends one whole message through the instance's vtable TX function.

nodes.name: Xcvr_RxN
nodes.summary: Receives one whole message through the instance's vtable RX function.

nodes.name: _Xcvr_SetValue
nodes.summary: Calls an optional property setter on the base object, treating an absent (NULL) setter as success.

nodes.name: Xcvr_SetTarget
nodes.summary: Sets the target of the next message, such as an I2C address or SPI chip-select id, when the transport supports one.

nodes.name: Xcvr_SetFlags
nodes.summary: Sets transaction flags for the next message, such as holding the bus open at its end, when the transport supports them.

nodes.name: Xcvr_ConfigBaudRate
nodes.summary: Requests a baud-rate change when the transport supports it.

nodes.name: HAL_Encoder.h
nodes.summary: Selector header for the encoder HAL: includes HAL_Encoder.h from a dedicated HAL_ENCODER_PATH when one is defined, otherwise from the common peripheral HAL path.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC.h
nodes.summary: KE0x (MKE06Z/MKE02Z) ADC register-level HAL: channel activation, conversion FIFO depth and pin loading, hardware-trigger control, completion flags and NVIC interrupt gating. Also holds the board-called SIM_SOPT0 routing of the FTM2 init trigger through a one-shot delay to the ADC.
nodes.languageNotes: Header-only static inline functions over a typedef of the vendor register struct, so each call reduces to a register access with no call overhead.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC_T
nodes.summary: ADC HAL handle: alias of the vendor ADC_Type register struct that every HAL_ADC_* function takes as its first argument.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC_Activate
nodes.summary: Starts a conversion by writing SC1 with the channel selected and the conversion-complete interrupt enabled.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC_Deactivate
nodes.summary: Disables the ADC by setting every channel-select bit while clearing the interrupt enable, which isolates the input and ends continuous conversion.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC_WriteHwTriggerFifoCount
nodes.summary: Sets the FIFO depth together with HTRGME so that one hardware trigger converts the whole FIFO instead of one channel per trigger.

nodes.name: HAL_ADC_Init
nodes.summary: Minimal ADC init selecting the VDDA/VSSA reference; clock source, resolution and divider are left to the board.

nodes.name: KE0x_ADC_InitHwTriggerFtm2
nodes.summary: Board-called platform init that selects the FTM2 init trigger, with delay, as the ADC hardware trigger source in SIM_SOPT0.

nodes.name: KE0x_ADC_InitHwTriggerDelay
nodes.summary: Sets the 8-bit one-shot delay, in ticks of the delay clock, between the FTM2 trigger and the ADC start.

nodes.name: KE0x_ADC_InitHwTriggerDelayClock
nodes.summary: Selects the trigger delay clock as the bus clock divided by 2^busRef through SIM_SOPT0[BUSREF].

nodes.name: HAL_CAN.h
nodes.summary: MSCAN register-level HAL for KE0x: encodes and decodes standard and extended identifiers through bit-field images of the IDR bytes, loads and launches one of three Tx buffers, reads the single foreground Rx buffer, and programs two 32-bit acceptance filter banks inside an init-mode window. Also sets the bit timing (8 time quanta per bit) and initializes the module at a default 250 kbps.
nodes.languageNotes: Bit-field structs inside anonymous unions map a 29-bit ID onto the four IDR bytes. The flag registers are write-1-to-clear, so they are written with the exact bit rather than read-modify-write.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_T
nodes.summary: CAN HAL handle: alias of the vendor MSCAN_Type register struct operated on by the HAL_CAN_* functions.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_WriteTxExtendedId
nodes.summary: Splits a 29-bit identifier across the four Tx IDR bytes of the selected buffer through bit-field images, setting IDE and SRR and placing RTR in IDR3.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_WriteTxStandardId
nodes.summary: Encodes an 11-bit identifier and the RTR bit into the two standard-frame Tx IDR bytes.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_ReadRxExtendedId
nodes.summary: Reassembles the 29-bit identifier from the four IDR bytes of the foreground Rx buffer.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_ReadRxStandardId
nodes.summary: Reassembles the 11-bit identifier from the two standard-frame Rx IDR bytes.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_WriteTxExtendedId
nodes.summary: Selects an empty Tx buffer, one of three, through CANTBSEL and writes an extended identifier with RTR cleared.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_WriteTxStandardId
nodes.summary: Selects an empty Tx buffer through CANTBSEL and writes a standard identifier with RTR cleared.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_WriteTxRemote
nodes.summary: Sets the remote-request bit on the already-selected Tx buffer, in IDR3 for an extended frame or IDR1 for a standard frame.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_WriteTxData
nodes.summary: Copies up to 8 payload bytes and the DLC into the selected Tx buffer, then launches it by clearing that buffer's CANTFLG bit.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_ReadRxData
nodes.summary: Copies the received payload, length clamped to 8, out of the foreground Rx buffer and returns the byte count; the Rx-full flag is left for the caller to clear.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_EnterInitMode
nodes.summary: Requests MSCAN initialization mode and blocks until the controller acknowledges it.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_ExitInitMode
nodes.summary: Clears the initialization request and blocks until the controller has left init mode.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_SetRxFilterStandard
nodes.summary: Programs one 32-bit acceptance bank for 11-bit IDs from an (id, mask) pair where a mask 1 means must match, inverting it to the MSCAN 1 = ignore polarity. IDE is a care bit, so extended frames are rejected; the caller must already be in init mode.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_SetRxFilterExtended
nodes.summary: Programs one 32-bit acceptance bank for 29-bit IDs from an (id, mask) pair with must-match mask polarity, matching data and remote frames alike; the caller must already be in init mode.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_SetRxFilterAcceptAll
nodes.summary: Sets both 32-bit acceptance banks fully to don't-care so every frame reaches the Rx buffer; the caller must already be in init mode.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_EnterFilterWindow
nodes.summary: Saves the Rx interrupt enables and enters init mode ahead of a runtime filter change, because init mode resets CANRIER.

nodes.name: _HAL_CAN_ExitFilterWindow
nodes.summary: Leaves init mode and restores the saved Rx interrupt enables.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_SetRxFilterStandard
nodes.summary: Runtime standard-ID filter update: wraps the bank write in an init-mode window that preserves the Rx interrupt enables.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_SetRxFilterExtended
nodes.summary: Runtime extended-ID filter update inside an init-mode window that preserves the Rx interrupt enables.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_SetRxFilterAcceptAll
nodes.summary: Opens both acceptance banks at runtime inside an init-mode window.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_SetRxFilterAcceptNone
nodes.summary: Closes the acceptance filter (IDAM closed) inside an init-mode window so the hardware accepts no frames.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_InitBaudRate
nodes.summary: Derives the prescaler for 8 time quanta per bit from the CAN clock, clamps it to the 6-bit BRP field, and writes the bit-timing registers in init mode.

nodes.name: HAL_CAN_Init
nodes.summary: Enables the MSCAN module, selects its clock source with loopback and listen-only off, opens the acceptance filters, and applies the default baud rate.

nodes.name: HAL_ClockTimer.h
nodes.summary: Free-running 16-bit FTM timer HAL for KE0x clocked from the CPU clock: counter read and write, overflow flag and interrupt, and power-of-two prescaler selection for a requested tick frequency.

nodes.name: HAL_ClockTimer_T
nodes.summary: Clock timer HAL handle: alias of the vendor FTM_Type register struct used as a free-running time base.

nodes.name: HAL_ClockTimer_InitFreq
nodes.summary: Picks the power-of-two FTM prescaler nearest the requested tick frequency, restarts the counter on the system clock, and returns the frequency actually set.

nodes.name: HAL_ClockTimer_Init
nodes.summary: Sets the modulo to the full 16-bit range and starts the counter on the system clock.

nodes.name: HAL_EEPROM.h
nodes.summary: EEPROM HAL for KE0x on the flash controller type: on KE06, which has no EEPROM, every operation is a zero-size no-op stub; on KE02 the 512-byte EEPROM operations forward to the HAL_Flash command and flag functions.

nodes.name: HAL_EEPROM_T
nodes.summary: EEPROM HAL handle: alias of HAL_Flash_T, since flash and EEPROM share one controller on KE0x.

nodes.name: HAL_EEPROM_StartCmdWriteUnit
nodes.summary: KE02 form of the EEPROM unit write, forwarding to the flash page program command; the KE06 build defines the same name as a no-op stub (line 49).

nodes.name: HAL_Encoder.h
nodes.summary: Encoder HAL for KE0x: the chip has no quadrature decoder mode, so the counter interface is stubbed to constants and the encoder is emulated with FTM channel input-capture edge interrupts (rising, falling or both edges).

nodes.name: HAL_Encoder_Counter_T
nodes.summary: Encoder counter handle: alias of FTM_Type kept for interface parity; its counter and quadrature functions are stubs on KE0x.

nodes.name: HAL_Encoder_Pin_T
nodes.summary: Encoder pin handle: alias of FTM_Type whose channels capture the encoder phase edges and raise the per-phase interrupts.

nodes.name: HAL_Encoder_InitPinInterruptDualEdge
nodes.summary: Configures an FTM channel for input capture on both edges with its channel interrupt enabled, the basis of the emulated edge counter.

nodes.name: HAL_FastPin.h
nodes.summary: Fast GPIO (FGPIO) pin HAL for KE0x: set, clear, toggle and read pins by mask, plus direction and input-disable setup for input, output and deinit.

nodes.name: HAL_FastPin_T
nodes.summary: Fast pin HAL handle: alias of the vendor FGPIO_Type register struct, the single-cycle access alias of the GPIO port.

nodes.name: HAL_FastPin_WriteOutput
nodes.summary: Drives the masked pins high or low by rewriting the port data output register.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash.h
nodes.summary: Flash controller HAL for KE0x (FTMRE on KE06, FTMRH on KE02): builds command sequences through the indexed FCCOB registers for program, sector erase, erase-verify, program-once/read-once and backdoor-key unlock, launches them by writing CCIF, and reads the completion and error flags. Maps the 512-byte sector and 8-byte phrase onto the unit sizes the upper flash layer uses and sets the flash clock divider at init.
nodes.languageNotes: The launch and completion-poll functions carry a RAM-section attribute so they can run while the flash array is busy if the compiler does not inline them; FTMRx_* macros alias the two controller variants.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_T
nodes.summary: Flash HAL handle: alias of the vendor flash controller register struct, FTMRE_Type on KE06 or FTMRH_Type on KE02.

nodes.name: _flash_set_command
nodes.summary: Writes one indexed FCCOB word: selects the command-object index, then loads its low and high bytes.

nodes.name: _HAL_Flash_WriteCmdDest
nodes.summary: Loads the command code and the 24-bit destination address into FCCOB indices 0 and 1.

nodes.name: _HAL_Flash_WriteCmdData
nodes.summary: Loads an 8-byte phrase into FCCOB indices 2 to 5 as four words.

nodes.name: _HAL_Flash_LaunchCmd
nodes.summary: Launches the loaded command by writing 1 to CCIF; placed in a RAM section so it can execute while the flash array is busy.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_ReadCompleteFlag
nodes.summary: Returns whether the command-complete flag (CCIF) is set; RAM-resident so the busy-wait can run during a flash operation.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_StartCmdWritePage
nodes.summary: Starts programming one 8-byte phrase at the destination address.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_StartCmdEraseSector
nodes.summary: Starts erasing the 512-byte sector that contains the destination address.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_StartCmdEraseAll
nodes.summary: Starts the erase-all-blocks command.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_StartCmdVerifyEraseUnit
nodes.summary: Starts an erase-verify of a single unit at the destination address.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_StartCmdVerifyEraseUnits
nodes.summary: Starts an erase-verify of a given number of units from the destination address.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_StartCmdWriteOnce
nodes.summary: Starts a program-once command for one 8-byte record, mapping the address to a record index within the 64-byte program-once field.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_StartCmdReadOnce
nodes.summary: Starts a read-once command for the record index derived from the address.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_ReadOnceData
nodes.summary: Copies the 8-byte read-once result out of FCCOB indices 2 to 5.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_UnlockSecurity
nodes.summary: Loads the verify-backdoor-key command and an 8-byte key into the FCCOB registers; it does not launch the command itself.

nodes.name: HAL_Flash_Init
nodes.summary: Writes the flash clock divider derived from the bus frequency when FCLKDIV is not locked and no command is running, then asserts the divider matches.

nodes.name: HAL_I2C.h
nodes.summary: I2C register-level HAL for KE0x: byte data, status and write-1-to-clear flags, the single shared interrupt source, START/STOP/repeated-START and ACK control, slave address, and a baud-rate search over the MULT factor and the 64-entry ICR divider table.

nodes.name: HAL_I2C_T
nodes.summary: I2C HAL handle: alias of the vendor I2C_Type register struct operated on by the HAL_I2C_* functions.

nodes.name: HAL_I2C_WriteStart
nodes.summary: Generates a START condition by setting master mode and transmit direction while the bus is idle.

nodes.name: HAL_I2C_WriteSwitch
nodes.summary: Sets or clears the module enable bit and waits until it reads back; also exposed as Serial-style Tx and Rx switch aliases.

nodes.name: HAL_I2C_InitBaudRate
nodes.summary: Searches every MULT and ICR divider combination for the SCL rate with the smallest absolute error from the request and writes it to the frequency divider register; returns false for a zero rate.

nodes.name: HAL_I2C_Init
nodes.summary: Resets the control and filter registers and clears any stale interrupt and arbitration-lost flags.

nodes.name: HAL_I2C_Deinit
nodes.summary: Disables the I2C interrupt and switches the module off.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM.h
nodes.summary: FlexTimer PWM HAL for KE0x: per-channel duty, output mask, polarity and software output control, and module-wide synchronized updates (software-triggered duty load at the counter minimum and maximum, whole-register output mask and polarity writes). Module init sets center-aligned PWM with enhanced sync and enables the init trigger output.
nodes.languageNotes: Channel-level and module-level handles are separate typedefs of the same FTM register struct, which keeps per-channel calls and whole-timer calls distinct in signatures.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM_T
nodes.summary: PWM channel-level handle: alias of FTM_Type taken by the per-channel duty, output, polarity and software-control functions.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM_Module_T
nodes.summary: PWM module-level handle: alias of FTM_Type taken by the timer-wide interrupt, sync and init functions.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM_WriteDuty
nodes.summary: Writes a channel compare value (CnV), buffered until the next synchronized load.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM_InitChannel
nodes.summary: Configures a channel for high-true pulses and unmasks its output.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM_SyncModuleDuty
nodes.summary: Issues the software sync trigger that loads the buffered duty values at the counter minimum and maximum loading points.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM_SyncModuleOutputState
nodes.summary: Writes the whole output mask in one store so the given channels turn on and the rest are masked on the same clock.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM_SyncModuleInvert
nodes.summary: Writes the whole polarity register so the given channels are inverted and the rest active high; POL is unbuffered and changes at the write.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM_InitModulePeriod
nodes.summary: Stops the counter clock, writes the modulo for the period in ticks, and restarts the counter on the system clock.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM_InitModuleFreq
nodes.summary: Sets the PWM period from a frequency using the center-aligned clock source frequency.

nodes.name: HAL_PWM_InitModule
nodes.summary: Enables FTM mode with center-aligned PWM, channel sync on all pairs, enhanced software-triggered sync, all outputs masked, the init trigger output and the overflow interrupt, leaving the clock off until the period is set.

nodes.name: HAL_Pin.h
nodes.summary: GPIO pin HAL for KE0x: mask-based set, clear and toggle through the write-only PSOR/PCOR/PTOR registers, a masked port write, pin reads, and direction and input-disable setup.

nodes.name: HAL_Pin_T
nodes.summary: Pin HAL handle: alias of the vendor GPIO_Type port register struct; pins are addressed by bit mask.

nodes.name: HAL_Pin_WriteModuleOutput
nodes.summary: Writes several pins of a port at once: the bits selected by the mask take the given on/off pattern and the rest keep their state.

nodes.name: HAL_Reboot.h
nodes.summary: Software reboot for KE0x: disables and clears every NVIC interrupt and the pending SysTick, restores the reset clock configuration, then requests a system reset.

nodes.name: HAL_Reboot
nodes.summary: Masks interrupts, clears the NVIC enable and pending registers and the pending SysTick, returns the clock tree to its reset state, and issues an NVIC system reset.

nodes.name: HAL_SPI.h
nodes.summary: SPI register-level HAL for KE0x: 8-bit full-duplex data, status flags, Tx and Rx interrupt enables, the single SPE enable exposed through Serial-style Tx/Rx switch aliases, master, clock-mode and bit-order configuration, and a baud-rate search over the SPPR prescaler and SPR divisor.

nodes.name: HAL_SPI_T
nodes.summary: SPI HAL handle: alias of the vendor SPI_Type register struct operated on by the HAL_SPI_* functions.

nodes.name: HAL_SPI_ClearRxErrors
nodes.summary: Clears a mode fault with the read-status-then-write-C1 sequence; the KE0x SPI has no receive overrun flag.

nodes.name: HAL_SPI_WriteSwitch
nodes.summary: Sets or clears the single SPI enable bit and waits until it reads back; the Tx and Rx switch aliases gate this same bit.

nodes.name: HAL_SPI_SetClockMode
nodes.summary: Maps SPI mode 0 to 3 onto the clock polarity and phase bits.

nodes.name: HAL_SPI_InitBaudRate
nodes.summary: For each of the nine SPR divisors computes the rounded SPPR prescaler, keeps the pair with the smallest absolute error from the requested rate, and writes it to the baud register; returns false for a zero rate.

nodes.name: HAL_SPI_Init
nodes.summary: Clears the control and baud registers, leaving the module disabled with interrupts off, and reads the status register.

nodes.name: HAL_SPI_Deinit
nodes.summary: Disables the Tx and Rx interrupts and switches the module off.

nodes.name: HAL_Types.h
nodes.summary: Forward typedefs of the KE0x HAL handle types (UART, clock timer, ADC, CAN, flash) onto the vendor register structs, so signatures can name them before the full HAL headers are included. Also defines HAL_ADC_HW_TRIGGER_FIFO on KE06, where one hardware trigger converts the whole ADC FIFO.

nodes.name: HAL_UART.h
nodes.summary: UART register-level HAL for KE0x: character transmit and receive, data-register status reported as 0/1 counts, overrun flag, Tx and Rx interrupt enables, enable switches that wait for the bit to take effect, and baud-rate divisor configuration accepted only within 3 % of the request.

nodes.name: HAL_UART_T
nodes.summary: UART HAL handle: alias of the vendor UART_Type register struct operated on by the HAL_UART_* functions.

nodes.name: HAL_UART_WriteTxSwitch
nodes.summary: Sets or clears the transmitter enable bit and waits until the write has taken effect.

nodes.name: HAL_UART_WriteRxSwitch
nodes.summary: Sets or clears the receiver enable bit and waits until the write has taken effect.

nodes.name: HAL_UART_ConfigBaudRate
nodes.summary: Computes the 16x-oversampling SBR divisor, picks the closer of sbr and sbr + 1, and writes BDH/BDL with the transmitter and receiver briefly disabled only when the achieved rate is within 3 % of the request; returns whether it was applied.

nodes.name: HAL_UART_Deinit
nodes.summary: Disables the Tx and Rx interrupts and switches both the transmitter and receiver off.

nodes.name: HAL_Watchdog.h
nodes.summary: Watchdog HAL placeholder for KE0x: defines the HAL_Watchdog_T handle over the vendor WDOG register struct; the feed, disable and init functions exist only as commented-out drafts.

nodes.name: HAL_Watchdog_T
nodes.summary: Watchdog HAL handle: alias of the vendor WDOG_Type register struct; no functions operate on it yet.

nodes.name: KE0x.h
nodes.summary: Platform include selector for KE0x: pulls in the vendor device header for MKE06Z4 or MKE02Z4 according to the series macro and fails the build when neither is defined.

nodes.name: KE0x_Clock.h
nodes.summary: KE0x clock tree bring-up called by the board: granular SIM divider, oscillator and ICS steps (FLL reference, output select, lock wait) composed into the FLL-engaged-external and FLL-engaged-internal boot clocks and the reset-state clock used before a reboot.
nodes.languageNotes: Each register step is its own small inline function with a blocking status wait; the boot sequences are plain compositions of those steps, with flattened copies kept as comments.

nodes.name: KE0x_SIM_InitClockDivs
nodes.summary: Sets the SIM dividers so the core and timer run at ICSOUTCLK and the bus at half; written before the ICS switch.

nodes.name: KE0x_SIM_InitClockDivsUnity
